raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY


The Customer & Client Experience (C&CE) team is responsible for the servicing of Cigna customers across multiple lines of business, including US Employer, Pharmacy Benefit Management, Individual and Family Plans, and more. C&CE owns the delivery of exceptional customer experiences while operating Cigna’s call centers effectively and efficiently for the business. The Senior Strategy & Analytics Advisor will be responsible for leading critical analytical work that supports C&CE strategic priorities.

This role is part of a Business Analyst team that provides direct support to the Workforce & Footprint Strategy team in the C&CE organization, including driving strategic improvements in customer experience and operating efficiency, as well as supporting improvements in the associate experience through better capabilities and tools. They will work closely with leadership and their teams to deeply understand the business problems at hand, develop analytical models/insights and build compelling business case presentations that positively influence go forward strategy.

Senior Advisors are expected to independently structure workstreams, solve problems, and seek additional opportunities across stakeholder domains. Senior Advisors can expect to lead impactful projects across domains or functions, perform hands-on analysis, present to executive (VP+) audiences, and help drive overall business strategy.


This role will be highly visible, and the individual will be a critical thought partner to leaders across C&CE.

This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates in select geographies. Candidates who reside within 50 miles of the following locations will be required to perform onsite 3 days per week: Bloomfield, CT; Chattanooga, TN; Denver, CO; Scottsdale, AZ; St Louis, MO.

Primary Functions

  • Shape C&CE strategy by developing business cases, evaluating options, and assessing costs and benefits to guide prioritization decisions
  • Leverage data to solve business problems by identifying data needs, pulling data from relevant sources, and performing analysis
  • Identify business opportunities using trend analysis and mining operational data for insights
  • Develop testing plans, monitor performance indicators, and be ready to quickly investigate and remediate emerging issues
  • Grow into a thought partner and executive storyteller by distilling work into crisp presentations that educate, inform, and inspire action
  • Employ a product management mindset to translate Operations needs into business requirements that can be delivered by Tech partners

Role Components:

  • Analytics – Evaluate business opportunities and make strategic recommendations. Identify an effective method, perform data analysis, and develop recommendations that account for benefits, costs, risks, and alternatives.
  • Strategy – Shape the future of C&CE through data-driven analysis and business acumen. Identify and assess truly transformational opportunities for change over the next 3-5 years.
  • Business Judgment – Develop and use frameworks to scope and address ambiguous problems. Understand where the leverage is and focus problem-solving efforts to uncover insights that drive action.
  • Data – Ground analysis in data as much as possible. Define needs, identify data sources, ensure data quality, and partner with data teams to complete analysis and forecasting future expectations. Coding experience in a relevant language (e.g. SQL or Python) is a core requirement.
  • Communications – Influence senior leaders across C&CE and our stakeholder teams. Distill complex analytical work into key insights, recommendations, and next steps. Grow as a persuasive storyteller and thought leader.
  • Teamwork – Partner extensively across Cigna. Work closely with Operations, Product, Tech, and Finance teams. Learn from supportive Analytics leaders and join an inclusive, empowering team where you can grow professionally and have fun!

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Business, or related field preferred
  • Five years of relevant analytics or management consulting experience
  • Strong communication (oral and written), presentation, and facilitation skills
  • Ability to structure project / program plans and independently drive workstream forward
  • Ability to partner across organizations and roles to influence and deliver work
  • Proficiency in an analytics-focused coding language, e.g. SQL, Python, or R
  • Two years of building, managing, or using business models, e.g. optimization, predictive analysis and forecasting, or financial / credit modeling

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree (e.g. MS in Analytics)
  • Eight or more years of relevant analytics or management consulting experience
  • Four or more years of end-to-end model design and ownership experience, e.g. optimization, predictive analysis and forecasting, or financial / credit modeling
  • Two or more years of healthcare experience
  • Two or more years of experience in Operations or Customer Experience

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.For this position, we anticipate offering an annual salary of 112,800 - 188,000 USD / yearly, depending on relevant factors, including experience and geographic location.

This role is also anticipated to be eligible to participate in an annual bonus plan.


At The Cigna Group, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits, with a focus on supporting your whole health. Starting on day one of your employment, you’ll be offered several health-related benefits including medical, vision, dental, and well-being and behavioral health programs. We also offer 401(k), company paid life insurance, tuition reimbursement, a minimum of 18 days of paid time off per year, paid holidays, and leaves of absence. For more details on our employee benefits programs, click here.





About The Cigna Group

Doing something meaningful starts with a simple decision, a commitment to changing lives. At The Cigna Group, we’re dedicated to improving the health and vitality of those we serve. Through our divisions Cigna Healthcare and Evernorth Health Services, we are committed to enhancing the lives of our clients, customers and patients. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, childbirth (including pregnancy) or related medical conditions including but not limited to lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital or familial status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete the online application process, please email for assistance. Please note that this email inbox is dedicated to accommodation requests only and cannot provide application updates or accept resumes.

The Cigna Group has a tobacco-free policy and reserves the right not to hire tobacco/nicotine users in states where that is legally permissible. Candidates in such states who use tobacco/nicotine will not be considered for employment unless they enter a qualifying smoking cessation program prior to the start of their employment. These states include: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Vermont, and Washington State.

Qualified applicants with criminal histories will be considered for employment in a manner consistent with all federal, state and local ordinances.

raw.description:
LOCATION:Remote – must live in or near Rockingham County, Forsyth County, Surry County, Stokes County, North Carolina. The person in this role is required to maintain residency in North Carolina or within 40 miles of the NC border. This position will serve Rockingham County, NC, Forsyth County, NC, Surry County, NC, and Stokes County, NC. Must have ability to travel as needed to those counties.

    GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB

    The Personal Care Services (PCS) Assessor Registered Nurse is responsible for completing needs-based assessments/eligibility determinations for Medicaid-beneficiaries in Vaya Partners regions who are applying for State Plan Personal Care Services provided in their home or in adult care or supervised living homes. These Medicaid-beneficiaries have a medical condition, cognitive impairment, or disability and demonstrate unmet needs for hands-on assistance with qualifying activities of daily living (ADLs). The PCS Assessor Registered Nurse is responsible for scheduling appointments, administering telephonic and face-to-face assessments in beneficiaries home and community, working with healthcare professionals, and submitting service authorization requests (SARs) on behalf of PCS providers.

    ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

    PCS Assessment and Collaboration

  • Works with members, family members, and/or other healthcare professionals to schedule assessments.
  • Conducts assessment to determine whether the member meets the conditions and criteria for PCS eligibility, using standardized assessment tool(s).
  • Conducts interviews with family members and informal caregivers who are present at the time of the assessment.
  • Ensures that assessments are conducted within established timeframes.
  • Performs expedited assessments over the phone as needed.
  • Provides education and assistance to the member, as necessary, to select PCS providers.
  • Works with prescribers and/or other healthcare professionals to ensure that requests are accurate and complete.
  • Submits service authorization requests (SARs) on behalf of PCS provider.
  • Ensures that the privacy and dignity of individuals receiving assessment for PCS is maintained at the highest standards.
  • Participates in mediation and appeal processes, as needed.
  • Responds to state inquiries regarding assessments conducted.

Other duties as assigned

Including, but not limited to, attending and actively participating in staff meetings and conducting case consultations/peer reviews/internal auditing as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

  • Knowledge of North Carolina Medicaid Clinical Coverage Policy (Clinical Policy) 3L and PCS Program Provider Manual
  • Knowledge of standards of practice related to Medicaid-funded State Plan Personal Care Services, home and community-based services (HCBS) programs, and Early and Periodic Screening, Diagnostic and Treatment (EPSDT).
  • Knowledge and understanding of public sector services and supports.
  • Computer proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.
  • Ability to utilize computer equipment and web-based software to conduct work.
  • Ability to interact with various office staff as needed to support necessary workflows.
  • Ability to interact with healthcare professionals, patients, their families and other supports.
  • Ability to communicate effectively to individuals and groups through spoken, written and electronic media.
  • Ability to attend to detail, effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a timely manner.
  • Ability to work independently without a high degree of supervision.
  • Develops level of care recommendations based upon clinical evaluations.
  • Participates in training of PCS stakeholders as needed.
  • Ability to use person-centered thinking, planning, and have competency in awareness of the needs of persons with disabilities.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Close visual acuity to perform activities such as preparation and analysis of documents; viewing a computer terminal; and extensive reading. Physical activity in this position includes crouching, reaching, walking, talking, hearing and repetitive motion of hands, wrists and fingers. Sedentary work with lifting requirements up to 10 pounds, sitting for extended periods of time. Mental concentration is required in all aspects of work.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree in Nursing or other healthcare field required and two years of experience in home care setting. Experience with community-based individuals needing personal assistance with ADL and IADL tasks is highly preferred. Experience conducting PCS assessments highly preferred.

Licensure/Certification Required:

Must have active licensure in North Carolina as a Registered Nurse (RN).

RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT:The person in this position is required to reside in North Carolina or within 40 miles of the North Carolina border.

SALARY:Depending on qualifications & experience of candidate. This position is exempt and is not eligible for overtime compensation.

DEADLINE FOR APPLICATION:Open Until Filled

APPLY:Vaya Partners accepts online applications in our Career Center, please visit.

Vaya Partners is an equal opportunity employer.

raw.title: Incubation Research Specialist II
raw.excerpt: As an Incubation Research Specialist II, you'll join a newly established research and incubation capability within Global Program, helping transform emerging ideas into evidence-based solutions that improve outcomes for children, youth, families, and churches around the world.
raw.description:
As an Incubation Research Specialist II, you'll join a newly established research and incubation capability within Global Program, helping transform emerging ideas into evidence-based solutions that improve outcomes for children, youth, families, and churches around the world. Incubation is how Compassion explores unmet needs, develops promising concepts, rigorously tests them in real-world settings, and determines whether they should be expanded for greater impact.

This is not a traditional research role. You'll work at the intersection of innovation, strategy, and practical ministry application, partnering with diverse stakeholders across the globe to explore complex questions, facilitate meaningful conversations, and evaluate new approaches that could shape the future of child development programming.


If you are curious, collaborative, energized by ambiguity, and passionate about using research to drive meaningful change, this role offers a unique opportunity to influence Compassion's future while advancing its mission to release children from poverty in Jesus' name.


This position may be filled at either the Level II or Level III based on the selected candidate's experience, skills, and demonstrated competencies.


What will you do?


  • Maintain a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. Is a consistent witness for Jesus Christ, maintains a courteous, Christ-like attitude in dealing with people within and outside of Compassion, and faithfully upholds Compassion's ministry in prayer.
  • Act as an advocate to raise the awareness of the needs of children. Understand Christ's mandate to protect children. Commit to and prioritize child protection considerations in all decision-making, tasks and activities across the ministry. Abide by all behavioral expectations in Compassion's Statement of Commitment to Child Protection and Code of Conduct. Report any concerns of abuse, neglect or exploitation of children through Compassion's internal reporting process and appropriately support responses to incidents if they occur.
  • Support the design, development, and implementation of incubation and research initiatives that address complex challenges facing children, youth, families, churches, and field offices.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to identify unmet needs, generate new ideas, and evaluate their potential effectiveness, sustainability, and scalability.
  • Explore and apply appropriate research methods to answer key learning questions and assess the impact of pilot initiatives.
  • Facilitate workshops, discussions, and stakeholder engagement sessions that bring together diverse perspectives and foster collaborative problem-solving.
  • Analyze and synthesize research findings, translating complex concepts into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support projects from concept development through testing and evaluation, helping determine whether an approach should be refined, expanded, or concluded.
  • Contribute to learning agendas that strengthen Compassion's ability to innovate responsibly and effectively.
  • Balance and integrate feedback from multiple stakeholders, including children, youth, church partners, field leaders, researchers, and organizational leadership.
  • Stay informed on emerging research, development trends, and innovative practices relevant to child development and poverty alleviation.
  • Travel globally (up to 30%) to support project implementation, stakeholder engagement, and learning activities as needed.
  • Foster a culture of curiosity, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement across teams.

What do you bring?

  • Master’s degree preferred or Bachelor's degree and approximately five years of relevant experience.
  • Familiarity with research processes and methodologies, with a willingness to learn and apply new approaches.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and a passion for exploring complex questions without predetermined answers.
  • Ability to thrive in ambiguity, adapt to evolving priorities, and contribute within a newly established capability.
  • Strong collaboration skills and experience working effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and organizational levels.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts in clear and engaging ways.
  • Experience engaging diverse stakeholders, from subject-matter experts to community-based practitioners.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and facilitation capabilities.
  • Experience conducting or supporting research, monitoring, evaluation, learning, or related activities is preferred.
  • Exposure to human-centered design, innovation, design thinking, or incubation approaches is desirable.
  • Experience working in cross-cultural is highly valued.
  • Familiarity with data analysis tools such as R, Stata, or similar platforms is beneficial.
  • Spanish or Kiswahili language skills are a plus.

Why work here?

  • The mission: Join a team that is motivated to release children from poverty in Jesus' name.
  • Our benefits: Receive generous paid time off, 10% contribution to a 403(b) retirement fund on top of your salary, excellent healthcare coverage, free short-term professional counseling, and more.
  • Spiritual growth: Participate in regular chapel services, prayer groups, and department devotionals.

raw.excerpt: We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our partner company, a healthcare technology platform used by clinics to manage scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and more.
raw.description:
We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Full-Stack Developer to join our partner company, a healthcare technology platform used by clinics to manage scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and more. In this role, you will ship features end to end, own production health, and build AI-powered capabilities that help clinic staff work smarter. The ideal candidate is passionate about writing clean, secure, and performant code, enjoys working directly with stakeholders, and is eager to raise the engineering bar for the whole team.

Excited? Let’s see what it takes 💛

What you will do:

  • Ship features end to end in Django/DRF, PostgreSQL, and React/TypeScript, covering scheduling, clinical records, invoicing, and reports;
  • Maintain the Playwright end-to-end test suite for both API and UI, keeping it green with the help of AI agents;
  • Build AI features, including an MCP server that gives AI agents per-user access to the platform and a staff assistant on AWS Bedrock with EU data residency;
  • Plan and ship releases, including scoping, QA sign-off, migration and deploy order, feature flags, and rollback;
  • Own production health across ECS services, RDS, Celery workers, and the real-time server, leading the fix and the post-mortem when something breaks;
  • Build and maintain the integrations clinics depend on: UAE health exchanges, Stripe, SMS, WhatsApp, email, imaging and 3D scans, and country-specific tax and invoicing rules;
  • Keep each clinic's data isolated and safe through multi-tenant access control, roles and permissions, and audit trails;
  • Keep the product fast by fixing N+1 queries, tuning slow endpoints and reports, and writing migrations that are safe on live data;
  • Work directly with stakeholders and clinics to clarify requests, demo completed work, and turn support tickets into root-cause fixes;
  • Mentor a middle developer and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, Jenkins pipelines, and Terraform.

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 5+ years of proven experience with Python/Django and PostgreSQL;
  • Hands-on experience with AWS, particularly ECS and RDS;
  • Confidence working with React;
  • Practical experience building products with AI/LLMs;
  • Familiarity with Jenkins, Bitbucket, and Jira;
  • Fluent English (B2 or higher), both written and spoken;
  • Ownership mindset with the ability to lead incident resolution, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and mentor others.

Will be a plus:

  • Experience with healthcare or clinical workflows;
  • Experience with integrations with government or healthcare systems.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Fixed schedule: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UAE time (GMT+4);
  • Opportunity to cooperate fully remotely;
  • Inclusive and international environment;
  • Compensation in USD;
  • Supportive management focused on your growth and long-term collaboration.

So if you are a proactive PythonFull-Stack Developer who loves owning products end to end, building meaningful AI features, and making a real impact on healthcare — grab the chance to collaborate with us and send your CV in English 💛

raw.excerpt: About Dynamo AI Dynamo AI helps enterprises deploy AI systems that are reliable, secure, and production-ready.
raw.description:
About Dynamo AI

Dynamo AI helps enterprises deploy AI systems that are reliable, secure, and production-ready. Our market-leading technical controls span AI evaluations, guardrails, agentic risk management, and observability. Backed by world-class talent, we partner with innovative, highly-regulated global organizations — across financial services, government, and beyond — to deploy meaningful AI use cases at scale, securely and compliantly.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, scale, and operate the infrastructure powering our AI platform. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. We are looking for someone who can work independently, solve complex infrastructure problems, and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment. You should be comfortable designing systems, automating processes, troubleshooting production issues, and continuously improving reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.

What You'll Own

  • Design, build, and operate highly available production infrastructure on AWS, with strong expertise in EKS, EC2, VPC, S3, RDS/Aurora, IAM, ECR, ElastiCache, Load Balancers, and other core AWS services.
  • Build and improve CI/CD and release automation using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Helm, ArgoCD, and GitOps.
  • Manage infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code principles.
  • Build and operate Kubernetes platforms at production scale, including cluster management, upgrades, autoscaling, networking, security, and troubleshooting.
  • Run and operate AI/ML workloads in production, with a strong understanding of the infrastructure challenges associated with AI systems.
  • Deploy, scale, monitor, and optimize AI inference and model-serving workloads across Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.
  • Work with GPU-based workloads, including GPU scheduling, utilization, autoscaling, capacity planning, and optimization.
  • Drive infrastructure efficiency by balancing performance, reliability, scalability, and cost across AI workloads.
  • Own monitoring, logging, and observability using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Thanos, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Implement secure secrets management using technologies such as HashiCorp Vault and External Secrets Operator.
  • Develop automation and internal tooling using Python and Bash.
  • Drive improvements around reliability, security, scalability, performance, and infrastructure cost.
  • Participate in production incidents, root-cause analysis, and drive long-term fixes rather than short-term workarounds.
  • Work closely with Engineering, ML/AI, Security, and Product teams to solve infrastructure and platform challenges.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of strong hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Strong production experience with AWS and Kubernetes/EKS.
  • Proven experience running AI/ML workloads or GPU-based workloads in production is highly valuable.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, observability, and cloud security.
  • Excellent scripting and automation skills in Python and Bash.
  • Experience operating production systems and troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues independently.
  • Strong understanding of scaling, performance optimization, resource utilization, and cost management, particularly for compute-intensive workloads.
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to take a problem from design to production.
  • Experience working in a startup or fast-moving engineering environment is highly valued.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI inference platforms, model serving, LLM infrastructure, or ML platforms.
  • Experience with GPU infrastructure such as NVIDIA GPUs and Kubernetes GPU scheduling.
  • Experience with multi-region or highly distributed systems.
  • Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or other security/compliance requirements.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, or similar distributed systems.

The Kind of Engineer We Want

We're looking for someone who builds, automates, and takes ownership — not someone who simply operates existing infrastructure.

You should be comfortable with ambiguity, willing to dive deep into production problems, and constantly looking for ways to make our platform more reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Most importantly, you should understand that AI infrastructure has a different set of operational challenges. We want someone who can help us run AI systems efficiently at scale — making the right trade-offs between GPU utilization, performance, reliability, scalability, and cost.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to make a meaningful impact on the infrastructure behind an AI platform as we scale.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Director, Behavioral Economics will lead high-priority analytic, causal inference, and behavioral insights strategy work to improve outcomes, close care gaps, and strengthen enterprise decision-making. This role will be responsible for translating business priorities into rigorous measurement strategies, actionable insights and scalable decision framework that inform program design, outreach strategy, and operational investment decisions.
The Associate Director, Behavioral Economics will report to the Director, Behavioral Economics. You will help build durable team capabilities in causal inference, information science, and measurement frameworks. You will manage the team portfolio and associated outputs to ensure work is prioritized, coordinated, and delivered against the highest-value business needs. You will partner closely with cross-enterprise business owners to elevate information required for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Measurement Strategy and Causal Inference



  • Lead the design of rigorous measurement strategies for team portfolio of pilots, programs, and enterprise initiatives. Assess when causal inference is possible, when directional or descriptive measurement is more appropriate, and how to clearly communicate what information we can infer as well as what the remaining unknowns and their implications are.
  • Empower team to partner with cross-functional partners to ensure study designs, data requirements, outcome definitions, and reporting approaches are aligned.
  • Develop scalable approaches to evaluate intervention effectiveness and translate complex analytic concepts into practical guidance for senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Monitor pilot execution in partnership with operational teams and identify issues that could affect measurement validity or business interpretation. Synthesize pilot results into clear recommendations on whether to scale, refine, continue testing, or discontinue an intervention.


Team Leadership and Capability Building



  • Lead, coach, and develop team members to produce measurement plans with clear hypotheses, measurable outcomes, operational feasibility, and scalability in mind.
  • Build reusable tools, templates, playbooks, and operating rhythms that improve consistency and quality across the team's work.
  • Support onboarding and upskilling of team members in causal inference, pilot design, behavioral economics, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
  • Foster a team culture grounded in intellectual rigor, curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and practical business impact.
  • Help prioritize the portfolio of team work to ensure resources are focused on the highest-value opportunities.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications



  • Master's degree or PhD in economics, statistics, applied math, business analytics, psychology, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3 or more years of experience in causal inference evaluations and driving judgment by balancing rigor, feasibility, speed, and business relevance.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytic or measurement plans. Experience operationalizing the plans to inform decisions while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations.
  • Team development experience.


Preferred Qualifications



  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience in Medicare Advantage, or healthcare operations data.
  • People leadership experience.


Additional Information



This is a remote position.

Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. 40

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Job Description

Job Summary
CDW is seeking an Account Executive (AE), to work in cross functional teams. This mid-level position is responsible for driving sales in a specialized portfolio of clients. You must possess a high need to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders. The AE demands strong account management skills, including Supplier Diversity, RFx, VPAs, EDI/Epro. Working as an AE you will demonstrate a deep understanding of CDW's technology solutions and a consultative approach to sales. As an AE you are expected to not only drive new business, but also expand and deepen relationships with existing clients by offering strategic, customized solutions. The AE will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, including marketing, product teams, and delivery managers, to tailor solutions that align with clients’ business objectives.

What you will do:

  • Develop and execute sales strategies to drive revenue growth and expand the client base, focusing on both new and existing accounts.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers within customer organizations, often at the senior and C-level.
  • Leverage consultative sales techniques to assess client needs and propose comprehensive solutions, including cross-selling CDW’s products and services.
  • Prioritizing Accounts and Opportunities: Independently assess our book of business using key criteria such as customer potential, competitive advantage, relationship depth, and strategic alignment. Work with sales leadership to balance short-term targets with long-term growth potential, identifying underpenetrated areas within key accounts.
  • Developing an Account Strategy: Execute account strategies by setting clear objectives, aligning with customer priorities, and identifying tactical plays. Collaborate with solution architects and principal AEs to develop scalable plans that anticipate risk and include measurable success metrics.
  • Time-Constrained Discovery: Lead discovery conversations by identifying key business needs, defining success criteria, and gathering relevant insights. Must articulate the value of discovery, actively listening to the stakeholder's input, and respecting time constraints to ensure productive and respectful interactions.
  • Aligning to the Customer’s Buying Cycle: Guide your customers through the buying cycle by understanding internal processes, and timeline constraints, augmenting your approach as needed. As a consultant, you will maintain forward momentum while addressing risks and objections collaboratively.
  • Conveying Value: Build credibility through subject matter knowledge, account insight, and personalized solution positioning. Be able to connect customer centric outcomes with CDW’s capabilities. Validate mutual business understanding, defining affected priorities, engaging in discussions about the value of the offering, and establishing clear impact measurement metrics.
  • Managing Stakeholders: Proactively engage across organizations. Tailor your communications based on role, and responsibility while balancing stakeholder and seller interests, re-validating stakeholder interests, tailoring the value message to individual stakeholders, and collaboratively co-creating a solution are essential steps for building meaningful and successful relationships.

What we expect of you:

  • A minimum of 2-5 years of direct selling experience in a customer-facing sales environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM-related field, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience
  • General understanding of key technologies, including but not limited to Cisco, Microsoft, IBM, EMC, and HP, as well as competitive equivalents.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proven sales expertise, with a demonstrated ability to meet targets and inspire enthusiasm in the sales process.
  • Strong strategic planning, time management, and organizational skills, with a keen attention to detail.

About Reputation

Reputation, founded in Silicon Valley in 2013, is the industry's sole platform that uses an AI-powered product stack to help companies measure, manage, and scale their real-time reputation performance everywhere, effectively functioning as a business's eyes and ears across all customer feedback channels to uncover predictive insights. This market leadership is reinforced by significant funding from top-tier firms like Bessemer Venture Partner, Kleiner Perkins, and Marlin Equity Partners, driving substantial annual recurring revenue from Global Fortune 1000 companies, major automotive OEMs, healthcare systems, and top property management firms, with trust from over 250 partners including Google and Meta. Recognized recently as America’s Greatest Midsized Workplaces by Newsweek which rewards excellence and career development, and attracts player-coaches, team-oriented collaborators, and individuals who value perseverance and hustle.


Your Role at Reputation

Reputation is seeking a Financial Analyst to join our FP&A team on a remote contract basis. This role will support key financial planning and analysis activities across the business, including forecasting, budgeting, headcount tracking, and sales compensation analysis.


The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable partnering with business leaders to turn financial data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. This position reports to the Director of Finance Operations and will work closely with Finance and cross-functional business partners.


How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Support financial forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and operational metrics tracking
  • Analyze financial data and build financial models to support business decisions
  • Prepare financial summaries, reports, and presentations for business partners and executive leadership
  • Partner with business and operational leaders to provide financial insights and support decision-making
  • Analyze trends, forecasts, and business performance and recommend opportunities for optimization
  • Support key initiatives related to cost savings, efficiency, and financial improvement
  • Reconcile financial transactions and identify and correct data discrepancies
  • Support headcount tracking, sales compensation analysis, and other FP&A activities as needed
  • Take on additional financial analysis and reporting projects as assigned

The Skills That Set You Apart

  • Typically requires undergraduate degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field and 5+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience with Workday, Adaptive Planning/Adaptive Insights, and OfficeConnect highly desirable
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills
  • Experience working with financial data, forecasting, and reporting
  • SaaS experience preferred, but not required
  • Salesforce experience is a plus
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
  • Excellent data gathering, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a remote environment
  • Self-directed, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Become a part of our caring community

The Associate Director, Behavioral Economics will lead high-priority analytic, causal inference, and behavioral insights strategy work to improve outcomes, close care gaps, and strengthen enterprise decision-making. This role will be responsible for translating business priorities into rigorous measurement strategies, actionable insights and scalable decision framework that inform program design, outreach strategy, and operational investment decisions.
The Associate Director, Behavioral Economics will report to the Director, Behavioral Economics. You will help build durable team capabilities in causal inference, information science, and measurement frameworks. You will manage the team portfolio and associated outputs to ensure work is prioritized, coordinated, and delivered against the highest-value business needs. You will partner closely with cross-enterprise business owners to elevate information required for decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Measurement Strategy and Causal Inference



  • Lead the design of rigorous measurement strategies for team portfolio of pilots, programs, and enterprise initiatives. Assess when causal inference is possible, when directional or descriptive measurement is more appropriate, and how to clearly communicate what information we can infer as well as what the remaining unknowns and their implications are.
  • Empower team to partner with cross-functional partners to ensure study designs, data requirements, outcome definitions, and reporting approaches are aligned.
  • Develop scalable approaches to evaluate intervention effectiveness and translate complex analytic concepts into practical guidance for senior leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Monitor pilot execution in partnership with operational teams and identify issues that could affect measurement validity or business interpretation. Synthesize pilot results into clear recommendations on whether to scale, refine, continue testing, or discontinue an intervention.


Team Leadership and Capability Building



  • Lead, coach, and develop team members to produce measurement plans with clear hypotheses, measurable outcomes, operational feasibility, and scalability in mind.
  • Build reusable tools, templates, playbooks, and operating rhythms that improve consistency and quality across the team's work.
  • Support onboarding and upskilling of team members in causal inference, pilot design, behavioral economics, stakeholder management, and executive communication.
  • Foster a team culture grounded in intellectual rigor, curiosity, ownership, collaboration, and practical business impact.
  • Help prioritize the portfolio of team work to ensure resources are focused on the highest-value opportunities.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications



  • Master's degree or PhD in economics, statistics, applied math, business analytics, psychology, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3 or more years of experience in causal inference evaluations and driving judgment by balancing rigor, feasibility, speed, and business relevance.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business problems into structured analytic or measurement plans. Experience operationalizing the plans to inform decisions while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
  • Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations.
  • Team development experience.


Preferred Qualifications



  • Experience partnering with cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience in Medicare Advantage, or healthcare operations data.
  • People leadership experience.

This is a remote position.

This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 10-29-2026

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

Job Description

Job Summary
CDW is seeking an Account Executive (AE), to work in cross functional teams. This mid-level position is responsible for driving sales in a specialized portfolio of clients. You must possess a high need to collaborate with internal and external stakeholders. The AE demands strong account management skills, including Supplier Diversity, RFx, VPAs, EDI/Epro. Working as an AE you will demonstrate a deep understanding of CDW's technology solutions and a consultative approach to sales. As an AE you are expected to not only drive new business, but also expand and deepen relationships with existing clients by offering strategic, customized solutions. The AE will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, including marketing, product teams, and delivery managers, to tailor solutions that align with clients’ business objectives.

What you will do:

  • Develop and execute sales strategies to drive revenue growth and expand the client base, focusing on both new and existing accounts.
  • Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers within customer organizations, often at the senior and C-level.
  • Leverage consultative sales techniques to assess client needs and propose comprehensive solutions, including cross-selling CDW’s products and services.
  • Prioritizing Accounts and Opportunities: Independently assess our book of business using key criteria such as customer potential, competitive advantage, relationship depth, and strategic alignment. Work with sales leadership to balance short-term targets with long-term growth potential, identifying underpenetrated areas within key accounts.
  • Developing an Account Strategy: Execute account strategies by setting clear objectives, aligning with customer priorities, and identifying tactical plays. Collaborate with solution architects and principal AEs to develop scalable plans that anticipate risk and include measurable success metrics.
  • Time-Constrained Discovery: Lead discovery conversations by identifying key business needs, defining success criteria, and gathering relevant insights. Must articulate the value of discovery, actively listening to the stakeholder's input, and respecting time constraints to ensure productive and respectful interactions.
  • Aligning to the Customer’s Buying Cycle: Guide your customers through the buying cycle by understanding internal processes, and timeline constraints, augmenting your approach as needed. As a consultant, you will maintain forward momentum while addressing risks and objections collaboratively.

  • Managing Stakeholders: Proactively engage across organizations. Tailor your communications based on role, and responsibility while balancing stakeholder and seller interests, re-validating stakeholder interests, tailoring the value message to individual stakeholders, and collaboratively co-creating a solution are essential steps for building meaningful and successful relationships.

raw.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Mobile & Web
raw.excerpt: At MoneyGram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech-forward, growth driven culture.
raw.description:
At MoneyGram, we're combining the strength of a trusted global brand with the agility of a tech-forward, growth driven culture. With 85+ years of experience and a presence in more than 200 countries and territories, we've built a foundation of stability and trust to help millions of people around the world send funds quickly, securely, and affordably. We're looking for bold thinkers, builders, technologists, and sellers who want real ownership of their work, thrive in collaborative environments, and are energized by solving complex challenges. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a measurable impact - fast. If you're eager to shape the future of cross-border payments and financial services, join us as we transform how the world moves money.

Senior Full Stack Engineer, Mobile & Web Location: Remote, Germany or Portugal About the role MoneyGram is being refounded. Nearly half a million cash locations across 200+ countries, built over decades. Five times the footprint of McDonald's, Burger King and Starbucks combined. Over $150 billion moving through it a year. Nobody building crypto payments can buy that. Now we're wiring it into the rails money is moving onto. This past year: multi-chain, billions on chain, our own stablecoin, cash off-ramp for platforms like Kraken. Next is a stablecoin-powered balance account for millions of people worldwide. Most of the industry builds digital money for people who already have good banking. We're building it for everyone else. You'd join the small team building it. Startup pace, decades of infrastructure underneath you. What you'll do

  • Build features end to end. From the React Native screen a recipient taps to the Spring Boot service behind it. You'll own vertical slices, not layers.
  • Lead on mobile and web. The client experience is where this product lives or dies. We want someone whose frontend work is a genuine strength, not the half of the stack they tolerate.
  • Launch new markets, and make each one cheaper than the last. Every country brings its own regulatory, payout and localization requirements, and today each launch takes heavy manual work. You'll ship these launches, then build the tooling so the tenth doesn't cost as much as the first.
  • Work on the money path. Balances, ledgers, transfers, reconciliation. Getting this right when things fail halfway is the hard part of the job, and we treat it that way.
  • Integrate with systems you don't control. Payout partners, KYC vendors, card issuers, internal platforms in varying states of modernization. Designing sane contracts across messy boundaries is core to the work.
  • Invest in the platform. Automated testing, alerting, wallet recovery, KYC flows. We've deferred more of this than we'd like. You'll help us stop.

Operate what you build. Deployment, monitoring, on-call, root cause analysis, with the autonomy and the responsibility that come with it. What we're looking for

  • 7+ years building and shipping production software, with real depth across the stack
  • Strong React and React Native. You've shipped and maintained a production mobile app, you're fluent in TypeScript, and you build interfaces that hold up on low-end devices and poor connections
  • Solid backend engineering in Java and Spring Boot, or comparable experience and the appetite to pick them up quickly
  • RESTful API design, relational data modeling, and familiarity with distributed systems failure modes
  • Automated testing and CI/CD as a default habit rather than a separate task
  • Comfort in and around legacy systems, refactoring incrementally alongside code you didn't write
  • Genuine interest in the product, not only the implementation. You ask who this is for and what happens after launch.
  • Ability to operate with limited direction in a small, fast-moving team
  • We'd rather hire someone with four of these and obvious range than someone who ticks every box and works in one lane. If you're close, apply.

Nice to have

  • Payments or fintech at scale: ledgering, reconciliation, KYC/AML, PCI, chargebacks
  • Crypto, stablecoins or blockchain payment rails, including wallet and custody infrastructure and smart contracts
  • Native iOS or Android alongside React Native

Our stack

  • React Native and React, TypeScript, Java and Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Couchbase, Amazon EKS, OAuth 2.0 and JWT. You don't need all of it on day one.

How we work

  • Startup culture inside a global company. Small team, short path from idea to production, very little process for its own sake. Product decisions happen in conversation with engineers, not upstream of them. More influence than headcount alone would suggest, and less scaffolding than a large organization usually provides.
  • Remote from Germany or Portugal, with flexible hours. No relocation, no office expectation. You'll need the existing right to work in one of the two.
  • We work with teams on US East Coast time, five to six hours behind you. Your afternoons are the collaborative part of the day and your mornings are yours. We default to written communication and asynchronous decisions.
  • You'll own outcomes, not tickets. You'll instrument what you ship and care what the numbers say afterward. Cash-to-balance conversion is one of our biggest growth levers and needs someone who'll find where users drop off.
  • Greenfield and legacy, honestly. Some of this you'll build from nothing. Some is a decade old and carries real money. We won't pretend otherwise in the interview.

Timeline We aim to move from first call to decision within 7 to 10 days, and we'll give you a clear answer either way.

Here are some reasons why you will love working here :

  • Voluntary Pension Program - Retirement savings plan with employer subsidy for eligible employees (subject to plan terms and conditions)
  • Life and Accident Insurance - Employer-funded life insurance coverage for eligible employees
  • Community Service Days - Paid time off for eligible employees to volunteer in their communities
  • Tuition Reimbursement - Educational assistance program for eligible employees (subject to program guidelines and approval)
  • Transfer Fee Reimbursement - Smooth transitions with reimbursement for any transfer-related fees. We’ve got you covered.
  • Employee Assistance Program - Confidential counseling and support services for eligible employees
  • Employee Referral Program - Incentive program for employee referrals (subject to program terms)
  • Remote work flexibility - Available for eligible roles with hybrid or remote work options

About MoneyGram :

MoneyGram is a global payments network built to move money across borders with speed, simplicity and trust. Its omnichannel platform empowers consumers, developers and agents to transfer cash, fiat and stablecoin however it works best for them. The company serves over 60 million customers a year across 200+ countries and territories, nearly half a million retail locations and a rapidly expanding digital ecosystem reaching billions of devices. As one of the most recognized and trusted names in global payments, MoneyGram continues to reinvent how money moves - helping people around the world support their loved ones and build better futures.

Success in this role requires a proactive, self-starting mindset, strong communication skills, and a relentless drive to achieve results. You take ownership of your goals, hold yourself accountable to high standards, and are motivated by creating new opportunities that fuel the broader success of the business.

  • Proven success in a client-facing sales role, with the ability to build trust and drive outcomes

Working at Opus 2

Opus 2 is a global leader in LegalTech, creating solutions to drive digital transformation in the industry. We are a trusted partner of the world’s leading legal teams with 98 percent of the world’s 50 largest law firms using Opus 2.

Our solutions help optimize the performance, efficiency, and reliability of turbomachinery systems across a variety of industrial sectors.

  • Master’s Degree in Automation and Control Engineering or Mechanical Engineering
  • Five years experience in rotating equipment control systems as SME (Subject Matter Expert) or related field or related experience and/or equivalent combination of education and experience

raw.title: Remote Operations Centre Engineer - M/LWD
raw.excerpt: Job Overview:The primary responsibility of the ROC – M/LWD is to monitor the DS jobs utilizing his/her skills, experience, and available ROC hardware and software resources.
raw.description:
Job Overview:

The primary responsibility of the ROC – M/LWD is to monitor the DS jobs utilizing his/her skills, experience, and available ROC hardware and software resources. The ROC – M/LWD is the first point of contact, for M/LWD technical support, for the field personnel. The ROC – M/LWD should timely identify the job-related risks and hazards; and intervene to prevent equipment failures and non-productive time. The ROC – M/LWD shall seek the Subject Matter Expert (SME) support for complex and critical problems to provide an adequate and timely solution. Follows the corresponding steps of the Drilling Engineering process.

Responsibilities:

  • Must know and comply with the ROC Standard and approved local Appendices.
  • Follow the drilling engineering “Rules to live by”.
  • Comply with standards, internal processes, drilling instructions and operational procedures during the job planning and execution phases.
  • Establish and maintain constant communication with in-line management.
  • Participate in all ROC pre-job meetings.
  • Ensure remote-control application screens are connected or ready to be connected. (in situations of low field bandwidth) (TV lagging Field System).
  • Utilize the relevant job experience in troubleshooting any change in scope operations.
  • In case of the incident the ROC M/LWD must follow approved local incident/ event management process and establish the communication with management. The local incident / event management (OEPS Document – ROC Event Management Process) shall comply with ROC standard. If local incident / event management process is not established, follow the RTOC Standard (2.3.2 Incident Management Process).
  • Follow approved intervention process to provide the assistance with operations when required.
  • The ROC M/LWD has the full authority to STOP the job if current rig operation leads to Quality or HSE incidents.
  • Should perform pre-run paperwork / programming verification. The Field Engineers to submit to ROC M/LWD on duty pre-run programming for all runs to be QC’d by RTOC.
  • Shall validate the proper GeoMag Reference Input in Spectrum Navigator for each MWD run.
  • Perform TFO Spectrum verification.
  • The ROC M/LWD must establish the communication with M/LWD at the rig site and provide the verbal or written confirmation on TFO value and TFO measurement procedure before running the BHA below the rotary table. The Field Engineers must submit the necessary pre-run TFO paperwork to ROC M/LWD on tour. FOM to be included on insufficient submission email reply.
  • Monitor all jobs in the Geozone in real time via approved remote-control application, WITSML streaming and /or WITSML LWD submissions. The designated high-profile jobs require closer attention to ensure the rig crew follows the proper procedures and instructions. In instance of high-profile / high-complexity jobs the well data access is requested from RTDS and the field crew is required to enable WTSML communication/ streaming. If the direct WITSML data streaming is not available, third party EDR (Electronic Data Recorder) access to be requested with appropriate mnemonics for WITSML data streaming.
  • Deliver a quick update reports on rig related issue to relevant personnel.
  • The update report to include Out of Specification (OOS) conditions encountered / mitigation employed / troubleshooting attempted / component issue. (directional drilling, hydraulics, controller etc.).
  • Responsible for ensuring that operational specifications (limits) of the downhole DD/LWD tools are not exceeded.
  • Quality Check CORE submission and upload to Reliability. The Field Engineers to submit CORE files post-run and post-well to ROC M/LWD on tower. Any insufficient CORE submissions to be sent back to field and FOM / PLM to be included.
  • The JAR file generation is not direct responsibility of ROC M/LWD. The ROC M/LWD should help with JAR file generation when possible and doesn’t interfere with direct responsibilities. JAR files to be initially completed by FOM as per job call out / load out. Field Engineers to submit to FOM any requests for JAR files while job is ongoing.
  • Field Email Submission Integrity – ROC M/LWD to ensure compliance with field submission emails. (ex. Subject nomenclature)
  • In conjunction with Technical Alerts the RTOC M/LWD to be central point in collecting/ uploading all required failure submissions and posting to designated database in correct format. Any issues with gathering information to be brought to FOM’s attention via email.
  • Proactively support the field personnel to ensure that operational specifications (limits) of the downhole M/LWD tools are not exceeded.
  • Conduct RTOC self-audits in their districts, report findings to the ROC Manager, and actively follow up to complete audit’s corrective actions.
  • Perform various duties and activities as assigned by supervisor within the physical constraints of the job.
  • Demonstrate a personal commitment to Quality, Health, Safety and the Environment:
    • Maintain a safe and healthy workplace for all employees
    • Enforce all safety precautions and practices
    • Promote the safe work practices
    • Always attend a mandatory safety meeting and maintain Company property and equipment in safe operating conditions
  • Know and understand Weatherford’s Enterprise Excellence Process and the Quality Policy and comply with all requirements of the Quality Systems Manual, Operating and Technical Procedures and Workplace Instructions.
  • Must understand and comply with all safety rules and company policies of Weatherford.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in M/LWD operations
  • Thorough knowledge of Drilling Systems products and services
  • Bachelor’s degree in oil and gas related technical discipline – Electrical, Instrumentation, Petroleum Engineering
  • English proficiency at advanced level

Skills:

  • Demonstrate the knowledge of anti-collision analysis
  • Experience and ability to solve problems and perform with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to use multiple sources of data to formulate, test, and verify failure modes in M/LWD and relative surface equipment
  • Familiarity with the different forms of vibration encountered while drilling
  • Complete the Measurement Academy class -certificate, level
  • Have sufficient experience with M/LWD tools used in Geozone to provide adequate technical support to field personnel.
  • Submit the Valid AC101 certificate
  • Competent with Microsoft Office
  • Basic skills of the latest Weatherford software necessary to perform daily tasks
  • Excellent communication, organization, troubleshooting and teamwork skills. Positive attitude and a high degree of self-discipline and motivation
  • Able to relate to rig-site personnel at all levels.
  • Experiences with Rotary Steerable tools / Mud Motors

raw.description:
As our Junior Compliance Analyst, you will act as the crucial link between our day-to-day business activities and regulatory governance. Working closely with the Head of Compliance & Regulatory, you will translate platform architectures, technical controls, and operational processes into structured, audit-ready compliance evidence

. Your daily responsibilities will centre on:

  • Audit Readiness & Evidence Management: Collecting and organising technical control evidence across core security and regulatory frameworks, including ISO 27001, HIPAA, and PCI DSS.
  • Security & Vulnerability Coordination: Liaising with internal technical teams to track vulnerability remediations, schedule periodic penetration testing, and coordinate regular user access reviews.
  • Customer RFIs & Security Questionnaires: Assisting with the completion and timely submission of customer security questionnaires, vendor assessments, and technical Request for Information (RFI) documents.
  • Technical Incident Support: Supporting the compliance team during technical security incidents by capturing technical details and feed them into data breach assessment workflows and regulatory reporting timelines.
  • Compliance & Risk Tracking: Maintaining governance records, administrative filings, risk registers, and standard operating procedures, whilst supporting the rollout of internal security training

Requirements

  • Strong Communicator & Translator: Ability to communicate effectively with technical software engineers and translate complex technical security concepts into clear, formal compliance documentation.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: Exceptional organisation, documentation, and record-keeping skills with an analytical mindset.
  • Collaborative Partner: Proven ability to build positive working relationships across internal business, technical, and compliance teams.
  • Curious & Eager to Learn: A strong desire to continuously learn and develop hands-on exposure across information security, data protection, and cloud governance frameworks.

Essential Requirements

  • Educational Background or Equivalent: A formal qualification (such as a degree, diploma, or certification) in Data Protection, Cybersecurity, Law/GRC, or demonstrable equivalent practical experience in a similar role.
  • Security Fundamentals: A foundational, structured understanding of IT systems, information security principles, and cloud architectures
  • Evidence Collection Experience: Direct experience or a clear understanding of how to collect, verify, and organise technical compliance evidence (such as system logs or configurations) within organised repositories (such as Confluence or SharePoint).

Our Recruitment Process

Thank you for your interest in joining the Natterbox team. We believe in transparency, structured feedback, and human-centred communication. Below is a clear outline of what you can expect during your candidate journey with us.

Our Communication Commitment

We respect the time and effort it takes to submit an application. All applicants will receive a response from us.

Please note: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual, personalised feedback at the initial CV review stage.

Stage 1: Initial CV Review

Our People Team carefully reviews every CV against the core competencies and technical requirements of the role.

Stage 2: People Team Interview (30 Minutes)

If your application matches our criteria, you will be invited to a 30-minute introductory call with a member of our People Team.

  • What to expect: This is a two-way conversation to review your CV, discuss your background, and talk through how your skills and experience align with the role.

Stage 3: Department Manager

Candidates progressing to the next round will have a focused call with the Department Head.

  • What to expect: A deeper discussion into the practical, day-to-day elements of the role, your technical diagnostics approach, and how you tackle customer support challenges.

Stage 4: Competency Stage Interview

What to expect: We will give you the details prior to your interview.

Stage 5: Final Executive Review

The final stage is a call with a member of our Executive Team.

  • What to expect: A high-level conversation focused on long-term career growth, alignment with Natterbox values, and our overall company vision.

🤖 Important Note on the Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

We encourage our candidates to embrace modern tools and work smart.

  • What is acceptable: It is completely fine to use generative AI (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or spelling/grammar assistants) to help refine, format, or polish your CV structure and application answers.
  • What is not acceptable: We strictly ask that you do not use AI to generate or write answers on your behalf.

We value authenticity, genuine communication, and real problem-solving. Our multi-stage interview process is designed to deeply assess your individual skills and unique technical approach. Relying on AI to answer on your behalf during the application stages creates a disconnect during live conversations, and ultimately prevents us from getting to know the real you. Please ensure all submitted answers reflect your own words and honest experience.

Benefits

We offer a range of benefits to all our employees.

  • Competitive base salary - £28,00-£32,000 - depending on experience
  • 25 days holiday increasing to 30 days after 2 years (plus bank holidays).
  • Access to Perkbox - Hundreds of handpicked retail discounts, wellness perks, and monthly freebies to support your lifestyle.
  • Auto enrol pension
  • Private Health care - after probation

Please note: Candidates are required to have the permanent Right to Work in the UK. We are unable to accept applications from candidates who do not possess this, and we cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  • Planejar e executar simulações de ataques baseadas em cenários reais e na Inteligência de Ameaças (CTI) relevante para o setor da empresa, utilizando o framework MITRE ATT&CK como base metodológica;

raw.description:
Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com.


The Impact You Will Make


Partner Data Manager (PDM) is Risepoint's centralized database for partner and program information. It is also the mechanism through which Partner Support updates and distributes partner-facing content and resources organization-wide, giving teams one source of truth and helping ensure consistent messaging across Risepoint and with prospective and current students.

As Risepoint's business grows more dependent on PDM, this role ensures PDM evolves deliberately: anticipating business needs, prioritizing the right improvements (including user experience), and powering the transformation initiatives the business has prioritized. You will lead the business direction and roadmap for PDM, translating broader business priorities and the needs of Partner Support, Finance, Marketing, and other teams into a clear, prioritized roadmap. You'll partner closely with Business Technology's Product Owner, who leads technical delivery, while you own the business case, priorities, and the team that keeps PDM running reliably day to day.

How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life

What You Will Do

  • Serve as the business owner for PDM, shaping its multi-year vision and translating Risepoint’s broader business and transformation priorities into a clear roadmap, priorities, and business requirements.
  • Represent the business voice in roadmap trade-off decisions when partnering with Business Technology.
  • Build and maintain a structured intake and prioritization process for enhancement requests, balancing transformation-critical work, UX improvements, compliance/audit needs, and operational fixes.
  • Develop business cases and value justifications (cost, risk, efficiency, user experience) for proposed PDM investments.
  • Identify UX friction points and data/functionality gaps across PDM users and champion improvements through the roadmap
  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for PDM within Partner Support, representing its capabilities, constraints, and roadmap to leadership.
  • Act as liaison to Business Technology on all PDM-related initiatives, escalating and resolving cross-functional roadblocks.
  • Maintain a cross-functional view of how PDM connects to adjacent systems and processes, anticipating ripple effects of a given change rather than evaluating each request in isolation.
  • Own post-release follow-through — checking that changes landed as intended, gathering feedback from affected teams, and feeding lessons learned back into how future changes are scoped and rolled out.

What Success Looks Like

  • A prioritized, business-aligned PDM roadmap is in place and jointly owned with Business Technology's Product Owner.
  • Enhancement requests move through a clear intake and prioritization process
  • Key UX pain points and data/functionality gaps for PDM users have been identified and are being actively addressed.
  • Major PDM releases land with minimal disruption because affected teams were identified, informed, and prepared in advance.
  • undefined
  • Percentage of roadmap items entering Business Technology's backlog with a validated business case, clear priority, and defined success criteria.
  • Breadth of cross-functional input into the roadmap — how many departments actively contribute needs and priorities each planning cycle.
  • Stakeholder confidence — feedback from department heads and business leaders that their needs are understood and genuinely reflected in the roadmap

What You’ll Bring to the Team

Experience That Matters Most


  • 8+ years of experience in business systems, enterprise application management, or product/program leadership, including 3+ years in a director-level or equivalent strategic leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a roadmap or product strategy for a business-critical system, ideally in partnership with a separate technical/IT product or delivery team.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including experience managing managers.
  • Experience with business case development, prioritization frameworks, and cross-functional stakeholder management at the executive level.

Experience That’s Great to Have

  • Higher education, ed-tech, or partner/affiliate-based business experience.
  • Experience supporting or leading organizational transformation initiatives involving technology systems.

Risepoint is an equal-opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce.
