Job Description Summary

As a member of the Global Transportation team, you will be part of an international organization that drives GE Aerospace’s transportation and logistics execution across a complex global supply chain. This role supports the business’s Clear to Build strategy by ensuring material flows reliably to meet engine build and delivery requirements. The position will report into the Inbound Control Tower, the team responsible for enabling Clear to Build through disciplined transportation execution, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.
This is a high-intensity, high-volume execution role with primary focus on international and domestic inbound routes into the United States, while supporting a broader global portfolio. Success in this role requires the ability to receive overnight handoffs, assess priorities quickly, structure the day, and drive actions to closure in a dynamic environment.
This role is ideal for someone with hands-on logistics experience, strong judgment, a bias for action, and the communication skills to engage stakeholders across transportation, customs, operations, suppliers, and internal customers. While process improvement is an important part of the role, the core need is consistent operational execution.

Preferred location: Ohio or Kentucky. Candidates located across the Eastern Time Zone may also be considered.

Job Description

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Execute Clear to Build transportation processes and standard work to transport, track, expedite, and deliver parts in support of engine build requirements.
  • Receive, interpret, and prioritize overnight handoffs, converting them into a clear daily execution plan with strong follow-through.
  • Manage a high volume of transportation activity and escalations, ensuring urgent issues are addressed with speed, accuracy, and discipline.
  • Identify and surface emerging inbound delivery risks, including both international and U.S. domestic shipment issues, and engage the appropriate stakeholders to drive resolution.
  • Serve as a transportation escalation point for execution issues affecting material availability, build readiness, and supply chain flow.
  • Develop practical logistics solutions to meet urgent or non-standard transportation requirements within a complex regional and global network.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of customs-related requirements for international shipments, partnering with customs and transportation teams to support compliant, efficient movement and minimize delays.
  • Coordinate closely with transportation providers, internal sourcing and fulfilment teams, and receiving facilities to maintain flow, resolve exceptions, and protect build readiness.
  • Partner closely with the Clear to Launch team to ensure alignment across inbound and outbound priorities, handoffs, escalation management, and end-to-end transportation execution.
  • Use supplier performance metrics, operational data, and transportation visibility tools to identify execution gaps and support improvements in cycle time, service, quality, and premium transportation performance.
  • Support process improvement initiatives while maintaining a strong day-to-day focus on execution, responsiveness, and service continuity.
  • Use AI, analytics, digital tools, and automation to improve decision making, transportation visibility, process discipline, data quality, continuous improvement, and cost performance.
  • Contribute to transportation quality and supplier performance improvement efforts by identifying recurring issues, supporting root cause analysis, and helping implement corrective actions.
  • Champion compliance with regulatory requirements, company policies and procedures, and EHS expectations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university (or a high school diploma/GED with a minimum 4 years of experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or material flow, including hands-on responsibility for transportation planning and operational execution across international and domestic shipment flows)
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or material flow, including hands-on responsibility for transportation planning and operational execution across international and domestic shipment flows

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience managing transportation suppliers across complex regional networks.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage stakeholders clearly, concisely, and with urgency.
  • Proven ability to prioritize effectively, manage multiple issues concurrently, and make sound decisions in a high-pressure environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to absorb handoffs, interpret operational needs, and structure work for effective daily execution.
  • Strong analytical and process-development capability.
  • Experience using data, metrics, and digital tools to manage performance and identify gaps.
  • Working knowledge of customs processes and documentation relevant to international transportation; expert-level customs knowledge is not required.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other digital tools used to support logistics operations.
  • Strong operational mindset with a focus on execution, responsiveness, and closure.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a high-intensity, high-volume, rapid-response environment.
  • Customer-focused and action-oriented, with the ability to balance urgency, compliance, service, and cost.
  • Strong problem-solving capability, including identifying themes, escalating risks, and supporting corrective actions.
  • Excellent organizational skills and discipline in managing competing priorities.
  • Continuous improvement mindset, with the ability to improve processes without losing focus on daily operational delivery.

GE Aerospace offers comprehensive benefits and programs to support your health and, along with programs like HealthAhead, your physical, emotional, financial and social wellbeing. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; access to a Health Coach from GE Aerospace; and the Employee Assistance Program, which provides 24/7 confidential assessment, counseling and referral services. Retirement benefits include the GE Aerospace Retirement Savings Plan, a 401(k) savings plan with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants. Other benefits include tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time-off for vacation or illness. ​

The base pay range for this position is 94,000.00 - 115,000.00 Annual. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus based on a percentage of your base salary/ commission based on the plan. This posting is expected to close on October 18th, 2026.

This role will require in-person attendance for New Hire Orientation on Day 1.

About LOVB (League One Volleyball):
League One Volleyball (LOVB) is reimagining women's sports. Launched in 2019, our company is a mission-led sports performance, training and media enterprise that will change the game of volleyball in the USA and empower new generations of female athletes.

It is a groundbreaking time for volleyball in the US with our historic triple Olympic Gold medals in Women's Indoor, Beach and Sitting Volleyball. Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. In this role, you will join a mission-driven, roll-up-your-sleeves team of innovators and builders who have come together to change the paradigm of professional volleyball and women’s sports.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Title: Senior Counsel - Pro League

Department Code & Name: 90412 - Legal Pro

FLSA Status: Exempt

Reports To: VP, Legal and Business Affairs

Location: Remote – New York City metro preferred but not required. Occasional travel to events and business-related meetings.

Job Summary:

The Senior Counsel will provide legal support across the LOVB Pro League, partnering with business and operational teams on commercial partnerships, marketing and intellectual property matters, league operations, and sporting matters. Reporting to the Vice President, Legal & Business Affairs, this role will draft and negotiate a broad range of commercial and operational agreements and provide practical guidance that supports business objectives while appropriately managing risk.

The ideal candidate brings strong commercial judgment, exceptional drafting and negotiation skills, and experience navigating the unique legal considerations of professional sports. Familiarity with privacy and data security laws and regulations is a plus.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Commercial Contracts & Business Operations:

  • Structure, draft and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including sponsorships, facility and venue agreements, procurement contracts, marketing and promotional agreements, ticketing agreements, technology licenses and service agreements.
  • Counsel internal teams regarding contractual rights, obligations, interpretations, and potential risks.
  • Partner with business and operations teams to provide practical, commercially minded legal guidance and support transactions and/or events through completion.
  • Manage and coordinate with outside counsel when specialized expertise or additional support is required.

Marketing, Intellectual Property & Consumer Matters:

  • Advise internal business and creative teams on advertising, marketing, and other consumer facing initiatives and materials, including sweepstakes, contests and giveaways, privacy/publicity/IP disclosures, data collection/processing/usage rules, and pre-publication review of promotional and creative materials.
  • Support the protection and appropriate use of league, team, athlete, partner, and third-party intellectual property.

League Operations:

  • Oversee legal aspects of data privacy and security initiatives.
  • Review, draft, negotiate and interpret a wide range of technology agreements.
  • Assist in developing, refining and interpreting league-wide policies, guidelines, templates, and other documents that promote consistency across teams.
  • Navigate league requirements, approval processes, and governance structures to counsel internal teams regarding rights, obligations and risks.
  • Support general corporate matters, special projects, and emerging legal or business priorities as needed.

Sporting:

  • Draft, review, and negotiate athlete, coach, and other sporting staff agreements as requested

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Strong commercial contract drafting and negotiation skills.
  • Knowledge of legal issues relevant to professional sports teams and leagues.
  • Strong business judgment and ability to balance legal risk with organizational objectives.
  • Familiarity with privacy and data security laws and regulations preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Proactive, responsive, collaborative, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Education and Experience:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school required.
  • Active and in-good-standing license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction required; New York licensure preferred.
  • 5+ years of relevant legal experience; experience at a national law firm preferred.
  • Legal experience working for, or on behalf of, a professional sports team or league required.

Personal Attributes:

  • Commercially minded and responsive to internal clients.
  • Proactive in seeking information and committed to deal follow-through.
  • Solutions-oriented with strong judgment and discretion.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a growing organization with evolving priorities.

Work Environment & Physical Requirements (Hybrid):

  • Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment and communicate through in-person, video, phone, and written channels.
  • Ability to operate a computer and utilize standard business and legal technology.
  • Periodic travel required for league events, meetings, and other business-related activities.
  • Occasional evening and weekend availability may be required based on business and event needs

JOB SUMMARY:

The Excess Liability Insurance Underwriter evaluates, selects, and prices excess and surplus (E&S) casualty risks within delegated underwriting authority. This is a technical carrier underwriting role focused on sound risk selection, disciplined pricing, portfolio profitability, and documentation quality across a broad range of target classes including contracting/wrap-up/project-specific risks, product liability, service classes, real estate, and institutional exposures. The underwriter works within the carrier’s underwriting guidelines and appetite to make binding decisions on new business, renewals, and endorsements.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

Sound Judgment & Underwriting Authority: Exercises disciplined analytical thinking to evaluate complex excess casualty risk exposures and make binding underwriting decisions within delegated authority limits. Balances risk quality with portfolio profitability.

Technical Underwriting Depth: Demonstrates strong command of excess and surplus lines casualty underwriting principles, coverage structures, attachment points, and pricing methodology across multiple target classes.

Portfolio & Market Awareness: Monitors loss trends, emerging risks, and E&S market conditions to proactively adjust underwriting strategies and maintain a profitable, disciplined book of business.

Broker & Carrier Collaboration: Builds and maintains effective working relationships with wholesale brokers and internal carrier teams. Communicates underwriting decisions clearly, including rationale for pricing, coverage structure, or declinations.

Attention to Detail & Documentation: Thoroughly reviews applications, loss history, and exposure data. Produces clear, accurate underwriting files that reflect sound decision-making and comply with carrier guidelines, surplus lines regulations, and audit standards.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

raw.title: Product Analyst
raw.excerpt: About Dynamo AI Dynamo AI builds the platform enterprises use to bring AI applications to production and keep them there.
raw.description:
About Dynamo AI

Dynamo AI builds the platform enterprises use to bring AI applications to production and keep them there. Our products cover risk assessment, evaluation, runtime guardrails and observability for generative AI and agentic systems. We work with enterprises in regulated industries, including financial services, insurance, healthcare and defense.

The Role

Our PMs each own a set of business problems, such as getting AI agents approved for production, reducing the effort legal and compliance teams spend on guardrails, or lowering the cost of running guardrails at scale. Almost every one of these problems depends on evidence: whether an approach works, how well, and at what cost. Product Analysts produce that evidence.

Working with the PM who owns a problem, you take a specific question within it and own the answer. You scope the question, design the experiment or prototype, define how success is measured, run the analysis, and come back with a recommendation the PM can act on. When building is faster than waiting, that includes standing up a quick tool with AI to test an idea. You may support several PMs as priorities shift.

Training and infrastructure code is handled by our engineering and research teams. Your contribution is experimental design, prototyping and analytical rigor.

What You Might Work On

  • Guardrail creation and upkeep: design and curate the data used to train and accept custom guardrails, keep labeling consistent as datasets grow, and measure whether updates made from production errors improve performance without regressions.
  • Control coverage: benchmark detection against new attack techniques, languages and modalities, and scope what closing each gap would take.
  • Evaluation evidence: assess whether synthetic evaluation and red-teaming data is faithful and diverse enough for customers' approvers to trust, and research new ways to evaluate AI applications and agents.
  • Cost and performance: compare guardrail and orchestration configurations on accuracy, latency and inference cost.
  • Alerting: prototype ways to aggregate and prioritize guardrail alerts, and measure their effect on the workload of security analysts.
  • Workflow prototypes: build and test prototypes of new workflows, such as how legal and compliance reviewers contribute to guardrail policies or how customers onboard an application on their own, and measure the time and effort they take.
  • Rapid tooling: build small custom tools with AI to validate a hypothesis or unblock the team.
  • Benchmarking and reporting: measure performance with standard classification metrics (FNR, FPR, precision, recall) and report what is working and what is not.

Growth Path

You will start on well-scoped questions and move to harder, more ambiguous ones. Over time you will build intuition for SLM training, guardrail orchestration, agent security and how controls fit into a full AI application, along with an understanding of how our customers make approval decisions. This is a track toward a Product Manager or senior technical product role.

Requirements

  • A degree with strong quantitative or analytical content. We are especially interested in less common backgrounds, such as physics, information or data theory, and business, alongside solid data analysis experience.
  • A clear, demonstrated framework for thinking through problems.
  • Good instincts for data, ML concepts, and what makes an experiment or metric trustworthy.
  • Python and pandas for working with data.
  • Interest in AI security or safety, and in adversarial thinking.
  • Attention to detail and clear writing, including the ability to turn results into a recommendation a PM can act on.

Nice to Have

  • ML coursework, or coursework or projects in statistics or NLP.
  • Reading or working proficiency in Japanese, Chinese or a European language.
  • SQL.
  • A habit of building small tools or scripts, including with AI assistants, to answer your own questions.
  • Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, security tooling, experimental design or annotation work.

Why Join Us

  • Produce the evidence behind product decisions across every Dynamo product.
  • Work on AI security and governance problems that enterprises are facing for the first time.
  • Grow toward a product role at a founder-led startup.
  • Competitive compensation, equity and benefits.

raw.description:
Veranex’s mission as an Innovation CRO is to improve patient outcomes by accelerating our clients’ innovations to market. As the world’s only end-to-end professional services firm focused on MedTech, we take clients’ Vision to Velocity through our comprehensive service portfolio, with expertise in human centered design and product development, preclinical and clinical research, regulatory affairs, and market access and reimbursement consulting.

The Veranex Clinical Operations team is a dynamic group of professionals providing regulatory, quality and clinical services for the medical device industry. Our team supports start-ups, mid-sized private companies, and the largest corporations at all stages of the product life cycle. We work across a broad spectrum of technologies and treatment modalities. Our clients develop both next-generation and paradigm-shifting devices. Our product exposure includes implantables, instruments (manual, laser, robotic, etc.), capital equipment, combination products, software as a medical device (SaMD), medical mobile apps, in vitro diagnostics and more

About This Role:

Veranex has an exciting opportunity to join our team as a Senior Clinical Research Associate to support our Clinical Operations team. The Sr. CRA will participate in the planning, development, and execution of clinical trials to evaluate the safety, effectiveness and performance of medical devices. Under management supervision, the Sr. CRA will monitor assigned clinical trials to ensure adherence to the clinical protocol, applicable regulations, and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) governing clinical studies. Location: Remote, US

What You Will Do:

  • Responsible for ensuring that study investigators and coordinators comply with the study protocol, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), Code of Federal Regulations (CFRs), and Institutional Review Board (IRB)/Ethics Committee (EC) requirements during clinical studies by training/guidance of investigators/research coordinators, conducting periodic on-site evaluations and follow-up of corrective actions
  • Acts as primary liaison to clinical sites.
  • Conducts site qualification visits, study start-up activities (essential document collection), site qualification visits, site initiation visits and training, monitoring visits for source data verification (reported study data are accurate, complete, and verifiable from source documents in the site’s medical records), and site close-out visits. Generates high-quality site qualification, initiation, monitoring, and close-out visit reports in timely manner (in accordance with the Clinical Monitoring Plan)
  • Contributes to protocol, informed consent, case report form (CRF) and study plan development as well as annual progress reports (APRs) and the clinical study report (CSR) at study conclusion to report the study results to FDA and other regulatory authorities
  • Ensures that the rights and well-being of human subjects are protected and confirms data quality/integrity by maintaining site compliance, reviewing adverse events and device deficiencies, reviewing data trending/metrics, reviewing audit reports, and implementing corrective actions as necessary
  • Supports maintenance of department SOPs and work instructions
  • Supports investigational device traceability including documentation for forecasting, shipping, receipt, and disposition.
  • Supports and maintains documentation of all clinical research activities in the study trial master file (TMF), e.g., monitoring reports, site correspondence, device inventory information.
  • Drives trial enrollment and identifies and communications potential and actual obstacles to enrollment.
  • Travel requirement: 25-50%

Qualifications:

Required skills:

  • Minimum of 5 years of directly related work experience or equivalent in clinical research, including work on medical device significant risk IDE trials and/or non-significant risk abbreviated IDE trials.
  • Must be able to work autonomously and as a member of a cross-functional team and meet high expectations and tight deadlines. May work on highly visible projects in high-pressure situations
  • Must have working knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), FDA regulations and IRB requirements.
  • Must have strong project management competencies and ability to work with high quality, reliability, and attention to detail.
  • Must have a strong level of professionalism, including verbal and written communication skills; and the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization, cross-functionally, and with clients/partners.
  • Must have proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint; as well as experience with electronic data capture (EDC) and electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) systems.
  • Experience interfacing successfully with physicians/clinical staff and familiarity with hospital/clinical environments
  • Familiarity with medical and anatomical terminology.
  • Ability and willingness to travel

Preferred:

  • BS or BA degree preferred; BS or BA in a relevant scientific discipline or related field also preferred.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard for race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity or gender expression), sexual orientation, parental or marital status, disability, age, status as a protected veteran, national, social, or ethnic origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Sustainability in the NHS

Course Developer and Skills Coach

Permanent, full-time | Remote within the UK
Salary: up to £37,500 per annum, dependent on experience

Start date: Available for an immediate start

Closing date: Monday 19th October

(We may close this advert early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. We encourage early applications.)

Bring your NHS experience into learning

Have you worked in the NHS and helped turn sustainability commitments into practical action? This is an opportunity to use that experience to shape relevant learning for NHS colleagues and support them as a Skills Coach.

Direct experience of working within the NHS is essential for this appointment. We will prioritise candidates who bring practical NHS sustainability, procurement or related operational experience, as this is the expertise we are looking to add to our team.

Join KnowledgeBrief

KnowledgeBrief is an apprenticeship and training provider helping people and organisations build the skills they need across business management. Our expertise spans leadership and management, digital, and business and professional services. Through apprenticeships, professional qualifications, workshops and coaching, we connect learning to real work, helping people make better decisions, lead change and improve organisational performance.

Our vision is a future where every organisation can turn learning into measurable performance through confident people, modern leadership and practical capability. We bring together specialist expertise, our own learning technology and personalised support to help people apply what they learn and make a meaningful difference in their roles.

We are a values-driven organisation: inspirational, innovative and authentic, with relationships at the heart of how we work. Joining KnowledgeBrief means being part of a team that values the joy of learning and cares about the impact we create for our learners, clients and each other.

About the Role

You will help adapt our established Level 4 Corporate Responsibility and Sustainability Practitioner apprenticeship for NHS and healthcare learners, then coach apprentices through the programme over the long term. Development is planned from early 2027, with a proposed spring launch.

The course framework and core curriculum are already in place. Working with the Curriculum Development and Sustainability teams, you will review the content through an NHS lens, adapting examples, workplace activities and evidence opportunities while preserving the apprenticeship standard and its knowledge, skills and behaviours.

Your understanding of NHS structures, local priorities and procurement arrangements will help learners apply the programme in their own trust, integrated care board or department. The role sits within Operations and reports to the Curriculum Team Leader.

You may currently work in NHS sustainability, procurement, estates, operations or management and be ready to move into learning and coaching. We will support you to develop your apprenticeship delivery and coaching skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and adapt learning cycles, workshops, case studies and workplace activities for different NHS settings, retaining existing content where it remains relevant.
  • Apply NHS sustainability, governance, budgets, commissioning and procurement knowledge to connect learning with employers’ Green Plans, contracts and improvement priorities.
  • Check NHS policy references and resources for accuracy, work to editorial standards and deadlines, and share your subject expertise with colleagues and employer partners.
  • Coach adult apprentices through individual learning plans, monthly one-to-one sessions and relevant workshops, adapting support to their roles and working patterns.
  • Monitor progress, provide developmental feedback and hold reviews with learners and line managers every 6–8 weeks; identify barriers early and agree practical support.
  • Help learners prepare for gateway and end-point assessment, maintain accurate progress and off-the-job learning records, and contribute to programme improvement.
  • Follow safeguarding, Prevent, equality, inclusion, funding and quality requirements, raising concerns promptly.

Interpersonal Fit

You will bring curiosity, clear communication and an approachable manner, building credibility with NHS colleagues at every level. We value people who take ownership, collaborate with stong working relationships, welcome feedback and share our commitment to the joy of learning, sustainable patient care, quality, safeguarding and inclusion.

Experience, Skills & Qualifications

Essential

  • Substantial first-hand experience working within an NHS trust, integrated care board or national NHS body in sustainability, procurement, estates and facilities, operations or management, with hands-on involvement in net zero or social value activity.
  • Experience preparing papers or business cases for senior leaders, boards or committees and managing budgets, resources or contracts within NHS governance requirements.
  • Understanding of NHS structures and governance, Green Plans, the 2040 and 2045 net zero targets, climate duties under the Health and Care Act 2022 and CQC Well-led expectations on environmental sustainability.
  • Knowledge of the Procurement Act 2023, Provider Selection Regime, NHS Net Zero Supplier Roadmap, supplier Carbon Reduction Plans and social value; an understanding of how procurement arrangements differ across NHS organisations and functions.
  • Awareness of sustainability across healthcare estates, energy, clinical waste, medicines, anaesthetic gases, travel, food, digital services and lower-carbon care pathways.
  • Understanding of corporate responsibility and sustainability, including ESG, sustainability frameworks, GHG Protocol scopes, reporting standards, stakeholder theory and risk management.
  • Ability to review and adapt learning materials, check credible evidence and meet deadlines; experience coaching, training or developing adults, facilitating workshops and giving feedback.
  • A relevant degree in health management, environmental management, sustainability, business or procurement, or equivalent professional experience; a teaching or training qualification such as the Level 3 Award in Education and Training, or willingness to achieve one.
  • Clear communication, confidence with online delivery, strong organisation and accurate record keeping; GCSE
  • English and Mathematics at grade C/4 or above, or an accepted equivalent.

Desirable

  • Experience in a Green Plan role, supporting a board-level net zero lead or working with healthcare suppliers on net zero commitments.
  • Familiarity with the Five Case Model, Core20PLUS5, NHS anchor institutions, the NHS 10 Year Health Plan, NHS charities, the NHS Social Value Playbook, Evergreen or SusQI.
  • Experience developing learning resources or delivering apprenticeships; relevant professional membership, assessor, CIPS, NHS leadership or project management qualifications; experience with learning platforms or e-portfolios.

Why Work With Us?

At KnowledgeBrief, we are committed to creating an environment where people feel supported, challenged, and able to grow.

You’ll benefit from:

  • 5.6 weeks’ annual leave
  • Access to our Employee Assistance Programme
  • Dedicated monthly CPD days on successful completion of probation
  • Two weeks’ paid time off over Christmas and New Year on successful completion of probation
  • Company sick pay on successful completion of probation
  • Opportunities to contribute to cross-team projects and organisational growth
  • A remote-first environment with opportunities to connect in person

Our Commitment to Safer Recruitment and Inclusion

KnowledgeBrief is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of learners, and all colleagues are expected to share this commitment.

Offers of employment are subject to pre-employment checks, including right to work, references, and DBS checks where appropriate.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all backgrounds. Reasonable adjustments are available throughout the recruitment process.

Application Process

Submit your CV, clearly highlighting your NHS employment experience and involvement in sustainability, procurement, net zero or social value activity.

  • Initial screening with the People & Culture Team
  • Interview stage(s) with the hiring team
  • Final decision and feedback

We aim to keep the process timely, transparent, and respectful of your experience.

Ready to Apply?

If you would like to use your NHS experience to help others learn and make a practical difference, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your CV and we will be in touch.

The Hiring Team

KnowledgeBrief

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

The Agentic Delivery Analyst Intern keeps Axiamatic's customer engagements organized, on schedule, and well documented. This person supports the Agentic Growth & Value Transformation Leads and the Head of Agentic Growth and Value Transformation across a portfolio of customer accounts. The work spans onboarding, delivery tracking, executive reporting, and value reviews.
This is a paid intern-to-hire role for a recent graduate who wants to learn enterprise delivery from the inside. You will sit in customer meetings, track commitments across our team and the customer's team, and turn delivery data into clear reports for executives. As you build judgment, you will take on more of the work yourself, including running smaller workstreams end to end. At the end of the internship, we will decide on conversion to the full-time Agentic Delivery Analyst role based on your performance against the criteria below.
We're looking for someone who is excited to learn quickly, and build without waiting for a playbook. You don't need to have all the answers. You just need curiosity and a willingness to dive in!

What you'll do

Delivery support and project management
  • Maintain project plans, roadmaps, and trackers for each assigned account, and keep them current after every customer touchpoint.
  • Track deadlines and action items across Axiamatic's Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), delivery leads, and customer stakeholders. Follow up when something slips.
  • Prepare agendas, take notes, and send clear follow-ups for kickoffs, working sessions, and steering committee meetings.
  • Help gather and document customer requirements during onboarding, so FDEs can configure agent solutions against a clear spec.
  • Help test and validate agent output before go-live, and log issues for the FDE team.

Reporting and value realization
  • Build the weekly and monthly status reports and executive dashboards that customers rely on for program visibility.
  • Track usage and adoption metrics for each account, and flag accounts that are falling behind to the delivery lead early.
  • Prepare the materials for quarterly business reviews (QBRs), including usage data, outcomes delivered, and open risks.
  • Help turn customer wins into case studies and proof points.

Operations and playbooks
  • Document repeatable processes, templates, and checklists so the team can deliver the same way across many accounts.
  • Keep account records, meeting notes, and delivery artifacts organized and easy for anyone on the team to find.
  • Use Axiamatic's own agentic tools in your daily work, and share feedback on what would make them better for delivery teams.
  • Note expansion signals you hear in customer meetings, such as new programs or business units, and pass them to the delivery lead and Account Executive.

Requirements

  • A bachelor's degree, completed in the last year or expected by the end of this term. Business, economics, information systems, engineering, or a related field is a plus.
  • Exceptional organization. You keep many moving pieces on track at once and nothing falls through the cracks.
  • A strong work ethic and drive. You take ownership, follow through without being chased, and look for the next thing to pick up.
  • Business sense. You understand how a company makes money and why a project matters to the executive paying for it.
  • Professional presence. You communicate clearly and confidently in writing and in meetings, including with senior customer stakeholders.
  • Strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets and PowerPoint or Google Slides. You can turn raw data into a clean chart or summary.
  • Curiosity about AI and agentic tools, and a willingness to learn new software quickly.
  • Coachability. You ask for feedback, act on it, and adapt as our playbooks evolve.

Nice to have
  • An internship in consulting, project management, operations, customer success, or enterprise software.
  • Leadership experience in a student organization, team, or campus project where you ran timelines and coordinated people.
  • Exposure to enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, or Microsoft Dynamics.
  • Experience with project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, or Smartsheet.

What success looks like during the internship
  • First 30 days: You know Axiamatic's platform and delivery playbook. You own the meeting invites, notes, and follow-ups for one or two accounts.
  • First 60 days: You own the trackers and status reports for two or three accounts, and the delivery leads trust them. You spot slipping deadlines before anyone asks.
  • End of internship: You prepare QBR materials and executive dashboards on your own. You flag adoption gaps early, and you have improved at least one team template or process.

Conversion criteria
  • You own the trackers, notes, and status reports for at least two accounts with little correction needed.
  • Delivery leads rely on the QBR materials and executive dashboards you prepare.
  • You follow through on commitments without reminders, and you raise risks early.
  • Customer stakeholders see you as a reliable, professional point of contact for day-to-day coordination.
  • You act on feedback and show steady growth across the internship.

Growth trajectory
This internship is the entry point into delivery leadership at Axiamatic. Interns who meet the conversion criteria will receive an offer for the full-time Agentic Delivery Analyst role. From there, strong performers will grow into the Agentic Growth & Value Transformation Lead role and own customer accounts from kickoff through renewal.

Build the growth engine. Own the function. Accelerate your career.

LOCATION Remote (Chicago Pref’d) REPORTS TO CEO
BASE SALARY $130,000 to $150,000 TARGET BONUS 20%

The Opportunity

Guidant Power is looking for a high-potential B2B marketer ready to take the next major step in their career. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to build and own the marketing function of a rapidly growing, private equity backed services company.

We are looking for a builder. You will own Guidant's lead generation engine, HubSpot, campaigns, marketing metrics, budget, agencies, and the process for creating qualified pipeline one and two quarters ahead of sales requirements. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with sales and operating leadership.

Why This Role Is Different

  • You will own the marketing function, not one channel or a narrow piece of the funnel.
  • You will work directly with the CEO and senior leadership on growth priorities, investment decisions, and performance.
  • You will participate in Shore Capital's marketing cohort, sharing best practices and learning alongside marketers across a top 1% private equity firm’s portfolio.
  • You will gain direct experience with organic growth, M&A integration, cross-sell programs, and the operating discipline of a rapidly scaling services platform.
  • You will be judged on measurable business results, and success can lead to broader responsibility as Guidant grows.

What You Will Own

  • Build the lead flow model required to support bookings goals, including how many leads and qualified opportunities Guidant needs and how far in advance they must be created.
  • Create and manage integrated campaigns across email, paid media, social, events, conferences and trade shows, webinars, outbound BDR programs, SEO, and targeted accounts.
  • Own the marketing calendar, campaign priorities, annual marketing plan, and budget.
  • Oversee HubSpot implementation and operate HubSpot as Guidant's top-of-funnel platform for campaigns, lead scoring, qualification, workflows, attribution, and reporting.
  • Build dashboards that show pipeline generated by source, funnel conversion, cost per qualified opportunity, campaign ROI, and pipeline coverage one and two quarters forward.
  • Use qualitative market research with customers, prospects, salespeople, and technical experts to improve positioning, content, offers, and campaigns.
  • Manage agencies, contractors, paid media partners, content resources, data vendors, and other outside resources for quality, cost, timing, and results.
  • Support Guidant's M&A strategy by helping integrate acquired companies into Guidant's marketing systems, processes, brand, and cross-sell programs.

Who We Are Looking For

You do not need to have already led an entire marketing function. This role may be particularly attractive to someone who is ready for broader ownership and accountability.

  • 5 or more years of progressive B2B marketing experience, with a record of increasing responsibility and strong business results.
  • Demonstrated success personally building and executing demand generation programs that create qualified opportunities and pipeline.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform, with enough technical understanding to build workflows, reporting, and campaigns and manage outside implementation resources.
  • A strong marketing foundation across segmentation, positioning, customer acquisition, qualitative market research, content, SEO, paid media, social, email, events, and account-based marketing.
  • Comfort working with data, funnel metrics, attribution, campaign measurement, budgets, and reporting that connects marketing investment to pipeline and revenue.
  • The judgment and communication skills to work effectively with sales, operations, technical experts, outside partners, and senior leadership.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

  • Ambitious builder: energized by creating something that does not yet exist and eager to earn broader responsibility.
  • Strategic and hands on: able to move from market insight and investment decisions to campaign briefs, HubSpot workflows, dashboards, and vendor management.
  • Commercially minded: treats marketing as a revenue-generating function and focuses on qualified opportunities, sales productivity, pipeline, and ROI.
  • Customer curious: listens well, asks strong questions, identifies patterns, and turns insight into better campaigns and positioning.
  • Self-directed and accountable: moves with urgency, follows through, and is comfortable being measured on results.

What Success Looks Like

  • Guidant can reliably answer how many leads and qualified opportunities are needed each quarter and how much future pipeline marketing created this month.
  • Leadership knows which channels and campaigns create the best opportunities, what a qualified opportunity costs, and which investments should be increased, improved, or stopped.
  • Marketing consistently creates qualified opportunities early enough to improve pipeline coverage one and two quarters forward and make the sales team more productive.
  • HubSpot, attribution, funnel reporting, and marketing-to-NetSuite handoffs operate reliably and provide a measurable path from first engagement through booked business.

Compensation

The expected base salary range is $130,000 to $150,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus a 20% target annual performance bonus. The role is designed for a high-potential marketer ready to earn broader leadership responsibility through measurable results.

About Guidant Power

Guidant Power creates safer, more productive workplaces by helping companies improve electrical safety, reliability, and employee capability. We serve as a trusted guide through arc flash studies, infrared thermography, electrical engineering, healthcare specific electrical safety services, and training. Four values guide how we work: safety, trust, teamwork, and continuous improvement. We hire people who share them and who get results by making the team around them better. Our customers include well-known global and national companies such as Nestlé, Land O'Lakes, Bridgestone, Abbott, and Chord Energy. Guidant is growing organically and through acquisitions to build a national electrical safety and reliability services platform.

About the job SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

SENIOR DATA GOVERNANCE ANALYST

We are seeking a Senior Data Governance Analyst who will play an integral role in the execution of the banks enterprise data governance framework and supports the Senior Manager Analytics and Governance who has primary responsibility for enterprise-wide data governance activities.

The incumbent is responsible for monitoring and maintaining a robust data governance environment primarily through data risk assessments and ensuring the timely assignment and remediation of data incidents. The Senior Data Governance Analyst is the liaison between data governance team and business unit data stewards in ensuring that data management policies and procedures are communicated and embedded within the lines of business. As a Senior Data Governance Analyst, you will play an active role throughout the entire engagement cycle, specializing in solutions covering data governance, data quality and data classification.

Responsibilities:

  • Administers the Enterprise Data Governance programme by creating processes in support of data management practices to ensure compliance with the banks data governance and management policies.
  • Reviews data management practices in collaboration with the Senior Manager to ensure that the business is both aware of developments and operates within the Governance framework. This will include making recommendations to the Senior Manager on any updates that are required to processes, policies or business activities.
  • Analyze the effectiveness of data management processes and procedures in Technology and lines of businesses to identify and close gaps and reduce material data risks.
  • Conducts in depth monitoring of adherence data management processes to ensure compliance with regulatory authorities and data management standards.
  • Develops and maintains key effective relationships with unit leaders, data owners, data stewards and data custodians ensuring that there is clarity and consistency in methodology and practices for data management and governance throughout and across the business units.
  • Assists the Senior Manager and accountable officers in assessing data risks arising from all projects, products and change initiatives impacting the Line of Businesses (LOB) to ensure that material risks are appropriately identified and mitigated.
  • Provides support to data owners and stewards responsible for resolving data incidents under their purview and developing achievable action plans with realistic due dates to ensure that data incidents are remediated within agreed timeframe.
  • Monitors and tracks Data Incidents by attending weekly or monthly meetings (data quality working group etc.) to ensure that action plan owners are executing remedial actions as scheduled thereby minimising exposure.

Requirements:

  • 7 10 years banking experience, with a proven background in governance and control functions inclusive of the KCARs, SOX and quarterly assertion processes.
  • Understanding of banking data environment.
  • Knowledge of data governance practices, business and technology issues related to management of enterprise information assets and approaches related to data management.
  • Demonstrated consulting skills, with change management concepts and strategies, including communication, culture change and performance measurement design.
  • Experience in risk management, control testing, remediation management and reporting.
  • In-depth understanding of process improvement, risk, control and deficiency management to provide leadership to the business units.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end banking process flows to be able to develop controls in the context of new process development and providing a good basis for identifying risk and the absence of control.
  • Bachelors degree preferably in quantitative areas such as Computer Science or Information Technology.

Who is Forcepoint?

Forcepoint simplifies security for global businesses and governments. Forcepoint’s all-in-one, truly cloud-native platform makes it easy to adopt Zero Trust and prevent the theft or loss of sensitive data and intellectual property no matter where people are working. 20+ years in business. 2.7k employees. 150 countries. 11k+ customers. 300+ patents. If our mission excites you, you’re in the right place; we want you to bring your own energy to help us create a safer world. All we’re missing is you!

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff/Principal Infrastructure Automation & AI Ops Engineer to modernize enterprise infrastructure operations across endpoint, identity, Microsoft 365, network, cloud, and IT service management. This is not a traditional systems administration role. The successful candidate will establish an automation-first, API-driven, AI-assisted operating model that replaces manual administration with policy-as-code, automated remediation, and intelligent operational workflows, extending the governance and security foundation already built across the environment.

The engineer will act as a technical authority and architecture leader, unifying Intune, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, CrowdStrike Falcon, CyberArk, Freshservice, AWS, Commvault, and Juniper NGFW infrastructure into a single automation and telemetry architecture. The ideal candidate moves fluidly between writing Python, PowerShell, and Bash, troubleshooting a production authentication issue, reviewing architecture, and defining an AI-driven remediation strategy.

The organization operates as customer zero for Forcepoint's Data Security Everywhere (DSE) / DLP platform, piloting AI-assisted data security and remediation workflows ahead of general availability. This engineer will help shape how that integration extends into the broader automation and AI Ops corporate architecture.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering & Automation

Own the architecture and standards for the Windows endpoint platform in Intune. Design lifecycle automation covering provisioning, configuration, compliance, patching, and retirement, and sustain current patch and compliance rates as the fleet scales. Engineer Windows Autopilot workflows that enforce standard-user deployment and close local-admin exposure. Build automated software inventory auditing by reconciling Intune with CrowdStrike Falcon Discover, and design self-healing remediation for common failures.

Identity, Zero Trust & Access Automation

Serve as a technical authority for Entra ID identity architecture. Automate Joiner, Mover, and Leaver workflows across Entra ID, M365, and Freshservice. Mature Conditional Access from audit mode into full enforcement. Develop AI-assisted entitlement and RBAC analysis that surfaces excessive privilege, stale access, and segregation-of-duties risk. Partner on Beyond Trust privileged-access automation, including onboarding, credential rotation, and session monitoring.

Microsoft 365 Platform Engineering

Architect and automate Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and Conditional Access administration through Microsoft Graph and PowerShell. Establish configuration baselines and drift detection, and carry forward the SharePoint governance and versioning cleanup already underway.

Infrastructure-as-Code & Automation Engineering

Own the automation engineering practice enterprise-wide. Set standards for Terraform, Bicep, and scripting frameworks in place of one-off scripts. Build CI/CD pipelines and API-driven integrations across Intune, Entra ID, Freshservice, AWS, and Juniper, and deliver reusable automation modules other engineers can build on. Convert high-volume manual processes into automated Freshservice service catalog workflows.

AI Ops & Intelligent Automation

Deliver production AI-assisted capabilities, not pilots, across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and Service Desk. Implement anomaly detection and event correlation, intelligent ticket classification and routing in Freshservice, and predictive models for certificate expiration, patch compliance, and firewall licensing. Ensure every automated action carries authentication, authorization, logging, approval, and rollback controls, with human approval gates on high-risk changes.

Serve as a technical partner on the organization's customer-zero engagement with Forcepoint DSE/DLP, helping define how AI-assisted data security detection and remediation workflows integrate with the broader endpoint, identity, and ITSM automation architecture.

Observability & Security Guardrails

Build a unified telemetry view spanning endpoint, identity, network, cloud, M365, and ITSM. Implement secrets management through Key Vault, Secrets Manager, or Vault, eliminate hardcoded credentials and standing privileged access, and enforce least-privilege RBAC with full audit trails for every automated action.

Technical Leadership

Define the architecture standards adopted across Infrastructure & Operations. Lead design reviews, mentor engineers, and partner with Network, Cloud, Security, Identity, and Service Desk leaders, shaping standards across teams without relying on direct reporting authority.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in infrastructure, systems, or platform engineering, with demonstrated experience designing automation (not just executing predefined procedures) in large enterprise environments.
  • Expert-level Microsoft Intune and Windows endpoint management, including Autopilot and local-admin/LAPS enforcement.
  • Strong hands-on Entra ID experience: SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, Zero Trust, identity lifecycle, SCIM/API-based provisioning.
  • Advanced PowerShell, Python, and/or Bash; strong REST API/webhook integration and Git experience; experience with Terraform, Bicep, or Ansible and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Deep Microsoft 365 administration, including Microsoft Graph API and SharePoint governance.
  • Experience with EDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon preferred) and vulnerability/patch management reporting.
  • Understanding of 802.1X, enterprise PKI/CA, certificate deployment via MDM, and NAC/authentication troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted or event-driven production automation, including anomaly detection and automated remediation with appropriate security guardrails.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS platform engineering and account hygiene.
  • Direct Freshservice (or ServiceNow/Jira Service Management) administration and API integration experience.
  • Experience with CyberArk or equivalent PAM platforms, and Commvault or equivalent backup platforms.
  • Network automation using Python/Ansible; experience with observability/telemetry pipelines.
  • Experience with LLM/AI agent frameworks and enterprise AI governance.
  • Familiarity with Forcepoint DSE/DLP or Claude-based AI security tooling, or interest in shaping an early customer-zero AI/data-security integration.
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert; Terraform Associate; AWS/Azure professional certification.

Success Metrics (6–12 Months)

  • 60–80%+ of repeatable endpoint tasks automated; patch/compliance rates sustained or improved.
  • Automated Joiner/Mover/Leaver workflows live; Conditional Access moved from audit to full enforcement.
  • Infrastructure changes delivered through Git/CI/CD with reusable modules adopted across teams.
  • Proactive certificate, firewall, and endpoint compliance monitoring in place.
  • Multiple AI Ops use cases in production (ticket classification, automated low-risk remediation) with measurable reduction in mean time to detect/resolve.

Role Positioning

This role is measured by outcomes, not ticket volume: tickets eliminated, processes automated, incidents prevented, risk reduced, engineering capacity created.

The right candidate can architect a solution, build the automation, secure it, measure it, and roll it back if needed. This is an automation and platform architect who codes fluently, not an administrator who happens to know Intune and Freshservice.

Summary: The Cement Additives Process Engineer plays a pivotal role in driving business growth and profitability through strategic technical support and contribution to the sales process. This position is tasked with providing technical support and expertise of the cement manufacturing process to our cement additive sales team and customers. Proficiency in this role requires exceptional cement manufacturing, analytical, and communication skills to collaborate seamlessly with internal teams at Euclid Chemical and build strong, lasting relationships with external cement customers – both active and potential customers. This is a remote position, with Euclid Chemical's main campus located in Ceveland, OH.

  • Serve as a technical ambassador for the Euclid Chemical cement additive sales team.
  • Subject matter expert to provide feedback and troubleshooting information for customers.
  • Act as a technical expert on the latest cement manufacturing technologies, equipment, and best practices to maintain Euclid Chemical's competitive edge.
  • Deliver customer support through industrial trials, mill audits, special projects, data analysis, and detailed reporting to retain existing customers and attract new ones
  • Compile and analyze industrial trial process data, and prepare detailed reports providing conclusions and action items from industrial trial runs.
  • Keep thorough and updated records of activity history with active and potential cement additive customers.
  • Design and execution of plant industrial trials and mill audits.
  • Maintenance and operation of portable pump equipment inventory to utilize during industrial trials.
  • Collaborate with the Cement Additives Technical Manager and Cement Lab Manager to develop new products and enhance existing lines based on market trends, competitive analysis, and industrial trial results.
  • Work collaboratively with Euclid Chemical Cement Additives Lab team in the development and improvement of laboratory ball mill methodologies for testing materials.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (chemical or mechanical) or chemistry - master’s degree is preferred.
  • Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in cement manufacturing process control or quality management.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Advanced knowledge and understanding of cement manufacturing, cement chemistry, and raw and finish mill circuit operation.
  • Basic understanding of cement additives chemistries.
  • Ability to interpret lab outputs (e.g., XRD, clinker microscopy, isothermal calorimetry, and physical test results) to develop customer-specific strategies and product recommendations.

  • Knowledge of industry trends, including low clinker content cement production and co-grinding with alternative materials.
  • Data analysis and report writing skills.
  • Communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Leadership and team management capabilities.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • The ability to design and execute plant industrial trials and mill audits.

Travel:

  • Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings and plant industrial trials (up to 50%).

raw.title: Product Manager Data & Collectors
raw.excerpt: Sobre Tendios👋 Somos Tendios, una startup de rápido crecimiento nacida en 2023 en el corazón de Barcelona.
raw.description:
Sobre Tendios

👋 Somos Tendios, una startup de rápido crecimiento nacida en 2023 en el corazón de Barcelona. Nuestra misión es revolucionar el mundo de la contratación pública para empresas e instituciones.

Nuestra plataforma SaaS impulsada por inteligencia artificial ayuda a empresas a ganar más licitaciones y a entidades públicas a crear y gestionar licitaciones de forma más eficiente. Trabajamos con entidades como el Principado de Asturias, Renfe, Acciona o Telefónica, entre otras. Lo hacemos a través de dos productos:

  • Tendios Bid— para empresas que participan en licitaciones públicas: buscador, alertas, pipeline de oportunidades y workflows para ganar más concursos.

  • Tendios Create— para organizaciones públicas que crean y publican licitaciones: creación de expedientes y redacción de pliegos asistida por IA.

La IA no es un añadido en nuestros productos: es el núcleo. Redacción asistida, propuestas generadas, análisis automático de documentos y flujos conversacionales están en el centro de la experiencia. Buscamos a alguien que diseñeconesa mentalidad, noalrededorde ella.

Como un equipo joven y ambicioso, valoramos la energía, la creatividad y la colaboración. Si te apasiona la innovación y quieres tener un impacto real, nos encantaría que te unas a nosotros para redefinir cómo las empresas optimizan sus procesos de licitación pública.

El rol

Buscamos a alguien que sea el dueño de producto de todo el ciclo del dato: desde que se captura en la fuente (collectors) hasta que llega al cliente como valor (listas, directorios, análisis de mercado y Tender Intelligence).

Es un rol híbrido: lidera un equipo técnico de scraping/collectors y, al mismo tiempo, define y entrega la capa de producto de analítica de mercado que usan los clientes de Bid. Es un puesto con mucho impacto directo: la calidad del dato condiciona la activación, la retención y la propuesta de valor de Tendios.

Responsabilidades

1. Gestión del equipo de Collectors

  • Liderar y priorizar el trabajo del equipo de collectors (licitaciones, legislación, resoluciones y otras fuentes de contratación pública).

  • Definir el roadmap de cobertura: nuevas fuentes, nuevos países/territorios, nuevos tipos de documento y mayor profundidad de campos.

  • Evaluar la viabilidad y el valor de cada fuente (campos disponibles, frecuencia de actualización, estabilidad, coste de mantenimiento) antes de comprometer trabajo.

  • Gestionar el backlog, el ritmo de entrega y la coordinación con Ingeniería y Data & AI.

  • Garantizar la operación: monitorización de collectors, respuesta ante roturas de fuentes, SLAs de frescura y cobertura.

  • Dar visibilidad al resto de la empresa sobre qué datos tenemos, con qué calidad y qué limitaciones.

2. ETL y Data Quality a nivel de producto

  • Definir qué significa "dato de calidad" para Tendios: completitud, exactitud, consistencia, frescura, deduplicación y normalización.

  • Establecer métricas y umbrales de calidad (por fuente, por país, por campo) y hacerles seguimiento con dashboards y alertas.

  • Priorizar las mejoras del ETL en función del impacto en el producto: enriquecimiento, normalización de entidades (organismos y empresas), clasificación (CPV, tipologías, estados) y resolución de duplicados.

  • Traducir problemas de calidad de dato en impacto de negocio (ruido en alertas, resultados irrelevantes, análisis incorrectos) y escalarlos con criterio.

  • Definir la política de ciclo de vida del dato: estados de licitación, cambios, modificaciones, adjudicaciones y formalizaciones.

  • Ser el punto de referencia para evaluar la readiness de nuevos mercados en términos de calidad y disponibilidad de datos.

3. Producto de analítica de mercado y oportunidades de cliente

  • Ser el dueño de producto de:

    • Analítica interna de las oportunidades de las empresas

    • Directoriosde empresas y de entidades públicas.

    • Tender Intelligence: análisis de mercado, competencia, comportamiento de compradores, históricos de adjudicación y detección de oportunidades para cada cliente.

  • Descubrir necesidades reales de los Bidders (comerciales, responsables de licitaciones, dirección) y convertirlas en propuestas de producto claras.

  • Escribir PRDs orientados a producto (qué y por qué, flujos, reglas, estados y resultados esperados), sin entrar en cómo se implementa.

  • Definir métricas de éxito, plan de medición y experimentos; analizar el uso con herramientas de analítica de producto.

  • Colaborar con Diseño e Ingeniería en todo el ciclo: discovery, definición, entrega, lanzamiento y mejora continua.

  • Conectar la analítica de mercado con el resto del producto (buscador, alertas, pipeline) para que el dato se convierta en decisiones y no en pantallas aisladas.

Objetivos del rol

  • Aumentar la cobertura y la frescura del dato de las fuentes críticas.

  • Reducir de forma sostenida las incidencias de calidad de dato que llegan a cliente.

  • Lanzar y hacer crecer el uso de la analítica de mercado de la aplicación.

Requisitos

Imprescindibles

  • 4+ años como Product Manager, idealmente en productos de datos, plataformas B2B SaaS o marketplaces de información.

  • Experiencia liderando o coordinando equipos técnicos (scraping, data engineering o similar), con capacidad de priorizar y desbloquear.

  • Comprensión sólida de pipelines de datos (captura, transformación, carga), modelado de entidades y calidad de dato. No hace falta programar, sí hablar con fluidez con quien lo hace.

  • Capacidad analítica: SQL a nivel de consulta y uso cómodo de herramientas de analítica de producto y BI.

  • Buena redacción de especificaciones de producto y comunicación clara con perfiles técnicos y de negocio.

  • Español nativo o equivalente; inglés profesional.

Muy valorables

  • Conocimiento de contratación pública (LCSP, PLACSP, TED, CPV, ciclo de vida de una licitación) o de sectores similares de datos regulados.

  • Experiencia con productos de inteligencia de mercado, directorios o bases de datos de empresas/entidades.

  • Experiencia con bases de datos analíticas (p. ej. ClickHouse) y con datos en múltiples idiomas o jurisdicciones.

  • Experiencia con IA aplicada a extracción, clasificación o enriquecimiento de documentos.

  • Experiencia en expansión de producto a nuevos países.

Competencias clave

  • Ownership:asume la responsabilidad de extremo a extremo, del dato en bruto al valor percibido por el cliente.

  • Criterio de priorización:sabe qué fuente, qué campo o qué mejora de calidad mueve realmente el producto.

  • Pensamiento sistémico:entiende cómo una decisión en el ETL se refleja en una pantalla y en una métrica de negocio.

  • Liderazgo sin jerarquía excesiva:influye y alinea a equipos técnicos, diseño y negocio.

  • Orientación a evidencia:decide con datos y sabe cuándo el dato aún no basta.

Qué ofrecemos

  • 📄 Contrato indefinido.

  • 💰 Salario competitivo con bonificaciones basadas en el rendimiento.

  • 📈 Entorno acelerado de startup con oportunidades de crecimiento profesional.

  • 🎉 Eventos de equipo y una cultura de trabajo colaborativa.

  • 🎓 Oportunidades de formación y desarrollo profesional.

Proceso

  1. Revisión de portfolio y CV.

  2. Entrevista inicial (encaje y motivación).

  3. Entrevista con equipo de Producto y/o Ingeniería.

  4. Oferta.

raw.description:
Role Profile: Scrum Master

Role Summary

The Scrum Master is responsible for enabling Agile practices within the team, ensuring adherence to Scrum principles, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Acting as a servant leader, this role removes impediments, promotes collaboration, and drives successful delivery in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives).
  • Coach team members and stakeholders on Agile principles and the Scrum framework.
  • Identify and remove obstacles to ensure smooth delivery.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to ensure backlog clarity and prioritization.
  • Track and report key metrics (velocity, burndown charts) to stakeholders.
  • Ensure transparency and effective communication across teams and departments.
  • Support scaling Agile practices across multiple teams when required.
  • Drive adoption of Agile best practices and ensure compliance with organizational standards.
  • Mentor new Scrum Masters and contribute to the Agile community within the organization.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination for dependencies and shared deliverables.
  • Assist in defining and refining team goals and objectives aligned with business priorities.
  • Work closely with leadership to identify opportunities for process optimization.
  • Support risk management and proactively address delivery challenges.
  • Champion team health by monitoring workload, morale, and engagement.
  • Ensure proper use of Agile tools and maintain accurate documentation in Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Participate in release planning and help align sprint goals with release objectives.
  • Advocate for continuous learning by organizing workshops, training sessions, and knowledge sharing activities.

Qualifications

Education:

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Certifications:

  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) required.
  • Additional Agile certifications (SAFe, PMI-ACP, ICAgile) are a plus.

Knowledge, Experience & Skills

  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Excellent facilitation, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with Agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle and project management principles.
  • 3–5 years of experience as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.
  • Proven track record of delivering projects in fast-paced, high-pressure settings.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Exposure to scaling frameworks (SAFe, LeSS) is desirable.

Job Description:

Job Title: Digital Dealer Advisor

Location: Remote | USA (Western PA/Upstate NY)
Reports to: Manager, Digital Dealer Consultants

Employment Type: Full-time

This is an existing vacancy

About the Role: The Digital Dealer Advisor serves as a trusted advisor to the OEM’s dealer network, providing expert guidance across all areas of digital marketing and online retail performance. This role is responsible for conducting program performance reviews, offering vendor recommendations, and delivering ongoing consultative services that drive measurable improvements in dealership sales and service operations.


The ideal candidate brings strong proficiency in dealership websites, SEO, SEM, social media, reputation management, CRM platforms, and Google AdWords. This position requires the ability to work independently while keeping leadership informed of key accomplishments and insights.


The Digital Dealer Advisor serves as a trusted advisor to the OEM’s dealer network, providing expert guidance across all areas of digital marketing and online retail performance. This role is responsible for conducting program performance reviews, offering vendor recommendations, and delivering ongoing consultative services that drive measurable improvements in dealership sales and service operations.


The ideal candidate brings strong proficiency in dealership websites, SEO, SEM, social media, reputation management, CRM platforms, and Google AdWords. This position requires the ability to work independently while keeping leadership informed of key accomplishments and insights.


You will be a key player in the digital success of your assigned Dealers. This role will consist of 80% travel.


In this role, you will:


  • Support and train dealers and regional teams on digital marketing products, services, and best practices.
  • Stay current on emerging digital trends and ensure dealer alignment with approved program offerings.
  • Analyze and report on digital performance metrics to identify growth opportunities at both the dealer and regional levels.
  • Communicate cross‑tier program benefits to help dealers optimize participation and results.
  • Educate dealers on effective digital marketing strategies and best practices.
  • Work with dealers to diagnose and resolve digital marketing challenges.
  • Provide guidance on OEM digital systems, processes, and lead management best practices.  

Required Qualifications:


  • 3+ years working in the automotive industry
  • General understanding in the areas of automotive digital marketing, websites, digital advertising, leads, CRM, marketing analytics, ROI, etc.
  • Understanding and or experience working with Dealers or Dealer groups on digital marketing programs, consulting or executing campaigns
  • Engaging personality with the ability to connect with a diverse range of people.
  • Self-starter with ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Ability to lead internal and external meetings and be an articulate and active participant, ensuring the discussion stays on track.
  • Ability to deliver instructions in a clear and concise manner, providing the proper materials and documentation when necessary.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and confident with group presentations.
  • Identify risk and work with other leaders and internal groups to resolve conflict.
  • Superior analytical and organizational skills and demonstrated ability to pay attention to details.
  • Take ownership and accountability over the process ensuring success.
  • OEM and Dealer oriented team player with the ability to motivate the internal team while providing program leadership.

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a starting salary range of $100,000 USD - $115,000 USD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.


Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

Applications

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where employment is offered. JD Power does not provide employment sponsorship for this position.

This position is posted exclusively on and select trusted job boards such as LinkedIn or Indeed. All official communication comes from email addresses ending in @jdpower.com or @jdpa.com. We will never ask for payment, equipment purchases, or upfront fees. We may take additional steps to verify candidate information to protect the integrity of our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

In this role, you will analyze large-scale Generative AI deployments, draw insights from conversational data to uncover and communicate growth opportunities, and craft compelling narratives around performance and impact.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytically minded, has a strong grasp of customer behavior, and a track record of translating data-driven insights into actionable recommendations.

This role is right for you if you
