  • Enjoy turning complex data into clear, actionable business recommendations
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences

What we'd like to see

Benefits

About NCR Atleos

NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe. NCR Atleos was ranked #12 in Newsweek’s prestigious 2025 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces® list.


The Technical Consultant role focuses on activities such as evaluating, installing, unit testing, trouble-shooting and supporting software solutions based on business and operational requirements in a variety of customer-facing and internal business scenarios, associated with NCR Atleos’ financial software for ATMs and cash recyclers.

Upon achieving a fundamental knowledge of NCR Atleos’ software solutions, candidates will specialize into areas focusing on multi-vendor platforms, security, manageability, performance, consumer flow, transactions, maintenance (supervisor) operations and message formats. Focus on specializations will rotate periodically to create a well-rounded perspective and a deeper set of capabilities.

Candidates must work to anticipate internal and external client needs and have an overriding commitment to client satisfaction. Also, incumbents must be able to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rapid change. 

Installation, Troubleshooting, and/or Development skills and capabilities are a plus; however this role is not a full-time development role. Some shift work may be required.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Analyze, Install, Configure, Troubleshoot

  • Perform functional analysis of requirements to determine effort required to implement software in customers’ environments.
  • Configure base software in customer’s environments.
  • Conducting unit tests, tracking problems, and implementing changes to ensure adherence to test plan and functional requirements
  • Diagnosing, isolating, and implementing remedies for system failures caused by errors in software code, using knowledge of system characteristics and utilizing software-based system maintenance and tracking tools.
  • Establish acceptance criteria and quality goals
  • Provides estimates, goals, standards, constraints and dependencies as input to the SOW and the software development plan

Perform QA in the end-to-end testing process for software under your stewardship:

  • lead analysis and resolution of software issues reported during testing

Acceptance/Certification & Pilot Support

  • Preparation of software for distribution to customers or networks
  • Ensure installability through software distribution, full bare-metal installation, local updates
  • Support field organization as required during lab installations, certifications, training
  • Lead analysis and resolve software issues found during customer acceptance testing

Production Support

  • Support/resolution of production issues forwarded by Level 3 Support including the creation of a hot fix as well as executing integration test prior to delivering to QA.

Basic Requirements

  • Experience working in the ATM or kiosk self-service industry
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent accreditation in computer sciences, information systems or other technical discipline.
  • Technical project leadership experience organizing project resources
  • Experience working with Microsoft operating system technology – specifically Windows 10 and Windows 7 – including one or several off the following: installing and supporting hardware devices and drivers; installing and configuring windows applications; troubleshooting network protocols and services—including TCP/IP, Internet Information Services, and remote access; understanding of client/server application architectures.
  • Experience creating and leading group presentations, hosting web seminars and public speaking

Preferred Requirements

  • Knowledge of programming and/or direct experience in developing client applications, identifying software problems and debugging
  • Ideally experience in VB or VB.NET, C++, and C# is useful
  • Client application development experience as opposed to database application development experience is desired
  • Financial institution or network switch ATM operational experience
  • Knowledge and experience working with the CEN XFS ATM software specification
  • Knowledge and experience working with NDC and 912 message formats
  • Experience working with proprietary message formats
  • Experience building or integrating WebServices applications (WebSphere or IIS)
  • Experience working with internal tools including PSA, Confluence, and QuickBase
  • Experience working with any source control package, including JIRA, Subversion
  • Working knowledge of Agile SDLC

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job.

Full time employee benefits include:

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental Insurance

  • Vision Insurance

  • Short/Long Term Disability

  • Paid Vacation

raw.description:
Trabaja en DaCodes!

Somos una firma de expertos en software y transformación digital de alto impacto.
Durante 10 años hemos creado soluciones enfocadas en la tecnología e innovación gracias a nuestro equipo de casi 300 talentosos #DaCoders, incluyendo desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores UX/UI, PMs, QA testers y más. Nuestro equipo colabora en proyectos con clientes en LATAM y Estados Unidos, logrando resultados sobresalientes.
En DaCodes, tendrás la oportunidad de impulsar tu desarrollo profesional, trabajar en diversos proyectos dentro de distintas industrias, y contribuir al diseño, implementación y optimización de infraestructuras en la nube.
Nuestros DaCoders tienen un gran impacto en el éxito de nuestro negocio y el de nuestros clientes. Serás el experto que participará en nuestros proyectos y tendrás acceso a startups disruptivas y marcas globales.

¿Te interesa?

Buscamos un Senior Full Stack Engineer para integrarse a un equipo de desarrollo enfocado en la construcción de un nuevo producto para una empresa del sector financiero en México.

Trabajarás sobre una plataforma desarrollada de forma nativa en AWS, participando tanto en frontend con React como en backend con Node.js/TypeScript, dentro de un entorno altamente regulado donde la seguridad, disponibilidad y calidad del software son fundamentales.

Buscamos un perfil con fuerte capacidad técnica y autonomía, capaz no solo de desarrollar funcionalidades, sino también de proponer soluciones, tomar decisiones técnicas y construir pruebas de concepto.

La posición es 100% remota, de largo plazo y exclusiva para personas con residencia en México.

Requirements

Principales responsabilidades y funciones

  • Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener APIs y servicios backend desplegados sobre AWS.
  • Desarrollar interfaces utilizando React, incluyendo componentes reutilizables, hooks, manejo de estado y validación de formularios.
  • Diseñar APIs pensando en su consumo desde frontend, estableciendo contratos claros, estrategias de paginación y manejo consistente de errores.
  • Diseñar soluciones resilientes para procesos críticos que dependan de servicios externos, implementando mecanismos como colas, reintentos, Dead-Letter Queues (DLQ), idempotencia, monitoreo y notificaciones.
  • Implementar y mantener mecanismos de autenticación y autorización utilizando OAuth2, JWT y estrategias de renovación de tokens.
  • Gestionar de manera segura secretos, credenciales y archivos utilizando servicios especializados de AWS.
  • Implementar medidas de protección para APIs y aplicaciones, incluyendo AWS WAF y rate limiting.
  • Atender hallazgos de seguridad y vulnerabilidades dentro de los tiempos establecidos por el proyecto.
  • Participar activamente en procesos de CI/CD, code reviews y documentación técnica.
  • Colaborar dentro de un equipo ágil bajo metodología Scrum, utilizando herramientas como Jira y Confluence.
  • Analizar necesidades técnicas y proponer soluciones, arquitecturas y pruebas de concepto (PoC).
  • Colaborar con otros perfiles técnicos para asegurar la calidad, seguridad, escalabilidad y mantenibilidad de las soluciones.

Perfil deseado

  • 5+ años de experiencia profesional como Full Stack Developer, Backend Developer o Software Engineer.
  • Seniority Senior.
  • Experiencia real desarrollando aplicaciones con React, con capacidad para explicar e implementar:
    • Componentes.
    • Hooks.
    • Manejo de estado.
    • Formularios y validaciones.
  • Experiencia sólida en backend utilizando Node.js y TypeScript, idealmente con NestJS o Express.
  • También se considerarán perfiles con experiencia sólida en .NET, Java o Python, siempre que cuenten con experiencia relevante en frontend y AWS.
  • Experiencia práctica utilizando AWS en ambientes productivos.
  • Conocimiento sólido de servicios como:
    • AWS Lambda.
    • API Gateway.
    • Amazon SQS.
    • Amazon S3.
    • AWS Secrets Manager.
    • Amazon ECS / Fargate.
  • Capacidad para identificar cuándo utilizar serverless, contenedores o servicios administrados de acuerdo con las necesidades de la solución.
  • Experiencia trabajando con bases de datos SQL y NoSQL, como PostgreSQL y DynamoDB.
  • Experiencia con Git, Docker y pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Conocimientos de seguridad aplicada al desarrollo de software y APIs.
  • Experiencia con autenticación mediante OAuth2 y JWT.
  • Conocimiento de estrategias de resiliencia para sistemas distribuidos: retries, queues, DLQs e idempotencia.
  • Certificación AWS Cloud Practitioner, o compromiso para obtenerla.
  • Inglés intermedio, principalmente para documentación técnica y comunicación con equipos internacionales.
  • Residencia actual en México.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar de manera 100% remota.

Habilidades blandas

  • Pensamiento analítico y capacidad de resolución de problemas.
  • Proactividad y autonomía.
  • Curiosidad técnica y aprendizaje continuo.
  • Capacidad para proponer alternativas y tomar decisiones técnicas fundamentadas.
  • Comunicación clara de decisiones y conceptos técnicos.
  • Alto sentido de ownership.
  • Sensibilidad hacia seguridad, privacidad y manejo responsable de información.
  • Capacidad para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinarios.

Deseable

  • Experiencia con Next.js.
  • Experiencia trabajando con GraphQL.
  • Conocimiento de Infrastructure as Code (IaC) utilizando Terraform, AWS CDK u OpenTofu.
  • Experiencia previa en el sector financiero, fintech o ambientes altamente regulados.
  • Certificación AWS Developer Associate o AWS Solutions Architect.
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial aplicadas al desarrollo de software.
  • Buen criterio respecto al manejo de información confidencial y sensible al utilizar herramientas de IA.

Benefits

Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.

Trabajo remoto/Home office.

En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.
Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.

Día off en tu cumpleaños.
Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).
Seguro de vida (aplica para México).
Equipos de trabajo multiculturales.
Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.
Meetups con invitados especiales del área de IT.
Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.
Clases de inglés.
Oportunidades dentro de nuestras diferentes líneas de negocio.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Title: Cloud Security Engineer - Oracle
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Security Engineer - Oracle responsible for designing, implementing, and operating security controls across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), Oracle Cloud Applications, and hybrid Oracle environments.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and implement enterprise security architectures for OCI tenancies, including landing-zone guardrails, security zones, and compartment policies.
  • Configure and operate OCI Identity Domains, federation with corporate IdPs, and strong RBAC strategies across the tenancy.

Commercial Account Manager (PBSA/BTR)

Field-based / Remote

Salary: £40,000 + car allowance + commission (OTE £50,000+)

Are you a commercially driven Commercial Account Manager with experience managing relationships with Purpose Built Student Accommodation (PBSA) or Build to Rent (BTR) operators? Reporting to our Head of Client Acquisition (PBSA/BTR), you’ll take ownership of a growing portfolio of operator accounts, strengthening partnerships, protecting commercial value and driving sustainable revenue growth. This is an opportunity to help shape a fast-growing part of UniHomes, backed by an established PropTech business.

You’ll help accommodation providers improve listing performance and tenancy conversions while ensuring partnerships deliver value for both parties. We’re looking for someone who combines strong relationship-building skills with sound commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate, influence effectively and ensure agreed commitments are delivered.

Remote-based, with national client travel and occasional overnight stays, depending on account needs and seasonal activity.


Key responsibilities:

Strategic partner engagement:
  • Develop and maintain robust, high-value relationships with key decision-makers within PBSA and BTR operators.
    Serve as the primary strategic point of contact, leading ongoing discussions around performance, optimisation, and new opportunities.
    Conduct a minimum of 10 impactful meetings per week, including in-depth account reviews, strategic follow-ups, and platform training sessions.
    Actively represent UniHomes at industry networking events and conferences to strengthen relationships and uncover new opportunities.

Commercial performance and account growth:
  • Lead commercial account reviews, renewals and contract negotiations, ensuring partnerships deliver sustainable value for both parties.
  • Lead commercial discussions, working with internal teams and operators to achieve clear, timely and mutually agreed outcomes.
  • Proactively monitor, analyse, and significantly improve the performance of operator listings, ensuring maximum visibility, competitiveness, and data accuracy.
  • Deliver regular, insightful reports and data-driven recommendations that directly contribute to partner success and conversion rates. Provide weekly performance headlines and comprehensive reports to the Head of PBSA and BTR.

Portfolio excellence:
  • Ensure all partner listings are complete, up-to-date, and consistently exceed platform standards across pricing, availability, rich media (images/virtual tours), and detailed property information.
  • Collaborate with operators to effectively roll out impactful promotional offers and dynamic seasonal adjustments.

Internal collaboration and innovation:
  • Work seamlessly across our product, content, and marketing teams to address client needs swiftly and enhance overall platform functionality.
  • Identify and help implement process improvements that elevate partner satisfaction and streamline operational efficiencies.

Skills and experience:

  • Proven experience managing complex B2B accounts, ideally with PBSA operators, with a track record of commercial negotiation, revenue growth, and confidently leading complex commercial conversations.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build rapport and influence at all levels.
  • A strong commercial mindset underpinned by a proactive, data-driven approach to account growth and revenue generation.
  • Proficient and comfortable navigating property management systems, CRM platforms (ideally Salesforce), and various online marketplaces.
  • Highly organised, capable of managing a diverse portfolio of accounts simultaneously while maintaining meticulous attention to detail.
  • A clear, confident, and persuasive communicator (both written and verbal) who can articulate complex information effectively.
  • Full, valid UK driving licence (as this is a field-based role with regular travel).

Highly desirable:

  • Experience and a strong network directly within the Purpose-Built Student Accommodation (PBSA) and/or Build-to-Rent (BTR) sector.
  • Direct experience within the PropTech, SaaS, or online marketplace environments.
  • Familiarity with occupancy strategies, revenue management, and seasonal trends specific to student accommodation.
  • Experience with the International Student Market.

About us:

At UniHomes, we’re on a mission to transform the entire student rental experience across the UK. As the market-leading student accommodation advertising platform and utility management service provider, we make finding and securing all-inclusive student accommodation simple, seamless, and stress-free.

We’re not just another platform. UniHomes is developing innovative technology to deliver one go-to destination that supports the entire student rental journey. With an unwavering focus on our students, partner letting agents, operators and suppliers, we continually evolve and enhance our products and services to exceed expectations, while tackling market complexity with ease and transparency.

Since launching in 2015, we’ve experienced rapid growth. Today, we operate in 60+ cities, partner with 1,000+ agents and operators, and are backed by Macquarie Capital and LDC. Our success has been recognised with accolades from EY Entrepreneur of the Year, Deloitte UK Technology Fast 50, The Negotiator Awards, and Great Place to Work® certification.

Our 140+ strong team is based in the heart of Sheffield City Centre, where we’re driving innovation, expanding into new markets, and fostering a culture built on collaboration, creativity, and growth.

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact and help redefine how students find their perfect home, now is the time to join UniHomes. Be part of a team that’s opening new doors to better experiences, brighter ideas, and stress-free living.


We are a team driven and united by our core values:

  • Lead the Way
  • In it Together
  • Customers Matter
  • Keep it Simple
  • Rise Above Challenges
  • Make it Happen

What do you get when you work here?

With people and culture at the heart of our organisation, we are continually enhancing our employee offer and culture. We are incredibly proud to have been officially certified as a Great Place to Work® (GPTW®) and an accredited Living Wage employer - all our employees earn a fair living wage above the government minimum wage.

Our impressive benefits package and perks comprise:

  1. Health and wellbeing: healthcare scheme, Employee Assistance Programme, mental health and financial support
  2. Time away: holiday allowance 31 days (incl. BH), length of service days, volunteering day and enhanced family leave
  3. Financial benefits: enhanced pension, salary sacrifice and sick pay
  4. Development: career progression and personal and professional development
  5. Social: social events and recognition awards


When you do visit our stunning state-of-the-art office in Sheffield, you will be treated to complimentary breakfast, hot & cold drinks, snacks, pool table, and company social activities.

At UniHomes we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone can thrive and which values individuals for their unique perspectives. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments to make the recruitment process more accessible to you.

Applicants must already have the permanent and unrestricted right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship as we do not hold a sponsor licence.

We want to hear your unique voice in your application. We love AI, but relying on it solely to write your cover letter and answer the application questions is a missed opportunity to showcase the originality and personality that will make you stand out. Show us the real you.

Job Description

At Norton Rose Fulbright, people thrive because of a shared commitment to quality, unity and integrity. The highly regarded law firm consistently receives recognition from Great Place to Work and Top Workplaces, two companies that specialize in assessing organizational culture. Teams collaborate across regions, value new ideas and deliver meaningful client solutions, supported by a culture that embraces ambition, development and shared success. With more than 3,000 lawyers and 3,000 business services professionals working together across 50 offices worldwide, this global law firm provides a full range of legal services to leading corporations and financial institutions operating in key markets and sectors.

The Sr. Analyst, HR Technology will support the IT HR Technology Manager and be responsible for designing, configuring, and maintaining solutions across the firm’s HR systems, with a primary focus on the Workday platform, to support business processes and improve organizational efficiency. This position requires strong analytical, technical, and interpersonal skills.

The ideal candidate will bring experience with Workday business process configuration, security, benefits, compensation, functional HR processes, and reporting and analytics. The candidate will partner with business stakeholders to capture requirements, evaluate priorities, and deliver scalable Workday solutions.

This position may work remotely on a regular basis but must be located in a state where we have an established US office. All personnel, absent those with an approved accommodation, are expected to be in the office under certain circumstances, including but not limited to client business needs; firm business travel; participating in firm, group, or team meetings/events; at the request of their supervisor; when needed to serve a client or accomplish a task for the firm that requires in-office attendance, etc. Eligibility for remote work requires you to be in good standing with the firm and may be modified or revoked at the discretion of the firm.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate with HR, IT, Finance, and Infosec teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications
  • Maintain a detailed understanding of current HR systems, their functionality, and their relationship to other information systems within the firm
  • Provide system support and analysis, including functionality and design review, with a strong emphasis on Workday Benefits and Compensation
  • Collaborate with team members to define mapping, scenarios, and testing plans to ensure successful end-to-end process flow
  • Translate HR business needs into end-to-end solutions that align with Workday best practices
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues during implementation and post-go-live, focusing on root cause and preventing repeat problems
  • Stay current on Workday releases, features, and industry practices; proactively recommend improvements and retire legacy solutions when appropriate
  • Support Advanced Compensation process and compensation enhancements
  • Assist subject matter experts with testing of system changes and analyzing data flows for process improvement opportunities
  • Develop, maintain, and support reports using appropriate reporting tools
  • Communicate accurately, promptly, and professionally with employees, managers, and team members
  • Maintain data integrity in systems by running audits and analyzing data
  • Maintain documentation and provide training to end users

Other duties

Please note this job description does not cover or contain all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications and skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field
  • Minimum of four years of experience defining or improving Workday configuration or design standards, especially within the Benefits and Compensation modules
  • Extensive knowledge of Workday architecture, impacts, and security considerations.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and highly collaborative
  • Demonstrated commitment to improving systems, documentation, and processes
  • Additional functional experience in human resources and related functional areas is strongly preferred
  • Must display exceptional judgment and confidentiality
  • Knowledge of SQL and Power BI is a plus
  • Collaborative, supportive, and excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Extremely detail oriented with high standards for accuracy and precision
  • Ability to demonstrate conscientiousness, dedication, and strong working relationships

Benefits

Norton Rose Fulbright US LLP is committed to providing employees with a comprehensive and competitive benefits package that supports you, your health, and your family. Benefit packages include access to three medical insurance plans, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, and disability insurance. Employees can also access pre-tax benefits such as health savings and flexible spending accounts. Norton Rose Fulbright helps provide financial security by allowing employees to participate in a 401(k) savings plan and profit-sharing plans if eligible. Full- time employees are eligible to access fertility benefits designed to support fertility and family-forming journeys. Employees may also access commuter benefits where applicable and student loan assistance refinancing options.

In addition to the Firm’s health and welfare benefits above, we offer a competitive paid time off plan, which provides a minimum of 20 days off based on your role and tenure with the firm. The firm offers a generous paid maternity leave and paid paternity leave (parental leave) benefit allowing parents to take a minimum of 14 weeks of paid leave to bond with your newborn or adopted child(ren). Employees may also access child care support through a back-up care program. Employees are also entitled to 11 Firm holidays.

The information we receive will not be used to make any decision regarding employment and will be kept separate from your application. Acting as a strategic partner to the HR Europe Leader, this role helps translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, coordinates key regional initiatives, and drives the execution of major transformation, organizational effectiveness, and integration programs across Europe. The role serves as a central point of coordination for the European HR Leadership Team, ensuring alignment, governance, and effective delivery of strategic priorities.
The position leads cross-functional HR projects, supports mergers & acquisitions, integrations, and drives organizational effectiveness initiatives that enable business performance and growth. The role also identifies opportunities to improve HR effectiveness through process simplification, analytics, automation, and AI.
This position requires exceptional project management, stakeholder management, and change leadership capabilities, combined with strong business acumen and the ability to operate effectively across multiple countries, cultures, and regulatory environments.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Partner to the HR Europe Leader

  • Act as a trusted advisor and operational partner to the HR Europe Leader, helping drive the execution of the European People Strategy.

  • Support the prioritization, planning, and execution of strategic HR initiatives across Europe.

  • Serve as a key coordination point for the European HR Leadership Team, ensuring alignment, governance, and follow-through on key priorities.

  • Coordinate interactions with Global HR COEs and support the deployment of global initiatives across the region.

  • Identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities requiring leadership attention and propose mitigation plans.

  • Prepare strategic reviews, presentations, and executive materials to support leadership decision-making.

HR Transformation & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Lead HR transformation projects across Europe, ensuring successful implementation of regional and global initiatives.

  • Support organizational design, workforce planning, and right-sizing initiatives in partnership with HR Business Partners and business leaders.

  • Establish governance, project plans, milestones, and success measures for major regional initiatives.

  • Drive change management and stakeholder engagement activities to support successful implementation and adoption of new ways of working.

  • Identify opportunities to improve HR effectiveness through process simplification, analytics, automation, and AI

Mergers, Acquisitions, Integrations & Strategic Projects

  • Lead and coordinate HR workstreams for acquisitions, divestitures, and integration activities across Europe.

  • Coordinate HR due diligence activities, including workforce assessments, organizational analysis, reward practices, employee relations considerations, and cultural diagnostics.

  • Develop and execute integration plans that support business continuity, organizational effectiveness, and successful change adoption.

  • Partner with business leaders, HR teams, and COE to ensure successful post-transaction integration and delivery of expected outcomes.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop a Project Manager supporting the delivery of strategic HR initiatives, transformation projects, and integration activities across Europe.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive HR, consulting, transformation, project management, or organizational effectiveness experience.

  • Experience leading complex, cross-border projects in a multinational environment.

  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, integrations, or major organizational change initiatives.

  • Experience working across multiple European countries, legislations and cultures.

Skills & Competencies

  • Fluency in English and at least one additional European language (ideally German) is required; proficiency in multiple European languages is strongly preferred.

  • Exceptional project and program management skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing capabilities.

  • Ability to navigate complexity and ambiguity.

  • Strategic thinking combined with strong execution discipline.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills.

  • Experience with HR technologies, analytics, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

  • Ability to work effectively with senior leaders and global stakeholders.

​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Bookkeeper

Compensation range: $1,500–$1,800 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with the AU business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: Our client is an Australian-owned business operating in the construction supply sector, providing specialised products, equipment and practical solutions used across concrete and related outdoor construction projects. The business works closely with contractors and industry professionals, with a focus on practical innovation, product reliability and solutions that improve efficiency on site.

Role Overview: We are looking for a genuinely top-level Bookkeeper with exceptional Xero skills and strong Shopify experience to manage day-to-day reconciliation work and maintain accurate financial records. This is a hands-on role for someone with outstanding attention to detail who can work independently and take ownership of their work.

We’re not looking for someone who simply processes transactions. The ideal candidate is commercially minded, understands what the numbers are telling them, can spot discrepancies or potential issues, and takes action rather than waiting to be told what to do. They should be confident questioning unusual transactions, investigating problems and finding practical solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

Bookkeeping & Reconciliation

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations in Xero, including Shopify transactions, payouts and related financial records.
  • Manage the Shopify and Xero integration, ensuring transactions are accurately recorded and reconciled.
  • Handle general ledger allocations, balance sheet reconciliations and month-end reporting, investigating and resolving discrepancies promptly.
  • Manage Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, including supplier invoices, customer payments and outstanding balances.
  • Maintain accurate records across multiple business entities, where applicable.
  • Identify unusual transactions or potential issues, investigate them and take ownership of resolving them.
  • Assist with GST and BAS-related tasks and ensure records are accurate and up to date.
  • Use Excel for financial analysis, reconciliations and reporting as required.

Payroll Support

  • Assist with payroll processing for factory and office staff, including timesheets, leave, superannuation, PAYG and STP.
  • Maintain accurate payroll records and assist with resolving payroll discrepancies.

General Finance Support

  • Assist with regular bookkeeping, financial reporting and other day-to-day finance tasks.
  • Work closely with the Office Manager on financial matters and accounting requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve bookkeeping processes, accuracy and efficiency.

Requirements

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Advanced Xero expertise (non-negotiable)
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify and Xero integration
  • Ideally 5+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping experience
  • Proven experience supporting Australian businesses or clients
  • Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and initiative
  • Experience managing multiple business entities
  • Strong experience in Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, bank reconciliations, and general ledger management
  • Experience with Australian GST (Goods and Services Tax), BAS (Business Activity Statements), and payroll
  • Experience with month-end reporting and balance sheet reconciliations
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Excellent organisational and time-management skills
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone with strong bookkeeping skills, a sharp eye for detail, and a high level of accuracy. The ideal candidate should be confident working independently, take ownership of their work, and be proactive in identifying and resolving issues.

We’re looking for someone who is resourceful, thinks on their feet, and doesn’t simply process numbers without questioning them. If something doesn’t reconcile, they investigate it. If a transaction looks unusual, they look into it. If they spot a potential problem, they address it before it becomes an issue for management.

Most importantly, this person should take genuine pride in accuracy, accountability, and getting the details right.

Why Join Us

  • Work directly with an Australian business
  • 100% remote work from the Philippines
  • Full-time independent contractor role
  • Opportunity to work in a role focused on quality and accuracy

Work Arrangement & Expectations:

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

To ensure alignment and transparency, successful candidates will be expected to:

  • Disclose any existing ongoing roles or client work
  • Reflect this engagement on their LinkedIn profile (clearly marked as “Independent Contractor”)

raw.title: Director, Clinician Engagement
raw.excerpt: Position Summary Clinician Engagement is a new function at DataSpring, created to deepen the relationship between DataSpring and the clinicians and provider organizations who contribute to and rely on our data.
raw.description:
Position Summary
Clinician Engagement is a new function at DataSpring, created to deepen the relationship between DataSpring and the clinicians and provider organizations who contribute to and rely on our data. The function exists to increase trust and positive perception within the clinician user community, improve the quality of the data clinicians provide, and grow the volume of clinicians in our database, including the number who are active and attested.

The Director, Clinician Engagement leads this function. The position builds and stewards the forums where clinicians and provider staff shape our direction, develops partnerships with the provider organizations clinicians already trust, and serves as DataSpring's internal subject matter expert on clinician perspective. The role accelerates the reach and credibility of work already underway across Marketing, Product, and Insights by bringing clinician voice and clinician relationships to it.

This is role spans strategy and execution. The Director sets direction and holds the senior relationships, and also does the hands-on work of running councils, managing partner relationships week to week, and synthesizing what clinicians say into direction the rest of the organization can act on. Success depends on convening the right clinicians, earning their sustained participation, and closing the loop so they see their input reflected in what DataSpring builds and says.

The Director, Clinician Engagement is a full-time, remote, exempt position and reports to the Chief Medical Officer. This position will require the ability to travel up to 20% of the time for council meetings, site visits, association events, and industry forums.

Specific Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Input

  • Partner with Marketing and Product Strategy on a shared approach to increasing clinician awareness of and engagement with their clinician profile; in partnership with the CMO, drive strategy and execution on how best to reach specific associations, specialty societies, and clinician segments.
  • Partner with Convening function to provide subject matter expertise and input to agendas and meetings for DataSpring’s advisory councils, including the Provider Advisory Council and new clinician staff workgroup. Support the recruitment of council members who bring specialty society and partner organization relationships alongside clinical credibility.
  • Partner with Marketing to amplify campaigns through clinician and association channels and to strengthen clinician-facing messaging.
  • Partner with Product and Data Quality teams to bring clinician and provider staff needs into design and roadmap decisions.
  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, and Research to understand what additional value DataSpring can provide to clinicians and their staff, in exchange for completing/updating their profiles.
  • Partner with Government & Public Affairs to amplify clinician voice and perspective in DataSpring’s public policy positions, provide clinical subject matter expertise in support of legislative and regulatory analysis, and enhance government and public affairs reach to targeted clinician communities.

Provider Organization Partnerships and Industry Relations

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive clinician engagement strategy to achieve organizational goals and objectives.
  • Build and manage relationships with professional associations, specialty societies, state and national medical associations, health systems, and large group practices.
  • Develop and deliver content that supports the clinician awareness work referenced above, including webinars, podcasts, conference presentations, and partner-facing materials. May include development of continuing education content for clinicians and provider staff, coordinating with partners to deploy.
  • In addition to the CMO, serve as the relationship owner for provider organization partners, representing DataSpring credibly with clinical leadership.
  • Develop and execute co-branded and partner-led approaches that extend the reach of DataSpring programs and campaigns through trusted third-party voices.
  • Coordinate partner campaigns with Marketing from planning through measurement and prepare briefing materials and follow-ups for senior partner conversations.
  • Build and maintain a partnership pipeline with clear prioritization logic, sequencing clinician segments by value to our health plan customers.
  • Negotiate and manage partnership agreements in coordination with Legal, Marketing, Business Development, Product, and other functions as appropriate.

Subject Matter Expertise for Research, Insights, and Thought Leadership

  • Serve as the internal subject matter expert on clinician and practice staff perspective, workflow reality, and what motivates clinician and clinician staff action.
  • Advise DataSpring’s Insights department on research design and interpretation so studies ask the right questions and findings are read correctly in clinician-facing/provider organization context.
  • Support research execution by recruiting participants and reviewing findings for plausibility.
  • Maintain a running view of clinician and provider staff feedback themes across forums, campaigns, and support channels, and package into concise briefs for internal partners.
  • Shape messaging and positioning toward themes that resonate with clinicians, including patient access, directory presence, referral volume, and fewer claim denials.
  • Contribute to and review external thought leadership, including reports, issue briefs, and presentations, and represent DataSpring at clinical, association, and industry forums.

Reporting

  • Define what success looks like and track key performance metrics and clinician engagement metrics covering trust and perception, data quality, and active attested clinician volume. Collaborate with departments that may source data for the metrics (Marketing, Product, etc.).
  • Report on clinician engagement progress and outcomes to the executive leadership team.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None initially. This role is expected to help shape and scale the Clinician Engagement function and may assume responsibility for managing a small team as the function matures

Skills

  • Strategic thinker with the ability to develop and execute innovative initiatives.
  • Strong relationship-building skills with provider organizations, specialty societies, and medical associations.
  • Fluency in the clinician and provider staff experience, including credentialing, attestation, provider directory data, and administrative workflow.
  • Ability to translate qualitative stakeholder input into clear, prioritized recommendations for product, marketing, and research teams.
  • Executive presence and credibility with both clinical leadership and internal executive audiences.
  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to synthesize complex discussion into briefs, PowerPoint presentations, and recommendations.
  • Ability to develop and deliver clinician-facing and clinician-staff facing content, including webinars, presentations, and continuing education materials.
  • Effective at influencing without authority and at building cross-functional support for new initiatives.
  • Strong project management discipline, with comfort operating without established process and building programs from the ground up.
  • Understanding of how clinician sentiment connects to organizational priorities, with the ability to anticipate how input will be used in decisions.
  • Ability to simultaneously manage multiple initiatives and follow work plans.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organizational skills, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong experience in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel; working knowledge of CRM and survey tools is desired.
  • Maintains an intellectual curiosity about how to accomplish goals through stakeholder and industry collaboration.

Experience & Education

  • 10+ years of experience in provider relations, clinician engagement, healthcare operations, medical affairs, professional association management, credentialing, or a related healthcare field, with progressive leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated experience in provider-facing, clinician engagement, medical affairs, association relations, provider network, or healthcare stakeholder management roles.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain relationships with senior clinical stakeholders, provider organizations, and healthcare industry leaders.
  • Experience leading advisory boards, councils, committees, user groups, or similar stakeholder engagement programs.
  • Experience standing up a new function, program, committee, or stakeholder forum strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a health plan, health IT, healthcare data, healthcare services, credentialing, or healthcare association environment preferred.
  • Experience with provider credentialing processes and/or credentialing committees preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business administration, public health, a clinical discipline, or a related field required.
  • Physicians and other licensed clinicians are encouraged to apply; non-clinical candidates with significant experience in credentialing, provider relations, professional associations, or healthcare stakeholder engagement will also be considered.

Clinical Education & Qualifications (Strongly Preferred)

  • Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree preferred.
  • Clinical experience as a physician (MD/DO) or other licensed healthcare professional preferred.
  • Active or previously active, unrestricted clinical licensure preferred.
  • Experience participating in credentialing, peer review, provider governance, medical staff, or quality-related activities preferred.
  • For physician candidates, board certification in a relevant specialty is preferred.
  • Additional certification or education in healthcare management, leadership, or business administration is desirable.

Who We Are

DataSpring is the trusted data connector at the core of healthcare. For more than 25 years, we have powered the industry with the largest and most complete healthcare data foundation in the U.S., including more than 4.8 million provider data records sourced directly from providers and member data representing 75% of covered lives supplied by health plans. By improving how essential information flows across the system, DataSpring helps healthcare operate more efficiently, accurately, and with greater confidence.

What You Get

At DataSpring, you will do meaningful work at the intersection of healthcare, data, and technology, helping solve complex problems that make the healthcare system work better. You will collaborate with experienced professionals who care deeply about accuracy, trust, and meaningful impact in a fully remote environment.

DataSpring offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package for full-time employees, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) with company contributions and matching, paid parental leave, tuition assistance, and generous paid time off. We are committed to investing in our people and supporting professional growth over time.

Equal Opportunity Employer

DataSpring is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering a workplace where all individuals are valued, respected, and empowered.

Employment decisions at DataSpring are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin or ancestry, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, familial status, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, genetic information, source of income, place of residence, or any other characteristic protected by law. DataSpring does not tolerate unlawful discrimination or harassment of any kind.

Applicants have rights under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA),Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO), and the Employee Polygraph Protection Act (EPPA). If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a posted position, please contact the DataSpring People & Culture team at or 202-517-0436.

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:
The Senior Regulatory Counsel is a legal and compliance partner across CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM), with a primary focus on mortgage origination. The role provides legal research and regulatory guidance, gives legal support to the regulatory change function, and supervises a junior attorney. This role turns legal and regulatory requirements into practical guidance, policies, procedures, and business and system requirements. The Senior Regulatory Counsel plays a key role in CCM’s compliance program.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Research and analyze federal and state laws and regulations affecting CCM’s business activities.
  • Provide clear, practical legal advice and recommendations to leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Prepare legal memoranda and written analyses on complex regulatory and compliance matters.
  • Interpret new and amended regulatory requirements and determine how they apply to CCM.
  • Partner with the regulatory change implementation function on impact assessments and communication of regulatory change to business units.
  • Support implementation of regulatory changes, including updates to policies and procedures.
  • Review and resolve escalated legal and compliance matters from the compliance inbox.
  • Evaluate borrower rescission requests and advise on required actions and timing.
  • Advise on post-closing compliance matters, including corrective actions, cures, and remediation.
  • Support power-of-attorney and trust reviews for loan transactions.
  • Manage and prioritize legal and compliance origination issues, as identified.
  • Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical, risk-based guidance for business partners.
  • Turn regulatory requirements into business and system requirements, controls, and processes for Encompass, Mavent, and other platforms.
  • Supervise, train, and mentor a junior attorney, including assigning work and reviewing work product.
  • Partner with the EVP, Regulatory Counsel on complex regulatory matters and business challenges.
  • Keep the EVP, Regulatory Counsel informed of significant matters, emerging risks, and priorities, with recommended courses of action.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) and active bar license in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
  • 5+ years of legal or regulatory compliance experience in mortgage lending or financial services.
  • Experience interpreting regulatory changes and advising on their implementation.
  • Experience supervising or mentoring attorneys or compliance professionals, preferred.
  • Extensive knowledge of mortgage origination laws and regulations, including TILA/Regulation Z, RESPA/Regulation X, ECOA/Regulation B, HMDA, FCRA, the SAFE Act, UDAAP, and state lending and licensing requirements.
  • Advanced legal research, analysis, and writing skills, to effectively explain complex legal concepts to business and executive audiences.
  • Skill in converting regulatory requirements into operational and technology requirements.
  • Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Sound judgment to effectively manage a high volume of matters and competing deadlines.
  • Excellent collaboration, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with loan origination systems, Encompass preferred.
  • Experience with compliance technology such as Mavent.

EnsoData

EnsoData strives to make healthcare more accurate, efficient, and affordable through waveform artificial intelligence (AI) technology. Using AI and machine learning, our software analyzes billions of data points collected from sensors placed throughout the human body. Our first solution, EnsoSleep, reduces the time clinicians spend analyzing, scoring and managing sleep studies. This results in a simplified and accelerated patient testing, diagnosis, and treatment workflow. Our AI-powered technology has the capability of informing health decisions beyond sleep medicine, from monitoring patient health in the ICU or through wearables, to detecting and capturing seizure data, to providing earlier detection of heart disease, diabetes, stroke, and Alzheimer’s.

The Role

Hi, I'm Jon, the Regional Sales Director (RSD) for the eastern US at EnsoData! We're excited to announce that we're looking for an Account Executive based in Philadelphia, PA. We are looking for a self-starter who is eager to contribute to the growth of our business dedicated to improving healthcare. This person will be focused on growing the EnsoHST solution to all sleep, and referring physicians. This remote position offers the following compensation:

  • Base salary: $90,000
  • At plan: $220,000
  • New hire guarantees for the first six months
  • Bonus potential after annual target is reached
  • Uncapped commissions
  • Stock options
  • Additional benefits such as paid time off, healthcare insurance, and parental leave.

The company is based in Madison, Wisconsin but the territories are field based and this territory primarily covers central and eastern Pennsylvania, central and south New Jersey, and Delaware.

This person will have the following responsibilities to name a few:

  • Plan to be on the road and hunting!
  • Strive to exceed the monthly revenue quota
  • Identify prospective customers, generate and convert leads to sales; collaborate with new and existing customers to identify needs and sell solutions
  • Coordinate the sales process with marketing and the Sales Solutions Engineer (demonstrations)
  • Negotiate contracts and pricing with the RSD and/or CCO

  • Partner with Marketing and others to develop and refine sales and marketing strategies
  • Represent EnsoData at shows and, as needed, travel for onsite demonstrations

Requirements

  • Experience working with CRM like HubSpot or Salesforce
  • Hunter mindset with creative thinking

  • Experience working with remote and hybrid office/remote teams
  • Desire to contribute to building groundbreaking technologies to make healthcare more efficient, affordable, and effective
  • Personal qualities of integrity, perseverance, and commitment to the mission

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree is strongly preferred but other degrees will be considered
  • Previous experience in sleep medicine, specifically home sleep testing sales
  • Previous experience at a startup, tech, software engineering, or similar company

Please note that candidates who do not live in the territory area will not be considered.

Company Culture - Embrace the Pineapple!

How do we do this?

  • Make Healthcare Better - is passionate about moving healthcare to a better place for everyone everywhere
  • Put Customers First - delights customers by working closely with them to support their initiatives

  • Gets $#!t Done - bias toward action and intrinsically motivated to go above and beyond; demonstrates the ability to work autonomously as well as across teams
  • We also practice a Focus on Quality and look for teammates who don't cut corners and demonstrate integrity and attention to detail

Benefits

The benefits package includes, but is not limited to, the following:

Remote and flexible schedule - we are a remote company with hybrid options and support for flexible schedules! That being said, we have an amazing office headquarters in downtown Madison, WI with views of the capitol that you are welcome to work at anytime. In case you didn't know, Madison has consistently been ranked as one of the top places to live in the US (businessinsider.com, money.com, livability.com)!

Health, dental, and vision insurance with options to choose a plan that fits you and your dependents needs.

401k to help people invest in the future.

Team Summits! We look forward to opportunities to gather in person and enjoy a few days together. We participate in team events and gain some great in-person time. (Hint: check out our blog for info from former team gatherings!)

Position Title:SkillBridge - Data Center Commissioning Field Technician (Nationwide Travel)

Position Location:Remote - work from anywhere in the United States. Must be located near a major airport.

Travel Requirements:Up to 75% domestic travel; relocation may be considered for long-term project needs.

Priority Travel Locations Include:

  • IAD Region (Baltimore, Dulles)

JOB SUMMARY

This opportunity is for Military personnel participating in the Department of Defense SkillBridge Program. Ideally, the SkillBridge will be a minimum of 90 days in length. DLB is able to accommodate up to the full 180-day program and we will consider durations less than 90 days. For more information and to speak with our SkillBridge Specialist, please submit your application and we will be in touch with you within 24 hours to schedule time to connect on the opportunities we have available, the geographic area that you are looking for and your time frame.

The SkillBridge - Data Center Commissioning Field Technician is an entry-level role that builds upon foundational commissioning knowledge while introducing more independent troubleshooting, testing, and reporting responsibilities. This role provides technical support in the inspection, validation, and functional testing of electrical, mechanical, and control systems.

The SkillBridge - Data Center Commissioning Field Technician will develop a deeper understanding of commissioning procedures, engage with vendors and project teams, will rely on instructions and take ownership of specific testing tasks under immediate supervision. They are expected to demonstrate increasing autonomy, problem-solving skills, and initiative in executing commissioning tasks.

The SkillBridge - Data Center Commissioning Field Technician will rely on instructions and pre-established guidelines to perform the functions of the job. Works under immediate supervision.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals and values, as well as departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Perform On-site Inspection, Validation, Testing and Verification of Electrical and Mechanical Equipment (50%)

  • Participate in factory witness testing
  • Observe startup activities
  • Use technical equipment to perform testing
  • Perform functional testing of equipment and electrical, mechanical and controls systems
  • Troubleshoot system components

Develop Testing Plans and Procedures (20%)

  • Assist in the development of commissioning plans
  • Prepare pre-functional checklists
  • Prepare functional performance test scripts

Review Construction Related Design Documents, Drawings and Specifications (15%)

  • Review shop drawings and submittals
  • Review sequence of operations
  • Assist in commissioning focused design reviews

Reporting (10%)

  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Assist in preparation and contributes to final commissioning report
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency (5%)

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (BEGINNER LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)

  • Must be a current participant of the Department of Defense SkillBridge Program
  • Knowledge of electrical, mechanical and controls system principles
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment thru effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to achieve certification for NFPA70E and / or OSHA training as / if required
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 75%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and ability to rent vehicles.
  • Must be located near a major airport.
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.
  • Potential for international assignments.
  • Potential relocation opportunities may exist per project needs.

CERTIFICATIONS REQUIRED

  • Must be able to obtain NFPA 70E / OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certifications as required.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related discipline.

OR

  • A minimum of two years’ experience with installation, hands-on testing, validation and troubleshooting of mechanical, controls and / or electrical infrastructure.

Growth Pathway from Technician II

This role provides a structured learning path to progress into:
Technician III (Level 3, Step 1-4) – increased level of independent work and technical problem-solving.

WHAT YOU WILL GAIN IN THIS DOD SKILLBRIDGE PROGRAM WITH DLB:

  • Learn how your military experience translates into a rewarding civilian career.
  • Explore a career or industry you might want to pursue upon separation from active duty.
  • Earn real-world industry qualifications and certifications.
  • Build experience and competency in your trade/ profession with our team.
  • Expand your professional network of contacts.
  • Gain familiarity with corporate culture.

BENEFITS

  • This is a military transitional program that does not provide compensation through DLB. If selected for full-time employment with DLB upon completion of SkillBridge you will be eligible for a very competitive benefits package; highlights include:
  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Health reimbursement account (HRA), flex spending accounts (FSA)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26
  • 401k with company match and self-directed brokerage account option
  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage
  • Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance
  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment

CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is DLB's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location.

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:

The Coding Advocate will handle medical coding and data entry / abstraction for Hospital (Acute) Out-Patient visits. Specifically, will code Emergency Room (E.R.) cases. Additionally, this individual will use the 3M 360 Encoder HDM to streamline the coding/billing process.


These Goals and objectives are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed; employees will be required to perform other job related duties as required. Goals and objectives are subject to change.


All activities must be in compliance with Equal Employment Opportunity laws, HIPAA, ERISA and other regulations, as appropriate.


Essential Functions: In addition to working as prescribed in our Performance Factors specific responsibilities of this role include:

  • Inpatient: Accurately assigns ICD-10-CM and PCS primary and secondary diagnoses and procedure codes based on the documentation in the record and in accordance with the site specific guidelines and policies. Accurate assignment of the DRG.
  • Ability to create compliant physician queries.
  • Accurately review claims for medical necessity.
  • Update problem lists consistent with client contract.
  • Correctly assign present on admission indicators.
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service to our clients and teammates.
  • Consistently demonstrates an excellent attitude, and works to strengthen the team as a whole.
  • Floats between multiple sites, and coding specialties with ease and flexibility.

Minimum Requirements:

Education/Experience/Certification Requirements

  • 2 year degree or equivalent experience; AHIMA or AAPC certification REQUIRED.
  • Actively holds one or more of the following credentials: RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CPC, COC
  • Experience coding Emergency Room cases REQUIRED.
  • Experience working with 3M 360 Encoder HDM REQUIRED.
  • Meets or exceeds Quality and Productivity standards.
  • Excellent communication (written and oral) and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time-management skills.
  • Must be detail oriented and able to follow through on issues to resolution.
  • Must be able to act both independently, and as a team member.

  • Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time-management skills.
  • Must be detail oriented and able to follow through on issues to resolution.

Want to work with cutting-edge technologies on long-term, strategic projects that combine Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Edge AI, and IoT? 🚀🤖🚜

At Marvik, we are leading the next evolution of smart machinery—integrating vision capabilities, real-time image processing, and multi-sensor fusion into physical products operating in real environments.

🌟 What do we offer?:

  • Challenging, real-world projects: Work on stuff other people only read about—bringing AI out of the cloud and straight into physical, intelligent machinery.

  • State-of-the-art tech stack: Optimize and deploy cutting-edge Computer Vision and Deep Learning models on Edge devices.

  • Strategic growth: Join an expanding team with huge potential for long-term ownership, leadership, and professional development.

  • Great team culture: Excellent work environment full of highly motivated, collaborative, and talented professionals who elevate each other.

  • Global exposure & On-site experiences: Opportunity to travel internationally to work directly with clients.

  • Flexible work style: Opportunity to work remotely with global, high-impact clients.

🧑🏻‍💻 Responsibilities:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of Machine Learning models, moving them beyond training and ensuring reliable deployment in production on physical hardware.

  • Design, build, and optimize real-time AI pipelines, integrating foundation models, sensor and application data, and scalable inference workflows.

  • Optimize inference performance, memory usage, and execution speed for Edge AI platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, embedded platforms).

  • Collaborate directly with clients and cross-functional engineering teams, building trust, proposing proactive solutions, and maintaining smooth technical communication.

  • Debug, monitor, and maintain production models operating continuously under real-world hardware constraints.

🤝 If you have:

  • Strong experience bringing AI to production: It’s not just about training models—you know how to make them run reliably in real-world environments.

  • Solid background in AI & Deep Learning, including experience with LLMs, Computer Vision, multimodal models, model optimization, and efficient inference.

  • Edge AI & Embedded exposure: Experience optimizing models for constrained devices (TensorRT, ONNX, OpenCV, C++, or Python).

  • Strong Ownership & Soft Skills: Highly collaborative, proactive, independent, and clear in technical communication. A team player who builds trust with clients and peers.

  • Advanced English level: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact directly with international client teams.

  • Required tools: Python, C++, PyTorch/TensorFlow, OpenCV, Docker, Git.

🦾It’s a major plus:

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Jetson, ROS/ROS2, or embedded hardware platforms.

  • Experience in domains such as Robotics, IoT, Drones, Automotive, or Industrial Machinery.

  • Knowledge of sensor fusion (IMU, cameras, LiDAR) or OTA (Over-The-Air) updates and Cloud IoT architectures (AWS/Azure IoT).

About

H+O Structural Engineering specializes in mid-rise, high-rise and large scale building design. We're building a national company, serving architects and real estate developers across the US.

﻿Our mission is simple: A Better Experience. For our team. For our clients.

﻿

﻿﻿﻿We're building a software platform that connects BIM tools (like Revit) with structural analysis engines, automating the slow, manual data exchange that structural engineers deal with today. Think of it as the interoperability layer for modern structural design — making building data flow seamlessly across the tools engineers use every day.

﻿﻿

Role

﻿﻿This is a fully remote, full-time 1099 independent contractor role. You'll be joining a distributed team of collaborators across multiple time zones, working on meaningful problems at the intersection of software and structural engineering. We're looking for someone who thrives in an async-friendly environment and communicates well across a global team.

Candidates must be available to work a full 8-hour day within the 5:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST window.

Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain **WPF desktop applications** using a **strict MVVM architecture**
- Design clean, reusable **Views, ViewModels, and DataTemplates**
- Design and implement **2D and 3D viewports**
- Build **state-driven UIs** for complex engineering workflows
- Integrate UI with **.NET backend services and external systems**
- Ensure **correct command behaviour** (enable/disable, async execution, UI state)
- Improve **performance, responsiveness, and consistency of the UI layer**
- Collaborate with UI/UX designers while following the design language
- Collaborate closely with engineers on domain-specific workflows﻿

﻿Requirements

- Solid experience with **C# and .NET**

  • Strong understanding of **WPF** (Bindings, Styles, Templates, Resources)
    - Practical experience with **MVVM** (e.g. CommunityToolkit.Mvvm or similar)
    - Ability to build UI with **clear separation of concerns**
    - Experience with **dependency injection and application composition** (e.g. Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting)
    - Experience with **data-driven UIs** and complex state management
    - Ability to work across different UI paradigms (desktop and web)
    ﻿-﻿Comfortable working asynchronously with a globally distributed remote team
    ﻿-﻿Reliable availability for a full 8-hour workday within the 5:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST window
    -﻿﻿Full professional fluency in English, as this role involves frequent written and verbal collaboration across a distributed team

﻿﻿

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with [ASP.NET]() Core or Blazor (or other web UI technologies)
- Experience with **engineering, CAD, or BIM-related software**
- Experience working with **3D data or visualisation (e.g. viewports, geometry, CAD-like systems)**
- Familiarity with **performance-sensitive desktop applications**
- Interest in **structural or architectural workflows**﻿

Additional Information
﻿- ﻿This is a 1099 contractor position. Independent Contractors are responsible for their own insurance, health coverage, tax reporting, and more.

H+O is committed to equal opportunity and inclusive hiring practices. We celebrate diversity and encourage qualified applicants from all backgrounds to apply.﻿﻿
