raw.description:
Привіт, ми — Brainstack, українська мультипродуктова IT-компанія.

Якщо ти шукаєш простір можливостей для постійного масштабування і любиш задачі із зірочкою — тоді тобі до нас. Тут ти знайдеш виклики, які допоможуть реалізувати твої амбіції, створити профітні бізнеси без ілюзій і перетворити ідеї на успішні IT-продукти. А команда тебе завжди підтримає і не залишить наодинці з челенджами.

У нашому портфоліо — mobile- та web-застосунки і сервіси з мільйонною аудиторією, що охоплюють різні ніші: Health & Wellness, Mental Health, Astrology, AI, Utilities, Parental Control. А також розвиваємо власний R&D-центр.

Шукаємо Treasury & Finance Operations Specialist у нашу фінансову команду.

Що тебе чекає:

→ Робота з міжнародними банками та фінансовими установами й можливість поглиблювати експертизу в Treasury Operations;

→ Залученість до управління грошовими потоками групи компаній, роботи з різними валютами та платіжними інструментами;

→ Поєднання казначейських операцій, фінансового планування та супроводу виплат співробітникам і підрядникам;

→ Можливість впливати на вдосконалення фінансових процесів і розвиватися всередині фінансового департаменту.

Про тебе:

  • Досвід роботи у сфері фінансів, казначейства, банківських операцій або Finance Operations;

  • Розуміння принципів роботи з банківськими рахунками, проведення платежів і взаємодії з фінансовими установами;

  • Досвід роботи з платіжними системами, банківськими кабінетами та фінансовою документацією;

  • Впевнене володіння Excel або Google Sheets: робота з формулами, зведеннями, пошуком і консолідацією даних;

  • Аналітичне мислення та розуміння принципів планування й контролю грошових потоків;

  • Уважність до деталей під час перевірки платіжних реквізитів, документів і фінансових даних;

  • Високий рівень самоорганізації, відповідальність, самостійність і вміння працювати з кількома паралельними процесами;

  • Англійська мова на рівні, достатньому для ділового листування та комунікації з іноземними фінансовими установами.

Буде перевагою:

  • Досвід відкриття та супроводу рахунків юридичних осіб у міжнародних банках і фінансових установах;

  • Досвід роботи з мультивалютними рахунками, міжнародними платежами та різними платіжними провайдерами;

  • Розуміння банківських compliance-процедур, KYC/AML-запитів і проходження періодичних банківських рев'ю;

  • Досвід планування cash flow та консолідації платіжних даних за компаніями, валютами й фінансовими установами;

  • Досвід роботи з Jira та HR-системами;

  • Розуміння процесів супроводу ФОП і фрілансерів, розрахунку винагород, податкових зобов'язань і підготовки первинної документації.

Про твої задачі:

  • Treasury & Account Opening: відкриття банківських рахунків компаній групи, вибір фінансових установ і комунікація з ними;

  • Payment Operations: обробка заявок у Jira, проведення платежів, перевірка документів і реквізитів, підготовка банківських виписок;

  • Banking Compliance: комунікація з банками, підготовка інформації на їхні запити та супровід банківських рев'ю;

  • Cash Flow Planning: консолідація платіжних даних, щотижневе планування та оптимізація грошових потоків групи компаній;

  • Payment Support: супровід тестових карток, оновлення платіжних реквізитів провайдерів;

  • Employee & PE Support: супровід відкриття та закриття ФОП, комунікація зі співробітниками й облік іноземних ФОП;

RealTime eClinical Solutions is a Global Leader and rapidly growing SaaS technology company that provides comprehensive Software Solutions to the clinical research industry.

Our Vision is to reshape the global clinical research industry with innovative solutions that help advance medicine and save lives. Our cloud-based solutions are dedicated to solving complex problems and simplifying clinical research processes to be more organized, efficient, and cost-effective. We are based in San Antonio, TX, but we're truly a remote, telecommuting company.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Product Owner is responsible for translating prioritized product initiatives and epics into well-defined functional and technical requirements that enable efficient and predictable delivery by engineering teams. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and Quality, the Product Owner ensures that product initiatives are decomposed into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation that allow development teams to execute effectively.

This role serves as the operational bridge between product strategy and engineering execution. The Product Owner owns backlog quality and delivery readiness for their assigned product domain or engineering team, ensuring that stories entering development are well understood, actionable, and aligned with product objectives. The Product Owner plays a key role in maintaining backlog health, supporting agile delivery practices, and enabling consistent, high-quality product releases.

WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?

  • Translate prioritized product initiatives and epics into detailed functional and technical requirements, including user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Maintain and manage the product backlog for assigned product areas or engineering teams, ensuring items are clearly defined, prioritized, and ready for development
  • Partner closely with Product Managers to ensure product strategy and roadmap initiatives are accurately reflected in backlog priorities and delivery plans
  • Work collaboratively with Engineering, Design, and Quality teams to clarify requirements, answer questions, and support effective implementation of product functionality
  • Lead or facilitate backlog refinement sessions to ensure stories meet established Definition of Ready standards before sprint planning
  • Ensure functional and technical documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with delivered product functionality
  • Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to support effective agile delivery practices
  • Collaborate with QA and engineering teams to ensure acceptance criteria are clearly defined, and solutions meet expected functionality and quality standards
  • Identify and communicate risks, dependencies, or ambiguities that could impact delivery timelines or solution quality
  • Support continuous improvement of delivery processes, documentation practices, and backlog management standards within the Product Delivery organization
  • 25% of your time may include travel for client visits, conferences, and networking

WHAT DO YOU NEED?

  • 2–5 years of experience in a product, business analysis, delivery, or technical role within a SaaS or technology environment
  • Experience working with agile development teams and familiarity with Scrum or similar iterative delivery frameworks
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business or product requirements into clear functional specifications or user stories
  • Strong organizational and analytical skills with attention to detail in documentation and requirements definition
  • Experience working with tools such as JIRA or similar backlog management platforms
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product Management, Engineering, and Design
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

WHAT SETS YOU APART?

  • Prior experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, QA analyst, or similar delivery-focused role
  • Familiarity with backlog refinement, sprint planning, and agile delivery ceremonies
  • Experience supporting software development teams delivering SaaS or enterprise software solutions
  • Experience working in regulated or complex product environments (e.g., life sciences, financial services, healthcare, enterprise SaaS)
  • Exposure to API-based systems, integrations, or platform-oriented products
  • Experience contributing to documentation, testing support, or release readiness activities within a product development lifecycle

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU?

  • The company sponsors health insurance, long-term disability, and life insurance.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • 10 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Work Anniversary Bonus.
  • Participation in the Employee of the Quarter Program.
  • Monthly $100 Connectivity Stipend Reimbursement.
  • RealTime matches employee 401K contributions at 100% of the first 3% invested and 50% of the next 2% invested.

All successful candidates must complete and pass reference and background checks.

The pay rate is commensurate with experience and is determined on an individual basis after an interview has occurred.

Job Position: Content & Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Company: Pro Coffee Gear

Location: Remote (Anywhere)

Full - Time

About Us: Pro Coffee Gear is a thriving e-commerce company located on our scenic 20-acre ranch in Austin, Texas. We specialize in providing top-tier espresso machines and related parts to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond our products; we're committed to building a talented team that shares our passion for coffee and exceptional customer service.

Job Description:

We’re looking for a Content & Lifecycle Marketing Manager who can own the full storytelling engine of our brand across email, lifecycle flows, content strategy, and video-first creative.

This role blends creativity with performance: you’ll develop content that grows our audience, produce video and written assets that educate and inspire, and build lifecycle marketing programs that turn first-time buyers into loyal customers.

You’ll be at the center of how we communicate with customers from discovering us on social or through content, to browsing the site, to making a purchase, to coming back again.

If you love coffee, content, and building a brand people truly connect with, you’ll thrive here.

What You’ll Own

Email & Lifecycle Marketing (40%)

  • Own the full email and SMS strategy and calendar (campaigns + automated flows).
  • Develop segmentation and personalization strategies to increase LTV and retention.
  • Build and refine lifecycle programs:
    • Abandoned browse & cart
    • Post-purchase education
    • Loyalty & VIP
    • Winback
    • Welcome/onboarding

  • D

    esign A/B tests to optimize creative, messaging, and conversion.
  • Partner with Growth to align emails with product launches and promotions.

Content Strategy & Development (40%)

  • Own the overall content calendar across social, email, landing pages, and UGC.
  • Create high-quality content that connects with coffee enthusiasts and café owners.
  • Write scripts, website copy, blogs, landing page messaging, and content briefs.
  • Build content pillars that establish authority: education, how-to guides, product reviews, comparison content, café buildout content, etc.
  • Collaborate with product and growth teams to develop messaging for launches, events, and campaigns.

Video Production & UGC/Creator Support (20%)

  • Plan, script, shoot, and edit short-form videos (IG Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts).
  • Capture product demos, educational content, behind-the-scenes footage, and story-driven content.
  • Create UGC-style content to support paid ads, social media, and email.
  • Coordinate with influencer/UGC creators and edit/repurpose their content.

What Success Looks Like

  • Email and SMS become one of the company’s top revenue channels.
  • Strong, consistent storytelling across channels that elevates the brand.
  • Clear, engaging video content that boosts engagement, conversions, and trust.
  • Lifecycle flows that increase repeat purchase rate and average order value.
  • UGC and content that improves paid ad performance and lowers CAC.
  • A content engine that supports sales, SEO, and product launches.

What You Bring

  • 4-6 years of experience in DTC/e-commerce marketing, content, or lifecycle marketing.
  • You are an amazing writer
  • Demonstrated experience running email campaigns and automated flows in tools like Klaviyo, Shopify or HubSpot.
  • Strong writing skills from conversion-focused copy to brand storytelling.
  • Experience producing and editing video content (e.g., short-form vertical).
  • You are experienced in content email, especially in creating engaging content.
  • Ability to manage content calendars across channels with consistency.
  • Comfortable with basic analytics (GA4, Klaviyo dashboards, attribution tools).
  • Highly organized, proactive, and energized by a fast-paced growth environment.
  • No need for management experience
  • Bonus: experience with SEO content, influencer/UGC management, or coffee industry background.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • You’re building the content and lifecycle foundation of a rapidly scaling brand.

  • Standing up new process and tools for things like SMS marketing.

  • Direct ownership, autonomy, and creative freedom.
    A passionate community of coffee pros and home enthusiasts.

  • Your work directly influences how customers learn, engage, and fall in love with our brand.

How to Apply

Send us:

  • Your resume

  • 2-3 writing samples or email/flow examples

  • A portfolio is mandatory to apply for this role : )

Analyze, Install, Configure, Troubleshoot

  • Proven Deal Track Record: Demonstrated success securing high-value new logos and enterprise brand partnerships, ideally within an emerging or high-growth ad tech / retail media ecosystem.

  • Client-Facing Excellence: Track record of driving results through high-touch client engagements across in-person pitch meetings, executive presentations, and ongoing partner comms.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of dedicated experience in Retail Media, Performance Marketing or Affiliate ecosystems
  • 10+ years of enterprise client-facing experience managing complex, high-value brand partnerships
  • Proven track record of prospecting, negotiating, and growing relationships with top-tier brand advertisers
  • Experience guiding technical ad sales and integrations
  • Demonstrated capability in building product roadmaps in collaboration with Product and BizOps teams

Category: Mental Healthcare

Location:


Role Overview

We are seeking a strategic, highly organized, and growth-mindedMarketing & Partnership Managerto oversee the promotional and community outreach ecosystem of our US-based clinical practice. In this position, you will be the core driver of our client acquisition pipeline—managing our internal creative marketing team while optimizing paid advertising, digital content, website SEO, and client nurture strategies.

This role balances75% digital marketing strategy/executionwith25% healthcare business development. A cornerstone of this position is leveragingZoho CRMto track the customer journey from clinical intake to client onboarding, manage professional referral pipelines, and translate database insights into actionable growth strategies. If you are a process-driven professional who knows how to utilize CRM structures to optimize digital funnels while comfortably building local clinical relationships and B2B partnerships, we want you on our team.


Key Responsibilities

Clinical Marketing Leadership (75% of Role)

  • CRM Pipeline & Lifecycle Management:Act as the primary manager of our marketing lead flows withinZoho CRM, ensuring accurate tracking of client intake sources, monitoring conversion pipelines, and keeping customer data seamlessly organized for our clinical intake team.

  • Team Management:Oversee and coordinate our internal marketing team (content creators, copywriters), organizing workflows to ensure all social media assets, educational resources, and campaign schedules are cohesive, high-quality, and ethical.

  • Paid Advertising Strategy:Develop, deploy, and optimize paid social media advertising campaigns, utilizing precise US market targeting and messaging to ethically attract individuals seeking care while lowering overall acquisition costs.

  • Content & Intake Funnels:Collaborate with internal specialists to produce mental health/wellness content that builds clinical trust, and guide the email marketing team to craft supportive, informative lead-nurture sequences triggered through our CRM for prospective clients.

  • Web & SEO Technical Oversight:Monitor website health, organic traffic growth, and search engine optimization (SEO) so local individuals seeking care can easily find our practice when searching for relevant symptoms or specialties.

  • Online Reputation Management:Monitor, protect, and actively respond to reviews on major business listing platforms (e.g., Google Business Profile) in accordance with healthcare privacy guidelines.

  • Recruitment Marketing:Partner with clinical leadership to create targeted recruitment campaigns to attract top-tier licensed US therapists, clinicians, and clinical interns.

Clinical Referral & Partnership Development (25% of Role)

  • Referral Network Building:Proactively connect with local medical professionals, general practitioners, school counselors, HR managers, and community stakeholders via local networking, phone, and video conferencing to cultivate robust, long-term B2B referral networks.

  • Data-Backed Outreach:UtilizeZoho CRMaccount management features to track contacts, log communications, and monitor which referral channels are most effective, optimizing partnership efforts toward high-value community networks.

  • Community Outreach Integration:Identify local US alliance, sponsorship, or educational workshop opportunities that align with our active marketing campaigns to seamlessly transition community awareness into reliable, trusted client referral streams.


Performance Success Metrics (KPIs)

Your performance will be evaluated against a balanced scorecard heavily weighted on your marketing results and clinical partnership output:

  • CRM Data Integrity & Reporting (High Impact):Seamless management of lead statuses withinZoho CRM, ensuring precise visibility into lead tracking, source attribution, and pipeline conversion rates.

  • Ad Performance & Efficiency (High Impact):Cost Per Lead (CPL) and Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) efficiency for paid campaigns.

  • Funnel Health (High Impact):Website conversion rates (visitors turning into booked intakes) and organic search traffic growth for local mental health terms.

  • Referral Network Output (High Impact):Volume of qualified client inquiries or direct intakes generated via professional partner networks and newly secured B2B clinical stakeholders per quarter.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • Proven Experience:3–5+ years of digital marketing experience, ideally within healthcare, mental health, wellness, or clinical business environments operating inside the US market.

  • CRM Proficiency:Strong familiarity withZoho CRM(managing layouts, lead scoring, deal pipelines, and views) to structure and track marketing and referral pipelines.

  • The Zoho Advantage (Highly Valued):Direct experience setting up advancedZoho Automations/Workflows, utilizingZoho SalesIQfor visitor tracking/live chat engagement, or building reporting dashboards inZoho Analyticsis a significant added advantage.

  • Compliance Knowledge:Basic familiarity with US healthcare standards (such as HIPAA considerations regarding public marketing, client reviews, and data handling).

  • Relationship Driven:Excellent interpersonal communication skills with a natural ability to pitch partnerships, network comfortably with medical/clinical professionals, and represent the practice in the local community.

  • Technical Savvy:Solid understanding of Google Analytics, local SEO fundamentals, and email automation tools.

  • Monthly Health Stipend

The Hanover’s Specialty General Liability team is seeking a Senior Underwriting Specialist with high hazard product liability experience to join its growing and dynamic team. The Specialty GL team provides admitted primary and supported excess solutions to clients with challenging product liability exposures. At The Hanover, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where all voices are valued. We actively seek top talent from all backgrounds and encourage qualified professionals to apply. We believe that diversity strengthens our organization and fosters a more vibrant community. Recognizing the evolving nature of work, we support flexible arrangements. This role may be hybrid or fully remote, with occasional travel to key specialty locations. While we prefer candidates based in Georgia, Illinois, Arizona, Texas, Seattle, or Colorado we welcome qualified applicants from across the country. The actual job title and level may be flexible dependent on candidate qualifications and experience (Underwriting Specialist)

THIS IS A FULL-TIME, EXEMPT ROLE.

Position Overview: Responsible for identifying, soliciting, underwriting, and selling new and renewal accounts that drive profitable growth and align with the units appetite and growth goals. Apply advanced technical, sales and analytical skills to provide insurance solutions that help Hanover’s customers manage risk. Demonstrates a thorough understanding of Hanover’s strategies and appetites and will use internal and external data to make appropriate individual and portfolio risk decisions. Operates within a broad Letter of Authority for all underwriting decisions and with limited direction while managing an assigned book of business, generally with high technical complexity and coordination.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

Technical Underwriting:

  • Knows and applies underwriting concepts including risk selection, exposure and hazard identification and control, coverage implications, and loss analysis.
  • Uses all appropriate underwriting tools, disciplines and strategies to ensure underwriting guidelines are followed.
  • Understands pricing components and rating methodology and correlates pricing to exposures
  • When presented with minimal information on a risk, instinctively knows the key questions to ask to ascertain the full scope of operations and the key exposures and needed controls.
  • Completes file documentation according to best practices guidelines and can clearly explain account decisions.
  • Provides clear and concise rating instructions for quotes prior to generating proposal for presentation to the agent.

Portfolio Management & Financial Acumen:

  • Manages assigned portfolio to achieve gross written premium, profitability, rate, retention, product mix, new business, and portfolio management goals, by use of proven pipeline and marketing practices.
  • Developing an understanding of various financial reporting information and insurance performance measures in the management of risk.
  • Demonstrates an understanding of the market factors that can affect pricing and how it correlates to individuals book, agency’s book, the region, and countrywide.
  • Prepares or analyzes information on underwriting decisions, rate, underwriting requirements, company appetite, status, and declinations to drive results within the assigned territory.
  • Familiarizes oneself with other Hanover departments for leveraging growth in areas of business where portfolio could be more balanced.

Sales Management:

  • Can identify, solicit, pipeline, negotiate, and close accounts aligned with business strategy. Ability to profile assigned agency plant and to strategically market our capabilities to agents.
  • Keeps current on state/territory issues, regulations, and trends.
  • Utilizes market and competitor information to enhance relationships and individual account decision making.
  • Prioritizes and develops effective relationship management and producer activities to build trust, facilitate negotiation, and secure commitment in order to improve yield and retention ratios.
  • Operates with a franchise perspective to identify additional sell opportunities to create growth within other LOB’s and customer segments.
  • Partners with other business units to deliver comprehensive insurance solutions
  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of Hanover’s products and appetite while clearly communicating Hanover’s position at the point of sale.
  • Builds and maintains rigorous sales practices using all systems, sales tools and disciplines outlined in the sales best practices.
  • Makes presentations to agents and customers. Utilize department and Specialty partners to augment sales process. Effectively utilize Claims and Loss Control to display service and/or technical expertise with present and future customers.

Work Location and Arrangement

  • Work location (remote, hybrid, or onsite) is determined by the Company based on role requirements and business needs and may be modified at the Company’s discretion.
  • Certain roles require the ability to perform job duties onsite, including reporting to designated Hanover offices and attending in person meetings, training, or other work related activities, as required by business needs.
  • Travel may be required based on business needs and may vary depending on role demands.
  • The Company’s Flexible Work Arrangement Policy guides flexible work arrangements.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience
  • 5-7+ years Underwriting experience
  • 5-7+ years’ experience driving agency relationships resulting in profitable new and renewal business
  • Proficient in ability to identify, analyze and solve problems and manage and prioritize multiple concurrent projects. Is used as a resource by others to collaborate on more complex risks, pricing, trends, industry segments coverages and product knowledge. May conduct peer-to-peer self-audits under the direction of management.
  • Demonstrates ability to adapt quickly to change, exercise influence, and act as a change advocate being open to new and different ways of thinking.
  • Viewed as an informal leader amongst the team/branch/region. Open to and proactively shares knowledge and expertise with peers, management, and leadership. Acts as a mentor for less experienced underwriters or newly hired underwriters, may assist with training other team members
  • Communication - Interacts and communicates with confidence with all levels of external and/or internal business partners within scope of responsibility, team, and/or matrix environment. Can judge appropriate means and methods to communicate based on the nature of the communication. Able to influence desired outcomes to drive actions and results. Adept at influencing even when holding a position contrary to the majority opinion.
  • Judgement and Decision Making - Ability to exercise judgment, negotiate and make sound business decisions based on level of authority. Applies judgment and expertise to determine when escalation is needed. Demonstrates confidence in one’s ability to apply decision making to UW assessment.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration – Consistently fosters collaboration and respect among team members. Easily adapts to the diverse interests, styles, and perspective of key players. Is able to engage multiple members of a group to share information and to consider other points of view to reach objectives, consensus, and/or deadlines. Experienced in working with a wide range of teams and readily shares lessons learned.

CAREER DEVELOPMENT:

It’s not just a job, it’s a career, and we are here to support you every step of the way. We want you to be successful and fulfilled. Through on-the-job experiences, personalized coaching and our robust learning and development programs, we encourage you – at every level – to grow and develop.

raw.description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About the Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

Job Description:

The role is accountable for implementation delivery from initial planning through to configuration, integration, testing, launch, hyper care, and transition. By establishing clear standards, governance, and operating practices, the Director will ensure complex programs are delivered with appropriate visibility, control, and focus on client business outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings enterprise SaaS implementation leadership, strong client-facing experience, and an understanding of loyalty, eCommerce, grocery, or retail operations. They will serve as a trusted advisor to client executives, a senior escalation point for strategic engagements, and a key partner to Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Partnerships leadership.

This leader will build and develop a high-performing delivery team while advancing CORA Loyalty's implementation methodology, automation capabilities, and use of AI-enabled tools. The role will strengthen delivery consistency, improve operational efficiency, accelerate time to value, and create a more scalable implementation model.

Key Performance Indicators: Success in this role will be measured against the following:

  • Implementation Cycle Time
  • Scope Control
  • Milestone Performance and On-Time Go-Live %
  • Client Adoption
  • First-Time Right Implementation
  • Customer Health After Hypercare
  • Utilization
  • Delivery Margin

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Delivery Excellence

  • Set and uphold the strategic direction for CORA Loyalty's Delivery and Implementation function.
  • Build and scale the program delivery capability required to support complex and strategically significant engagements.
  • Own the Client Implementation Methodology including delivery playbooks, governance, templates, reusable assets, onboarding standards, launch readiness, and transition to Customer Success.
  • Establish measurable delivery standards and KPIs focused on quality, client adoption, operational efficiency, financial performance, and team development.
  • Advance the use of AI to improve implementation planning, project delivery, documentation, testing, client enablement, and operational reporting while maintaining appropriate governance and quality standards.
  • Develop and maintain reusable implementation assets—including templates, automation, AI-assisted tooling, integration patterns, configuration libraries, and delivery playbooks—to improve implementation quality, consistency, and time-to-value.
  • Drive continuous improvement across implementation processes, governance, and operating practices.

Client Leadership & Program Delivery

  • Serve as senior sponsor and escalation point for strategic and high-risk client implementations.
  • Build trusted relationships with client sponsors, operational leaders, technology stakeholders, and executive teams.
  • Ensure client objectives, adoption goals, business outcomes, and success measures are clearly defined and managed throughout each engagement.
  • Provide executive oversight of complex deployments and personally lead or support the most strategically significant programs.
  • Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, issue resolution, and executive communication across the implementation portfolio.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Support to ensure effective transition from implementation to ongoing adoption and value realization.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Solution Consulting to align client expectations, implementation strategy, scope, and success criteria from project inception.

Implementation Governance & Quality

  • Establish and enforce implementation standards across planning, discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, training, launch, and hypercare.
  • Implement governance models that strengthen visibility, accountability, decision-making, risk management, and delivery quality.
  • Maintain executive oversight of program health and ensure delivery gaps are addressed with appropriate speed and rigor.
  • Capture lessons learned and use them to improve frameworks, operating processes, and team capability.

Solution Delivery & Technical Enablement

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of CORA Loyalty platform capabilities, configuration models, integration patterns, and implementation best practices.
  • Provide implementation leadership and coordinate with Product and Engineering on solution architecture, data migration, system configuration, integration strategy, and technical deployment approaches.
  • Coordinate delivery of complex integrations in partnership with Product, Engineering, client technical teams, and third-party vendors.
  • Build organizational capability across implementation tooling, integration patterns, configuration approaches, deployment practices, and client enablement.

Operational & Commercial Leadership

  • Establish operational rhythms including portfolio reviews, delivery forecasting, utilization management, implementation analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor implementation portfolio health through delivery, financial, operational, and client outcome metrics.
  • Oversee implementation forecasting, staffing, utilization, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
  • Support Statements of Work, implementation estimates, change requests, and delivery commitments.
  • Partner with PMO leadership to strengthen governance, forecasting, resource planning, and project execution.
  • Provide executive reporting on implementation performance, client health, delivery risks, capacity, and emerging trends.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Implementation Managers, Program Delivery Leads, Senior Consultants, and Implementation Consultants.
  • Establish clear roles, performance expectations, decision rights, and accountability across the team.
  • Attract, develop, and retain talent with strong delivery, technical, commercial, and client leadership capabilities.
  • Build team capability through structured coaching, training, mentorship, and knowledge-sharing.
  • Partner with leadership on workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, succession planning, and organizational development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, innovation, and strong client focus.

Required Experience and Capabilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Retail Operations, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience leading enterprise software, SaaS, or technology implementations.
  • 3+ years of people-leadership experience managing implementation, consulting, delivery, or professional services teams.
  • Proven experience leading client-facing delivery for complex enterprise customers and managing multiple concurrent implementations.
  • Strong knowledge of SaaS implementation methodologies, program governance, and enterprise software deployment practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risk, scope, timelines, budgets, resource requirements, and client expectations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and executive presentation capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of data architecture, system integrations, APIs, EDI, and enterprise application ecosystems.
  • Loyalty platform experience strongly preferred; familiarity with grocery, retail, or eCommerce operations is an asset.

CareMind, part of the Mindoula Health family is hiring licensed therapists (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) to join our fully remote Suicide Prevention & Family Support Program in Washington.

Compensation: For candidates located in Washington State the pay is $90,000 a year. For candidates located outside of Washington, the salary is $75,000 per year plus excellent benefits and the opportunity to work with a fantastic team.

Comprehensive Benefits Package includes:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Short Term and Long Term Insurance paid by Mindoula
  • 401k, with a company match
  • 3 weeks paid vacation each year, 4 mental wellness days and 11 holidays
  • Parental Leave: 8 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Personal Development Program: $500 credit reimbursement per calendar year

As a Therapist, Suicide Prevention & Family Support (SPFS), you will work in collaborative settings to provide biopsychosocial assessments, individual and group therapy, and work with your team to coordinate care across a range of treatment settings. You will have the ability to manage a caseload and make decisions with appropriate autonomy.

Core Duties:

  • Deliver Family-Centered Psychotherapy: Provide evidence-based individual, joint family, and parent/guardian teletherapy for youth (ages 12–26) at high or critical risk of suicide, utilizing family-systems frameworks, C-CBT, DBT skills, and Motivational Interviewing.
  • Conduct Suicide Risk Assessment & Safety Planning: Administer validated risk assessment tools (e.g., C-SSRS) and lead real-time Safety Planning, lethal means counseling, and crisis stabilization tailored to both the youth and their family unit.
  • Manage Monthly Acuity & Risk Stratification: Complete validated clinical assessments at monthly review periods to measure acuity, track suicide risk trajectory, and dynamically adjust care frequency and treatment goals based on member readiness and family capacity.
  • Lead Clinical Care Team Collaboration: Direct the clinical safety strategy in close partnership with assigned Behavioral Health Support Specialists (BHSS) and the 24/7 crisis response team, ensuring aligned roles without duplicating billable services.
  • Provide Crisis Escalation Response: Serve as the licensed clinician for high-acuity escalations, executing immediate risk mitigation, triage, and rapid safety plan updates during critical member events.
  • Maintain Fee-for-Service & Medicaid Compliance: Complete high-integrity, timely clinical documentation (DAP) that explicitly substantiates medical necessity, suicide risk levels, family interventions, and whole-person care for Medicaid Fee-for-Service (FFS) billing.
  • Drive Multimodal Youth & Family Engagement: Utilize multi-platform engagement technology (video, secure messaging, interactive safety apps) to maintain persistent outreach and re-engage ambivalent youth or overwhelmed caregivers.
  • Integrate Care Infrastructure & Panel Tracking: Actively participate in interdisciplinary huddles, maintain registry accuracy, and monitor personal KPIs (billable hours, documentation turnaround, and show rates) to optimize clinical outcomes across the program panel.
  • Collaborate with the member, family, and healthcare providers to develop an individualized plan of care.
  • Develop and coordinate community resources with emphasis on medical, behavioral, suicide prevention, and social services.
  • Identify and initiate referrals for social service programs – including financial, psycho-social, community, and state supportive services.
  • Document all member assessments, care plans, and referrals provided. Prepare and maintain all required records, reports, paperwork, and member’s diagnostic records, maintaining confidentiality of members at all times.

Skills Required:

  • Relentless about prioritizing and following through on assigned tasks independently. Superior time management and organization to complete daily tasks by the end of each day.
  • Computer proficiency; Including experience with electronic health records (EHR).
  • Ability to exercise strict confidentiality and sound judgment with respect to sensitive member information, maintaining the integrity of member records at all times.
  • Excellent listening, verbal, and written communication skills. Clearly and accurately relay information to staff, business partners, stakeholders, and members including collaborating with interdisciplinary teams (e.g., BHSS).
  • Problem Solving: Identifies needs and takes independent action to implement change when and where it is needed; results oriented. Ability to plan, organize, manage time, and prioritize multiple tasks and assignments.
  • Ability to provide case management in routine and crisis situations.
  • Self-motivated, team player, adaptable with a strong sense of urgency in a fast-paced

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in psychology, social work, or other applicable behavioral health discipline from an accredited college or university is required.
  • Licensure: Current Washington Department of Health (WA DOH) independent behavioral health license. Eligible licenses include:
    • Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW)
    • Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC)
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
  • Two or more years of direct experience working with adolescents and adults in the behavioral health field required. Experience in suicide prevention strongly preferred.
  • Crisis intervention training and experience required.
  • Knowledge of local resources, social determinants of health, mental health, substance use disorders, interpersonal violence, and social issues.
  • Familiarity with Medicare or Medicaid practices preferred

Come be part of the solution!

Salary: $75,000 – $95,000 / year

Job Description:

The role is accountable for implementation delivery from initial planning through to configuration, integration, testing, launch, hyper care, and transition. By establishing clear standards, governance, and operating practices, the Director will ensure complex programs are delivered with appropriate visibility, control, and focus on client business outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings enterprise SaaS implementation leadership, strong client-facing experience, and an understanding of loyalty, eCommerce, grocery, or retail operations. They will serve as a trusted advisor to client executives, a senior escalation point for strategic engagements, and a key partner to Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Partnerships leadership.

This leader will build and develop a high-performing delivery team while advancing CORA Loyalty's implementation methodology, automation capabilities, and use of AI-enabled tools. The role will strengthen delivery consistency, improve operational efficiency, accelerate time to value, and create a more scalable implementation model.

Key Performance Indicators: Success in this role will be measured against the following:

  • Implementation Cycle Time
  • Scope Control
  • Milestone Performance and On-Time Go-Live %
  • Client Adoption
  • First-Time Right Implementation
  • Customer Health After Hypercare
  • Utilization
  • Delivery Margin

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Delivery Excellence

  • Set and uphold the strategic direction for CORA Loyalty's Delivery and Implementation function.
  • Build and scale the program delivery capability required to support complex and strategically significant engagements.
  • Own the Client Implementation Methodology including delivery playbooks, governance, templates, reusable assets, onboarding standards, launch readiness, and transition to Customer Success.
  • Establish measurable delivery standards and KPIs focused on quality, client adoption, operational efficiency, financial performance, and team development.
  • Advance the use of AI to improve implementation planning, project delivery, documentation, testing, client enablement, and operational reporting while maintaining appropriate governance and quality standards.
  • Develop and maintain reusable implementation assets—including templates, automation, AI-assisted tooling, integration patterns, configuration libraries, and delivery playbooks—to improve implementation quality, consistency, and time-to-value.
  • Drive continuous improvement across implementation processes, governance, and operating practices.

Client Leadership & Program Delivery

  • Serve as senior sponsor and escalation point for strategic and high-risk client implementations.
  • Build trusted relationships with client sponsors, operational leaders, technology stakeholders, and executive teams.
  • Ensure client objectives, adoption goals, business outcomes, and success measures are clearly defined and managed throughout each engagement.
  • Provide executive oversight of complex deployments and personally lead or support the most strategically significant programs.
  • Lead risk identification, mitigation planning, issue resolution, and executive communication across the implementation portfolio.
  • Partner with Customer Success and Support to ensure effective transition from implementation to ongoing adoption and value realization.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Solution Consulting to align client expectations, implementation strategy, scope, and success criteria from project inception.

Implementation Governance & Quality

  • Establish and enforce implementation standards across planning, discovery, solution design, configuration, integration, testing, training, launch, and hypercare.
  • Implement governance models that strengthen visibility, accountability, decision-making, risk management, and delivery quality.
  • Maintain executive oversight of program health and ensure delivery gaps are addressed with appropriate speed and rigor.
  • Capture lessons learned and use them to improve frameworks, operating processes, and team capability.

Solution Delivery & Technical Enablement

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of CORA Loyalty platform capabilities, configuration models, integration patterns, and implementation best practices.
  • Provide implementation leadership and coordinate with Product and Engineering on solution architecture, data migration, system configuration, integration strategy, and technical deployment approaches.
  • Coordinate delivery of complex integrations in partnership with Product, Engineering, client technical teams, and third-party vendors.
  • Build organizational capability across implementation tooling, integration patterns, configuration approaches, deployment practices, and client enablement.

Operational & Commercial Leadership

  • Establish operational rhythms including portfolio reviews, delivery forecasting, utilization management, implementation analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor implementation portfolio health through delivery, financial, operational, and client outcome metrics.
  • Oversee implementation forecasting, staffing, utilization, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
  • Support Statements of Work, implementation estimates, change requests, and delivery commitments.
  • Partner with PMO leadership to strengthen governance, forecasting, resource planning, and project execution.
  • Provide executive reporting on implementation performance, client health, delivery risks, capacity, and emerging trends.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Implementation Managers, Program Delivery Leads, Senior Consultants, and Implementation Consultants.
  • Establish clear roles, performance expectations, decision rights, and accountability across the team.
  • Attract, develop, and retain talent with strong delivery, technical, commercial, and client leadership capabilities.
  • Build team capability through structured coaching, training, mentorship, and knowledge-sharing.
  • Partner with leadership on workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, succession planning, and organizational development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, innovation, and strong client focus.

Required Experience and Capabilities

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Supply Chain, Retail Operations, or a related field; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience leading enterprise software, SaaS, or technology implementations.
  • 3+ years of people-leadership experience managing implementation, consulting, delivery, or professional services teams.
  • Proven experience leading client-facing delivery for complex enterprise customers and managing multiple concurrent implementations.

  • Strong understanding of data architecture, system integrations, APIs, EDI, and enterprise application ecosystems.

CareMind, part of the Mindoula Health family is hiring licensed therapists (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) to join our fully remote Suicide Prevention & Family Support Program in Washington.

Compensation: For candidates located in Washington State the pay is $90,000 a year. For candidates located outside of Washington, the salary is $75,000 per year plus excellent benefits and the opportunity to work with a fantastic team.

Comprehensive Benefits Package includes:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Supplemental Life Insurance
  • Short Term and Long Term Insurance paid by Mindoula
  • 401k, with a company match
  • 3 weeks paid vacation each year, 4 mental wellness days and 11 holidays
  • Parental Leave: 8 weeks of paid parental leave
  • Personal Development Program: $500 credit reimbursement per calendar year

As a Therapist, Suicide Prevention & Family Support (SPFS), you will work in collaborative settings to provide biopsychosocial assessments, individual and group therapy, and work with your team to coordinate care across a range of treatment settings. You will have the ability to manage a caseload and make decisions with appropriate autonomy.

Core Duties:

  • Deliver Family-Centered Psychotherapy: Provide evidence-based individual, joint family, and parent/guardian teletherapy for youth (ages 12–26) at high or critical risk of suicide, utilizing family-systems frameworks, C-CBT, DBT skills, and Motivational Interviewing.
  • Conduct Suicide Risk Assessment & Safety Planning: Administer validated risk assessment tools (e.g., C-SSRS) and lead real-time Safety Planning, lethal means counseling, and crisis stabilization tailored to both the youth and their family unit.
  • Manage Monthly Acuity & Risk Stratification: Complete validated clinical assessments at monthly review periods to measure acuity, track suicide risk trajectory, and dynamically adjust care frequency and treatment goals based on member readiness and family capacity.
  • Lead Clinical Care Team Collaboration: Direct the clinical safety strategy in close partnership with assigned Behavioral Health Support Specialists (BHSS) and the 24/7 crisis response team, ensuring aligned roles without duplicating billable services.
  • Provide Crisis Escalation Response: Serve as the licensed clinician for high-acuity escalations, executing immediate risk mitigation, triage, and rapid safety plan updates during critical member events.
  • Maintain Fee-for-Service & Medicaid Compliance: Complete high-integrity, timely clinical documentation (DAP) that explicitly substantiates medical necessity, suicide risk levels, family interventions, and whole-person care for Medicaid Fee-for-Service (FFS) billing.
  • Drive Multimodal Youth & Family Engagement: Utilize multi-platform engagement technology (video, secure messaging, interactive safety apps) to maintain persistent outreach and re-engage ambivalent youth or overwhelmed caregivers.
  • Integrate Care Infrastructure & Panel Tracking: Actively participate in interdisciplinary huddles, maintain registry accuracy, and monitor personal KPIs (billable hours, documentation turnaround, and show rates) to optimize clinical outcomes across the program panel.
  • Collaborate with the member, family, and healthcare providers to develop an individualized plan of care.
  • Develop and coordinate community resources with emphasis on medical, behavioral, suicide prevention, and social services.
  • Identify and initiate referrals for social service programs – including financial, psycho-social, community, and state supportive services.
  • Document all member assessments, care plans, and referrals provided. Prepare and maintain all required records, reports, paperwork, and member’s diagnostic records, maintaining confidentiality of members at all times.

Skills Required:

  • Relentless about prioritizing and following through on assigned tasks independently. Superior time management and organization to complete daily tasks by the end of each day.
  • Computer proficiency; Including experience with electronic health records (EHR).
  • Ability to exercise strict confidentiality and sound judgment with respect to sensitive member information, maintaining the integrity of member records at all times.
  • Excellent listening, verbal, and written communication skills. Clearly and accurately relay information to staff, business partners, stakeholders, and members including collaborating with interdisciplinary teams (e.g., BHSS).
  • Problem Solving: Identifies needs and takes independent action to implement change when and where it is needed; results oriented. Ability to plan, organize, manage time, and prioritize multiple tasks and assignments.
  • Ability to provide case management in routine and crisis situations.
  • Self-motivated, team player, adaptable with a strong sense of urgency in a fast-paced

Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in psychology, social work, or other applicable behavioral health discipline from an accredited college or university is required.
  • Licensure: Current Washington Department of Health (WA DOH) independent behavioral health license. Eligible licenses include:
    • Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW)
    • Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC)
    • Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
  • Two or more years of direct experience working with adolescents and adults in the behavioral health field required. Experience in suicide prevention strongly preferred.
  • Crisis intervention training and experience required.
  • Knowledge of local resources, social determinants of health, mental health, substance use disorders, interpersonal violence, and social issues.
  • Familiarity with Medicare or Medicaid practices preferred

raw.description:
About This Role


As Biogen's AI Security Engineer, you are a hands-on technical specialist responsible for securing the organization's rapidly expanding use of artificial intelligence, machine learning, and generative AI technologies. This role operates at the intersection of cybersecurity engineering and AI/ML systems — ensuring that AI deployments across Biogen are resilient against adversarial threats, data poisoning, model manipulation, prompt injection, and unauthorized data exposure.


The AI Security Engineer will design, implement, and operate security controls purpose-built for AI workloads — spanning model development pipelines, inference endpoints, training data protection, and AI-assisted automation platforms. This role is responsible for translating emerging AI threat frameworks (MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, NIST AI RMF) into actionable engineering controls that protect Biogen's AI investments without impeding innovation velocity.


This position requires a rare combination of software engineering depth, AI/ML systems knowledge, and cybersecurity expertise. The scope demands:


Deep technical proficiency across AI/ML security, cloud security, and application security — with the ability to build production-grade security tooling, not just assess or advise


Autonomous execution — independently identifying AI security gaps, designing solutions, and implementing them end-to-end without requiring constant direction


Adversarial mindset — thinking like an attacker to identify how AI systems can be subverted, manipulated, or exploited before threat actors do


Cross-domain fluency — bridging the gap between data science teams building AI and security teams protecting the enterprise, translating between both worlds.


What You’ll Do


AI Threat Detection & Response Engineering

  • Design, build, and operate detection capabilities for AI-specific threats including prompt injection, model extraction, training data poisoning, and adversarial input attacks
  • Develop and maintain AI security monitoring pipelines that correlate signals across LLM interactions, API gateways, and model inference endpoints
  • Engineer automated response playbooks for AI security incidents — including model quarantine, token revocation, and session termination
  • Continuously research emerging AI attack vectors and translate findings into detection signatures and prevention controls
  • Operate and tune CrowdStrike AI Runtime Defense (AIRD) and Microsoft Purview AI governance controls across the environment

AI Platform Security Engineering

  • Implement security controls across AI development and deployment platforms (AWS SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Databricks, internal ML pipelines)
  • Secure model training environments — including data access controls, compute isolation, artifact signing, and pipeline integrity verification
  • Engineer guardrails for generative AI usage — content filtering, DLP integration, output validation, and session-level access controls
  • Design and enforce AI model governance controls including model registry security, version control integrity, and deployment approval gates
  • Perform security architecture reviews of new AI services and integrations before production deployment

AI Risk Assessment & Framework Implementation

  • Conduct technical risk assessments of AI systems using MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, and NIST AI RMF frameworks
  • Perform adversarial testing (red teaming) of AI models and AI-integrated applications to identify vulnerabilities before production deployment
  • Develop and maintain AI security standards, reference architectures, and secure development guidelines for AI/ML teams
  • Evaluate third-party AI services and vendor AI integrations for security posture, data handling practices, and supply chain integrity

Security Automation & AI-Augmented Defense

  • Build and maintain AI-powered security tools that augment the cybersecurity team's detection and response capabilities
  • Develop integrations between security platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Zscaler) and AI/ML systems for intelligent threat correlation
  • Engineer automated security workflows using LLMs and agentic AI for threat hunting, alert triage, and incident investigation acceleration
  • Contribute to the security team's internal AI capabilities — including MCP server development, agent frameworks, and security data pipelines
  • Build and maintain security scoring engines and risk quantification models that drive prioritization decisions

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of combined experience in cybersecurity engineering, software engineering, and/or AI/ML systems
  • Demonstrated expertise in at least three of the following domains:
  • AI/ML Security: LLM security, prompt injection mitigation, model robustness testing, adversarial ML, AI supply chain integrity
  • Cloud Security Engineering: AWS, Azure, or GCP security architecture and controls implementation at scale
  • Application Security: Secure SDLC, API security, code review, penetration testing, threat modeling
  • Security Operations: Detection engineering, SIEM/SOAR development, incident response, threat hunting
  • Hands-on proficiency with Python and demonstrable experience building production security tooling and automation
  • Experience with AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain) and AI cloud services (SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Databricks)
  • Working knowledge of AI security frameworks: MITRE ATLAS, OWASP AI Top 10, NIST AI RMF
  • Experience with enterprise security platforms (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, Okta, Zscaler, CyberArk, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of LLM architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), fine-tuning security implications, and agentic AI patterns
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or related technical field required

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $140,000.00-$187,250.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.


At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.

The Director leads technical staff, sets priorities across daily support and change initiatives, and serves as a primary IT partner to Advertising leadership. Working with Finance, Sales Enablement, Product, Application Development, Infrastructure, Security, the PMO, and vendors, this position turns business needs into practical technology plans and provides leadership for major implementations and migrations.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

Directly supervises and develops the platform support analysts and other technical staff assigned to Advertising Operations. Sets individual and team priorities, allocates work, manages performance, plans coverage and succession, and supports staff development. Core Responsibilities:

Own the IT strategy and operational performance of advertising order management, CRM and sales workflows, creative and production systems, digital advertising, payment processing, reporting, and related third-party platforms. Directly lead the platform support analysts and other assigned technical staff; establish priorities, allocate capacity, develop employees, and maintain support coverage and institutional knowledge for critical systems. Partner with Advertising and IT leadership to translate business requirements into technology roadmaps and a prioritized Jira backlog, balancing operational support, enhancements, and project delivery against available capacity. Oversee integrations and data flows among order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, creative and pagination systems, billing, payments, and reporting; establish priorities for configuration, automation, and enhancements. Ensure system changes are tested across connected workflows and validated with business users, including production checks and reconciliation where transactions affect financial records. Partner with Finance on advertising billing, accounts receivable, payments, reconciliation, and controls at the points where advertising and financial systems meet. Coordinate with development, architecture, infrastructure, security, and service management teams to resolve issues and align platforms with enterprise standards. Manage advertising technology vendor relationships, including escalations, implementation commitments, service performance, technical requirements, and product direction. Maintain operational documentation, access governance, audit support, business continuity, and disaster recovery practices for advertising systems. Use Jira and a regular Agile planning and review cadence to track commitments, completed work, blockers, and dependencies; report delivery progress, system health, risks, and resource needs to IT leadership and business stakeholders. Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT, enterprise applications, business systems, or related work, including at least three years leading technical teams or major technology programs. Experience supporting integrated systems in a multi-location or enterprise environment preferred.

HCO Behavioral Health Services is seeking experienced Licensed Mental Health Professionals (LPC, LCSW, or LMFT) who have a passion for clinical excellence, mentorship, and developing future behavioral health professionals.

Successful candidates should be able to commit approximately 15–20 hours per week and enjoy balancing direct clinical work with leadership and supervisory responsibilities.

Clinical Assessments

  • Conduct assessments via telehealth
  • Complete assessments accurately and within established documentation timeframes
  • Develop appropriate clinical recommendations and treatment recommendations

Clinical Supervision

Provide supervision and oversight for assigned provisional and non-licensed behavioral health professionals, including:

  • Clinical guidance and mentorship
  • Performance feedback regarding documentation quality and clinical practice
  • Review documentation for clinical accuracy and compliance

  • License in good standing
  • Ability to provide clinical supervision under Louisiana regulations
  • Excellent clinical judgment
  • Strong documentation skills
  • Reliable internet connection and private workspace for telehealth services

We're looking for clinicians who are:

  • Organized and detail-oriented
  • Strong clinical decision-makers
  • Effective mentors and coaches
  • Excellent communicators
  • Passionate about developing clinicians
  • Committed to documentation excellence
  • Professional and dependable
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Solution-focused and collaborative

This opportunity offers experienced clinicians the chance to expand their impact beyond direct client care.

Rather than maintaining a large therapy caseload, you'll help shape the development of future behavioral health professionals while ensuring clients receive high-quality, clinically sound care.

Benefits of this opportunity include:

  • Flexible part-time schedule
  • Approximately 15–20 hours per week
  • Remote flexibility
  • Leadership and supervisory experience
  • Opportunity to mentor developing clinicians
  • Administrative support
  • Collaborative clinical environment
  • Meaningful impact on both clients and clinicians

Position Details

  • Independent Contractor (1099)
  • Part-Time
  • Approximately 15–20 hours per week
  • Approximately 5–8 behavioral health assessments weekly

Join HCO Behavioral Health Services and play an important role in developing exceptional clinicians while ensuring the delivery of high-quality behavioral healthcare throughout Louisiana.
