170+ Years Strong. Industry Leader. Global Impact.At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.

The GSOC Analyst, assigned to one of Pinkerton’s clients, will conduct in-depth research, open-source analysis, and social media review to monitor threats that may impact the safety and wellbeing of the client’s executives, operations, and/or assets. The Analyst vets potential and/or actual crisis response activations, as well as provide analysis on intelligence gathered. This position can be based anywhere (remote) within the Eastern time zone of the United States.

Responsibilities

  • Represent Pinkerton’s core values of integrity, vigilance, and excellence.
  • Conduct regular monitoring of open-source intelligence, social media platforms, and client specific intelligence gathering tools for known and potential threats to employees, company assets, and reputation.
  • Monitor geopolitical events that may impact executive travel, company events, and/or operations, and provide periodic and timely reporting.
  • Conduct in-depth research on a wide range of issues pertaining to global security, such as terrorism, natural disasters, and international politics to better understand the potential impact on areas where the client has operational interests.
  • Monitor a 24/7 email inbox and phone line.
  • Escalate to security management matters related to employee welfare, global incidents, operational issues, and critical situations.
  • Collect and validate intelligence, assess the credibility and reliability of open-source information.
  • Effectively analyze relevant threats and produce actionable intelligence products in a timely manner for all incidents including but not limited to threat assessments and travel risk assessments.
  • Provide ongoing news monitoring.
  • Maintain highly sensitive and confidential information.
  • Track, document and report progress on projects and initiatives in areas of responsibility.
  • All other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications

High school diploma/GED, college preferred, with at least three years within a GSOC environment plus intelligence, geopolitical, or security-related experience.

  • Familiar with standard security communication protocols and security tools.
  • Knowledgeable of news and current world events.
  • Self-motivated and curious.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Able to intake, evaluate, and sift large quantities of information.
  • Able to analyze and provide rigorous and creative insight into complex situations.
  • Client orientated and results driven.
  • Able to multi-task and deliver timely work products in a fast-paced environment.
  • Serve as an effective team member.
  • Able to work independently with little supervision.
  • Computer skills; Microsoft Office.

Working Conditions:

With or without reasonable accommodation, requires the physical and mental capacity to effectively perform all essential functions;

  • Regular computer usage.
  • Occasional reaching and lifting of small objects and operating office equipment.
  • Frequent sitting.
  • Travel, as required.

Pinkerton is an equal opportunity employer to all applicants and positions without regard to race/ethnicity, color, national origin, ancestry, sex/gender, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital/prenatal status, pregnancy/childbirth or related conditions, religion, creed, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any protected status by local, state, federal or country-specific law.

Benefits

Benefit options include employer-paid life and AD&D, voluntary life and AD&D, medical, (HSA) Health Savings Account, (FSA) Flexible Savings Account, dental, vision, short-term disability, long-term disability, 401(K), paid time off (vacation, personal, sick, and holidays) and several employee assistance-related programs. This information provides a brief benefit overview. Upon the acceptance of an employment offer, the new employee will receive comprehensive plan details based on specific eligibility rules.

Posted Salary Range

USD $31.25 - USD $31.25 /Hr.

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Patient Communications Representative is responsible for performing customer service activities to service and collect patient accounts receivables for medical accounts. Patient Communications Representative will locate and communicate with patients via the telephone, email, chat, text, etc. to obtain repayment in full or to establish acceptable payment arrangements. Additionally, Patient Communications Representative will resolve issues of a non-routine nature as necessary as well as answer patient’s questions and research account changes when necessary and contract observance functions to ensure compliance of all company, client, and federal and state regulations.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

This position is 100% remote. Must reside in the United States.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Communicate with patients regarding the repayment of their medical debt.

  • Achieve assigned goals (resolutions, call quality, productivity standards – specified by line of business)
  • Provide customer service to patients resolving medical account balances.
  • Profile patients and obtain financial information. Update demographic and financial information on each call.
  • Negotiate the best possible arrangements.

Perform account research and route accounts through appropriate client workflows

accounts in accordance with company and client specifications.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Career


The Regional Sales Manager partners with our larger midsize and regional customers to secure their entire digital experience.

You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment and navigate complex, matrixed organisations to connect customers with a solution for every stage of threat prevention.


Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.


Your Impact

  • You will drive and orchestrate complex sales cycles and sell Palo Alto Networks Products and Solutions through Channel Partners and by interacting directly with customers in your region to consistently achieve and exceed regional revenue targets
  • You will own and develop a diverse set of customers in a selected set of complex accounts, focusing on long-term value creation.
  • Leverage consultative selling experience will help you identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and existing customers, architecting comprehensive cybersecurity transformation across network, cloud and SOC environments
  • Lead multi-threaded sales engagements involving senior executive stakeholders, technical buyers, and procurement teams, to navigate enterprise purchasing complexities and secure large-scale, multi year deployments.
  • Master the competitive landscape, trends, and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions.

  • You will leverage channel and marketing programs as well as sales plays to drive pipeline generation and expand coverage across the region both with existing and new customers.
  • You will collaborate with the specialist sales teams driving cross-platform adoption and ensure the best solution for our customers and prospects.

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry.
  • Experience selling into mid-size and large enterprises, typically with multi-billion-dollar revenue and global or multi-regional operations.
  • Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques.
  • Proven ability to manage high-value accounts with extended sales cycles while operating in a high-variance environment.
  • Comfort managing accounts of different sizes, deal complexity, and sales readiness; deals may range from mid-market cycles to six & seven-figure, enterprise-scale opportunities.
  • Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems.
  • Cultivated relationships with our channel partners to bring a channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers.
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes, including legal, security, and commercial negotiations.
  • Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process.
  • Experience collaborating closely with a specialist sales organization to position the complete portfolio with prospects and customers.
  • Excellent time management skills and a history of consistently meeting or exceeding sales targets in a regional sales environment.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

raw.excerpt: Process Engineers on the Process Engineering team are key partners for customers in the North American market.
raw.description:
Process Engineers on the Process Engineering team are key partners for customers in the North American market. They are creative technical leaders who support the successful sale, engineering, commissioning, and operation of complete system solutions. To deliver winning solutions, they apply deep technical knowledge of our solutions and technologies combined with an understanding of the customer’s process, the market, regulations, and our competitors to continually balance technical risk with commercial viability.

On complex flow sheets with multiple unit processes, a Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics is included on the project to own the overall solution for our customer in collaboration with one or more Process Engineers with expertise in the various technologies used in the flow sheet. A Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics requires the abilities and expertise of a Process Engineer, and the technical, leadership, and communication skills of an Engineering Project Manager. The Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics requires domain expertise to act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) and technical point of contact in customer and internal communications. From a technical perspective, they have responsibility for the overall treatment solution including strategizing on the creation of that solution (safety factors, flow fluctuations, assumptions), identifying and managing the impacts that any given unit process will have on upstream/downstream unit processes as well as process risks, and owning the overall process flow
diagram, accompanying flow and quality balance, and overall process guarantees. From a leadership perspective, they proactively communicate across the team of Process Engineers, manage the process deliverables (schedules, assignments), and represent Process Engineering in review meetings at the
bidding and engineering stages. If process issues arise, they lead the troubleshooting effort and

resolution.

As the focal point of the Process Team for projects, the Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics functions as a dual-path expert. Their time allocation is strategically divided into approximately 60% Communication, Organization, and Coordination, where they manage process deliverables, schedules, and cross-functional representation. The remaining approximately 40% is dedicated to Technical Expertise, acting as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) who owns the overall treatment solution, including process guarantees and the troubleshooting of complex issues.

The Process Engineering Project Technical Leader - Microelectronics for the Microelectronics market will lead proposals and projects in execution for our Microelectronics customers’ ultrapure water (UPW), wastewater, and reclaim treatment needs.

Key Characteristics:

  • Leadership
  • Customer focus and commercial mindset
  • Analytical mindset
  • Creativity
  • Responsibility
  • Collaboration
  • Accountability

Duties and Responsibilities:

Microelectronics Project Technical Leaders lead the process design of ultrapure, wastewater, and reclaim treatment solutions for the Microelectronics industry.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Align a team of Process Engineers working together on a flow sheet to a strategy (including influent design basis, safety factors, handling of flow variations, how to meet the customer’s needs, how to win against the competition), a list of deliverables, and a schedule, and ensure that all process deliverables meet quality and schedule for the project
  • Lead the design of complete water, wastewater, or waste treatment solutions (flow sheet, unit processes, process parameters) that will meet the customer’s requirements for a given influent and required effluent stream qualities using various in house and industry design tools, acting as the leader for a team of Process Engineers providing technical expertise on specific portions of the overall flowsheet.
  • Apply advanced treatment technologies including biological treatment, ammonia removal, solids separation, low- and high-pressure membrane treatment (ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, reverse osmosis - conventional and high-pH), ion exchange, UV treatment, and gas-transfer membrane processes to meet the stringent requirements specific to the microelectronics industry
  • Own the overall Process Flow Diagram (PFD), associated flow tables or mass balance, and overall process guarantees, including management of the interconnections between unit processes and consideration of any impacts of one unit process on upstream or downstream unit processes, with input from the Process Engineers on the team.
  • Engage in piloting and benchmarking and treatability studies as part of design, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of UPW treatment solutions
  • Serve as a lead technical contact with our customers, building partnership relationships, and representing the team of Process Engineers working on the flow sheet together
  • Serve as the lead technical contact with other functions working together on the project
  • Identify and support management of technical risks related to the treatment process (flow sheet, unit processes, achievement of outputs), including compiling the risks throughout the flow sheet in collaboration with the Process Engineers on the project team
  • Troubleshoot technical issues using data and observations
  • Understand relevant regulations and liaise with regulatory agencies as needed
  • Own and be accountable for the success of assigned projects throughout project development as measured by achieving treatment requirements (successful operation) and customer satisfaction through proactive communication, collaboration, and leadership of corrective action management, in collaboration with the team of Process Engineers on the project
  • Demonstrate Veolia’s expertise in the external market through customer and conference presentations
  • Provide training and 1:1 coaching to members of the Process Engineering team

Industry Leadership and Expertise:
A Process Engineering Project Technical Leader builds long-term relationships with customers and key experts in the industry and presents at industry conferences and technical forums to position Veolia as experts within the microelectronics market. They serve as an expert within the business, participating in innovation of solutions, technologies, and markets, and training and mentoring others in process design.

Qualifications:

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Ability to design complete integrated water, wastewater, or waste treatment solutions, including preliminary design of associated tanks, rotating equipment, piping, instrumentation, and controls
  • Ability to integrate multiple main unit operations (e.g. clarifier, MBR, RO, thermal) into a single flow sheet with consideration of recycle streams, flow variations, and a range of influent qualities
  • Demonstrated leadership skills
  • Exceptionally strong oral and written communication skills in English for customer facing communication (including presentations) as well as internal collaboration and influence
  • Proactive organization and time management
  • Excellent computer skills (i.e., Excel, Word and PowerPoint and Google Suite analogues)
  • Ability to exercise good judgement under changing conditions
  • Critical and creative thinking, and ability to evaluate among numerous options
  • Data analysis
  • Effective troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

Education and Experience:
Required:

  • Bachelor or advanced degree in an Engineering field – Environmental, Chemical, or Mechanical preferred, or other technical discipline with a combination of process design and hands-on microelectronics water and wastewater treatment system experience
  • 10+ years of related experience, preferably process engineering specific, with an emphasis in process design and/or operation of water, wastewater or waste treatment
  • Demonstrated experience with UPW, wastewater, and reclaim treatment processes and system design/operation for the microelectronics industry
  • Leadership experience or demonstrated leadership competency to connect people, set and communicate a vision, align and inspire a team towards an objective, train/coach/mentor others, and confidently make effective decisions with limited information under evolving conditions

Preferred:

  • Professional Engineer’s License

Why Veolia?

  • Join a company that values Responsibility, Solidarity, Innovation, Customer Focus, and Respect.
  • You'll receive comprehensive technical and commercial training, direct mentorship from experienced Account Managers, and a clear pathway to Account Manager promotion with direct account responsibilities.

Career Development Path:

  • This position is designed as a stepping stone to Account Manager, where you'll assume direct customer responsibility and independent account management upon demonstrating commercial excellence.

Ready to transition your technical expertise into a rewarding customer-facing career while
making a difference in water treatment and sustainability? Apply today!

Director, Global Media Relations


About Elsevier:

Elsevier, part of RELX, is a global leader in advanced information and decision support. For over a century, we have been helping advance science and healthcare to advance human progress. We support academic and corporate research communities, doctors, nurses, future healthcare professionals, and educators across 170 countries in their vital work. We help impact makers achieve better outcomes with research and clinical-grade solutions built on the world’s leading evidence-based scientific and medical content, precision AI, and expert human assessment. We champion inclusion and sustainability, working with the communities that we serve. The Elsevier Foundation supports research and health partnerships around the world.


About the Global Media Team:

Elsevier's global media team plays a strategic role in protecting and enhancing the company's reputation among key external stakeholders. The team proactively plans and executes earned media strategies aligned with Elsevier's objectives, helping to position the company and its portfolio of solutions with the scientific and medical communities, policymakers, and industry press.


Through their efforts, the global media team helps to enhance the company brand and supports commercial objectives while reinforcing Elsevier's position as a trusted leader in information and analytics.


About the role:

Director, Global Media Relations (reporting to Terri Mueller, VP, Global Communications)


Responsibilities:

  • The director will help lead the media strategy and support global media activities connected to Elsevier’s priorities, such as commercial launches, campaigns, thought leadership initiatives, executive communications and reactive media inquiries.
  • The director will collaborate with the segment teams on messaging, bylined articles, pitches and other content for use with media.
  • The director will work with multiple stakeholders in key markets, including agencies and business partners, to deliver on the media goals and will provide counsel to the business segments and markets.
  • The director will provide support on key global media activities such as handling media inquiries as needed, strategic planning, tracking and measurement.
  • Expected to maintain an in-depth understanding of technology, external regulation, and industry best practices through ongoing education, attending conferences, and reading specialist media.
  • This role is fully remote and will be based in New York, New Jersey or Pennsylvania, USA. There will be occasions where the director will be required to travel to an Elsevier office or to attend off-site meetings (10% travel).

  • 7+ years of experience in media relations or corporate communications ideally within a global, matrixed organization or agency setting supporting a large enterprise client.
  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • Established relationships with, and credibility among, journalists covering science, healthcare, technology, or business.

  • Strong news judgment and writing skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific and technical topics for a general audience.

IT Help Desk Specialist

  • Location: Remote. International applicants welcome.

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 3:30 PM US Central Time

  • Type: Full-time independent contractor

About the role

We run sales and support teams across several health and wellness brands. Everything they do runs on Salesforce, a cloud phone system and a business texting platform. When something breaks, you're the one who fixes it.

You'll be the first point of contact for 150+ users: their accounts, their phone setup and their support tickets. You'll escalate only what truly needs a system change.

How we work

This role is built for someone who doesn't need to be managed. There's no daily task list handed to you. Your work lives on a dashboard that shows every open ticket, pending request and system alert, and your goal is to keep it empty.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Starts the day by checking the dashboard, not by waiting for direction

  • Figures things out before asking

  • Manages their own time and priorities, and knows what's urgent and what can wait until the afternoon

  • Follows through without reminders and closes the loop with the person who asked

  • Can be trusted with admin access to the tools the whole company depends on

If you do your best work with clear ownership and little supervision, this is that job.

What you'll do

  • Keep the help desk dashboard at zero: open tickets, pending account requests and system health alerts

  • Resolve most support tickets yourself, and escalate the rest with the investigation already done

  • Set up and remove user accounts across Salesforce, Vonage, SMS Magic and our other tools as people join, change roles or leave

  • Troubleshoot calling, callback and voicemail issues with agents, and work with Vonage support on open cases

  • Manage our business phone numbers: assignments, releases, and requesting spam-label removal with the carriers (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile)

  • Maintain users and numbers in our business texting platform

  • Process requests to delete call recordings under our privacy process

  • Correct sales and order records when automated checks flag a mismatch

What you'll need

  • 2+ years in IT help desk, technical support or contact center support

  • Salesforce experience strongly preferred, especially managing users, permissions and records

  • Strong troubleshooting skills: you can take a vague "it's not working," find the cause, and fix it or explain it clearly

  • A track record of working independently: self-motivated, organized and good at managing your own time

  • Excellent written and spoken English; most communication is written, in tickets and Slack

  • Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the full 7:30 to 3:30 CT schedule

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator certification

  • Vonage Contact Center (VCC) or another cloud contact center platform

  • SMS platforms, telecom or phone number management

  • Experience supporting sales teams

Job Details

Senior Endpoint Engineer/Administrator (Level 3) responsible for the design, deployment, and advanced support of endpoint management solutions across a large, distributed physical and virtual device estate using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Microsoft Intune in a co-managed environment. Owns application packaging, third-party patch management, security vulnerability remediation, advanced PowerShell automation, and at-scale incident troubleshooting, partnering closely with Information Security, Networking, and Support teams to keep the endpoint fleet secure, compliant, and reliable.


Key Responsibilities

  • Package, test, and deploy Windows and third-party applications through MECM and Intune (Win32 apps), using PSADT and other silent-install packages with reliable detection logic and dependency handling.
  • MECM/Intune co-management experience: client settings, boundaries and boundary groups, deployment collections, Autopilot profiles, compliance policies, and configuration baselines across the enterprise endpoint estate.
  • Design, write, and maintain advanced PowerShell scripts for automation, remediation, and reporting, including Intune and MECM.
  • Identify, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities across the endpoint fleet in partnership with Information Security – driving CVE/patch-compliance reporting and mitigation timelines for OS and third-party applications.
  • Third-party application patching lifecycle – identifying, packaging, testing, and deploying updates (e.g., via Patch My PC, MECM, application/patch deployment) to minimize vulnerability exposure windows.
  • Networking knowledge (DNS, DHCP, IP addressing/subnetting, VLANs, boundary/content distribution) to resolve connectivity issues affecting client communication, application delivery, and patch distribution.
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools (Claude, Copilot and other scripting assistants) and automation/orchestration to streamline packaging, remediation, and reporting – tracking work in JIRA and version-controlling scripts/configs in GitHub.
  • Partner and collaborate with multiple technical teams (Architecture, Networking, Information Security, Support, etc.) to develop and support endpoint solutions.
  • Triage and resolve escalations from Endpoint Support and Security, acting as a technical escalation point for Level 1/2 teams.

This job profile description is a standardized, non-contractual reference description and global reference tool provided for organizational consistency and talent architecture purposes across Cencora. It does not alter actual job duties, responsibilities, reporting lines, working conditions, grading, compensation, or other essential terms and conditions of employment.

Actual duties and responsibilities may vary based on business needs, local requirements, and operational practices. Mandatory local laws shall also prevail.

Experience and Educational Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related technology field (equivalent experience considered).
  • At least 8 years of IT experience, including 5+ years in infrastructure/endpoint engineering.
  • Advanced, hands-on expertise with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune, including co-management, Autopilot, compliance policies, and Win32 application deployment.
  • Demonstrated experience remediating security vulnerabilities – identifying, prioritizing, and patching OS and third-party application vulnerabilities, including CVE triage and patch-compliance reporting (Microsoft Defender/vulnerability management tooling).
  • Advanced PowerShell scripting ability (functions, modules, error handling, remoting, Graph API/Intune scripting), plus familiarity with VBScript for legacy support.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex incidents at scale across large, distributed endpoint environments, with strong root-cause analysis skills.
  • Strong application packaging experience (.MSI/.MST, Win32; App-V/MSIX familiarity a plus) using, PSAppDeployToolkit, Advanced Installer, and Orca.
  • Experience managing third-party application patching programs (e.g., Patch My PC, Ivanti, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of Active Directory and Group Policy for managing user/computer objects, including GPO troubleshooting (gpresult, RSoP).
  • Working knowledge of wired/wireless networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, subnetting, and VLANs, and how they affect client-server communication and content distribution.
  • Familiarity with Windows 11 Enterprise features, settings, and deployment; BIOS/UEFI configuration; Bitlocker and Microsoft Defender.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies (Citrix, VMware) and thin/zero-client delivery is a plus.
  • Solid track record of delivering thoughtful, effective, and timely solutions to complex business problems that enhance the end-user experience.

Additional / Preferred Skills

  • AI-assisted automation and Copilot-style tools (Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude) to speed up scripting, triage, and remediation.
  • Service-Now for Incident, request logging.
  • GitHub (or Azure DevOps) for version-controlled scripts and Intune/MECM configuration-as-code, including basic CI/CD pipelines.
  • JIRA (or similar) for ticketing, sprint/backlog tracking, and change management.
  • Working familiarity with Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and Windows Autopatch.
  • Experience mentoring Level 1/2 engineers and producing clear runbooks/knowledge-base documentation.
  • ITIL foundations or equivalent incident/problem/change management experience.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. Summary of Position Role/Responsibilities

Quzara is seeking a hands-on SOC Engineer to onboard customers into our managed security services and keep their security tooling and telemetry running reliably. The SOC Engineer works with customers and internal teams to integrate data sources, configure Microsoft security services, automate workflows, and resolve technical issues in federal and regulated environments.

Essential Functions of the Job

  • Lead technical onboarding of new customers, from discovery and requirements through configuration, validation, and handoff.
  • Configure and integrate Microsoft security services, including Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, and Entra ID, with customer environments.
  • Onboard and validate security telemetry from identity, endpoint, network, SaaS, and multi-cloud sources, including Azure, AWS, and Google Workspace.
  • Integrate and troubleshoot log sources across multiple SIEM platforms, including Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, SentinelOne, and IBM QRadar.
  • Troubleshoot ingestion and integration issues across cloud, identity, network, Windows, and Linux layers.
  • Build automation and scripts that make onboarding and operations repeatable.
  • Support customers operating under federal and regulated requirements, including FedRAMP, CMMC, and NIST frameworks.
  • Produce clear technical documentation and work directly with customer stakeholders to resolve onboarding blockers.

Marginal Functions of the Job

  • Other duties as assigned

Normal Work Schedule:

This full-time role runs Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM–5:30 PM and requires flexibility to work remotely or on-site (if applicable per client RTO policies). On occasion additional hours may be necessary.

Education, Training, and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years in IT infrastructure, cloud, or security engineering, including 3+ years hands-on with Microsoft Azure.
  • 2+ years with Microsoft Sentinel or a comparable enterprise SIEM, including data-source onboarding.
  • Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft security stack (Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Azure Monitor / Log Analytics) and multi-tenant delegated access (Azure Lighthouse, GDAP).
  • Hands-on experience onboarding a wide range of data sources (identity providers, endpoints, firewalls and network devices, SaaS applications, Syslog/CEF, API, and agent-based integrations) from Azure, AWS, and Google Workspace / Google Cloud.
  • Experience working across multiple SIEM platforms, such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, SentinelOne, IBM QRadar, or similar.
  • Proficiency in KQL and scripting (PowerShell or Python), with solid troubleshooting skills across Windows, Linux, networking, and identity.
  • Strong written and customer-facing communication skills.
  • At least one current certification required: AZ-500 or SC-200.
  • Preferred: prior MSSP, MDR, or security consulting experience; experience supporting federal or defense-industrial-base customers, including GCC and GCC High environments; and experience with EDR/XDR platforms such as CrowdStrike or SentinelOne.

Preferred Certifications

  • Ideal: SC-100 (Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert).
  • Microsoft: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect Expert), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), SC-401 (Information Security Administrator), MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator).
  • Cloud security: AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
  • SIEM / EDR: Splunk Enterprise Security Certified Admin, IBM QRadar SIEM, SentinelOne, or CrowdStrike Falcon (CCFA) certifications, or equivalent.
  • General security: CISSP, CCSP, CompTIA Security+ or CySA+, GIAC (GCDA, GCIH, or GCED).

As the Account Executive for Life Sciences, you will own the account relationship across all Verily offerings, and be responsible for managing the sales process to bring Verily’s solutions to existing and new Life Sciences clients. This will include understanding customer needs, organization structure and buying patterns; developing deep and broad relationships within each account under your purview; collaborating with Verily Technical Sales and Customer Success teams to bring Verily breadth of solutions into your Life Science and MedTech clients; and holding responsibility for bookings and revenue generation. raw.title: Senior BIM Manager, Data Centers - Remote (U.S.)
raw.excerpt: AECOM is seeking a Senior BIM (Digital Design) Manager to lead digital delivery across our hyperscale data center portfolio.
raw.description:
AECOM is seeking a Senior BIM (Digital Design) Manager to lead digital delivery across our hyperscale data center portfolio. Reporting to and working alongside the Senior BIM Manager Lead, this role implements and enforces, at the project level, the firmwide BIM standards, execution plans, and coordination workflows that the Senior BIM Manager Lead owns. A central focus of the role is overseeing our U.S. BIM staff and global enterprise-capabilities (EC) partners and holding them accountable: monitoring their work against project standards, scope, and schedule, driving timely correction of deficiencies, and stepping in on the occasion project deliverables are in jeopardy of missing a deadline. This is a remote position open to candidates across the United States, with a hybrid option available for those near an AECOM office.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to:

1. BIM Standards & Execution

  • Implement and tailor project-level BIM standards within the firmwide framework owned by the Senior BIM Manager Lead, including BIM Execution Plans (BEP) templates, naming conventions, QA/QC checklists, and CDE folder structures suited to project type and client requirements.
  • Develop and maintain project BEP and related documentation, aligned to industry standards, NBIMs, NCIS, AIA, BIMForum and ISO 19650, and client Exchange Information Requirements.
  • Lead administration of the project Common Data Environment (CDE), such as Autodesk Forma or ProjectWise: folder structures, permissions, metadata, workflows, archival/retention, and integration with project-management systems.
  • Run BIM kickoff meetings internally, EC partners, consultants and clients for all phases.
  • Ensure compliance with contractual requirements and information-delivery milestones, flagging risks in digital deliverables to the Senior BIM Manager Lead.

2. Oversight & Accountability

  • Oversee day-to-day BIM production performed by U.S. BIM staff and EC teams, ensuring work aligns with the project BEP, standards, scope, and agreed Level of Development/Information.
  • Hold teams accountable to agreed quality, scope, and schedule: tracking progress, identifying gaps early, and driving timely correction.
  • Conduct regular QA reviews, visually inspect models, review clash and coordination efforts, advise on BIM solutions, provide model health scoring, and audits deliverables; triage issues, document deficiencies and non-compliance clearly, and escalate persistent or systemic issues to the Senior BIM Manager Lead.
  • Clarify scope and modeling expectations to teams and serve as a primary day-to-day point of contact for coordination.
  • Maintain accountability records (issue logs, audit results, deliverable status) that give the Senior BIM Manager Lead and project leadership clear visibility into performance.

3. Hands-On Production & Quality Backfill

  • Step in to produce, correct, or complete model content directly if output is late, incomplete, or below standard, to keep project deliverables on schedule.
  • Perform hands-on Revit production across disciplines as needed: modeling, sheet setup, parameter population, and corrections.
  • Resolve BIM design and modeling issues directly throughout all project phases.
  • Create smart-object content and templates to support production and reduce rework.

4. Project Delivery, Coordination & Reporting

  • Setup and/or verify project models, ensuring correct shared coordinates, base point, survey point, and model-coordination standards.
  • Establish and/or run multidisciplinary model coordination across projects: scheduled clash detection, issue triage, model health scoring, and remediation tracking, with particular attention to the high-density MEP and structural interfaces typical of data center builds (Navisworks, Revizto, Forma Model Coordination and Issues).
  • Oversee model lifecycle integration for 3D/4D/5D and incoming contractor and consultant model submittals, supporting progress reporting and cost integration.
  • Conduct regular model reviews and compliance checks across all delivery locations.
  • Report monthly on BIM KPIs, compliance metrics, and deliverable status to the Senior BIM Manager Lead and project leadership and maintain supporting dashboards.

5. Automation & Technical Enablement

  • Build and execute an automation roadmap focused on delivery needs, prioritizing Dynamo and Revit API scripts that reduce repetitive modeling, QC, and quantification tasks, especially to QA and remediate work efficiently.
  • Provide technical production support on 3D and 2D deliverables, smart-object content creation, and template development.
  • Deploy and support AECOM’s content management systems (Autodesk Content Catalogue / UNIFI).
  • Support asset information management (AIM) and digital handover for facilities management and digital-twin environments.

6. Resourcing, Training & Knowledge Sharing

  • Provide input to project estimates for BIM scope and resource schedules; help monitor utilization and recovery across assigned projects.
  • Contribute to role-based training and certification to build baseline BIM competency across U.S. and EC teams, and mentor EC coordinators and junior staff on project-standard and client-specific workflows.
  • Capture lessons learned and recurring EC deficiency patterns to refine workflows and inform the Senior BIM Manager Lead.
  • Share best practices, standards, tools, and techniques with the broader BIM team.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree + 6 years of relevant experience or an Associate's Degree + 8 years of relevant experience or HS Diploma + 10 years of relevant experience in BIM/digital delivery, including 2 years of experience directly leading or coordinating multidisciplinary BIM work, or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 8+ years in BIM environments, including experience establishing and enforcing standards and overseeing multidisciplinary teams, preferably within the U.S. market or on U.S. projects; data center or mission-critical experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating, overseeing, and performing QA on work produced by offshore / enterprise-capabilities teams, with a proven ability to hold remote teams accountable to standards and schedule.
  • Strong hands-on Revit skills, with the ability to step in and produce or correct model content directly across disciplines.
  • Deep experience with Forma, Revit, Navisworks, and Civil 3D;
  • Working knowledge of SharePoint, ProjectWise, and project planning tools desirable.
  • Demonstrated capability in automation (Dynamo, Revit API, scripting) and delivering quantifiable process improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of industry standards, NBIMs, NCIS, AIA, BIMForum and ISO 19650 Experience with BEP authoring, QA/QC frameworks, and model lifecycle management.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and training capability.
  • Detail-oriented, thorough, and well-organized, with excellent time management and the ability to drive accountability across distributed teams.
  • Interest or experience in integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) into BIM and digital-delivery workflows.
  • Relocation is not available for this role
  • Sponsorship is not available for this role
  • THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 9, 2026.

raw.description:
Note: Need only Independent Consultants

Job Title: Sr UX Engineer

Location: 100% Remote

Duration: 06+ Months Contract to Contract to Hire

Job Description:

This job will have the following responsibilities:

  • Hands-on foundational research, interaction design, visual design, prototyping and customer research
  • Taking problems from concept to implementation, quickly and iteratively.
  • Partner with design system team to ensure reusability and contribute to the design system ecosystem to improve and evolve design patterns.
  • Manage and translate end user research, facilitate structured brainstorming and ideation techniques, oversee rapid prototyping.
  • Translate business strategies into user experiences, which may include persona development, workflow planning, wireframes, and low fidelity sketches.
  • Deeply understand the needs, pain points, behaviors, emotions and journeys of users in the context of the digital and clinical experience.
  • Identify and coach other team members on user experience design.
  • Quantitative/qualitative customer research and experimentation to deliver the best experiences
  • Ability to successfully communicate and collaborate across a variety of stakeholders, including researchers, product managers, engineers as well as execs and customers

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • 5+ years of UX/UI Product Design experience
  • Should have visual design expertise, highly skilled in UI Design
  • should have human-centered / design thinking training
  • Should understand agile / lean + development frameworks
  • Should be a self-starter who's open to ambiguity and change
  • Should have a portfolio of work demonstrating your human centered approach and design thinking skills
  • can lead user tests + research studies a plus
